EXO.18.18.t: Surely you and these people with you will wear yourselves out, because the task is too heavy for you. You cannot handle it alone.
s: Surely you and these people with you will wear yourselves out, because the task is too heavy for you. You cannot handle it alone.

EXO.18.19.t: Now listen to me; I will give you some advice, and may God be with you. You must be the people’s representative before God and bring their causes to Him.
s: Now listen to me; I will give you some advice, and may God be with you. You must be the people’s representative before God and bring their causes to Him.

EXO.18.20.t: Teach them the statutes and laws, and show them the way to live and the work they must do.
s: Teach them the statutes and laws, and show them the way to live and the work they must do.

EXO.18.21.t: Furthermore, select capable men from among the people—God-fearing, trustworthy men who are averse to dishonest gain. Appoint them over the people as leaders of thousands, of hundreds, of fifties, and of tens.
s: Furthermore, select capable men from among the people—God-fearing, trustworthy men who are averse to dishonest gain. Appoint them over the people as leaders of thousands, of hundreds, of fifties, and of tens.

EXO.18.22.t: Have these men judge the people at all times. Then they can bring you any major issue, but all minor cases they can judge on their own, so that your load may be lightened as they share it with you.
s: Have these men judge the people at all times. Then they can bring you any major issue, but all minor cases they can judge on their own, so that your load may be lightened as they share it with you.

EXO.18.23.t: If you follow this advice and God so directs you, then you will be able to endure, and all these people can go home in peace.”
s: If you follow this advice and God so directs you, then you will be able to endure, and all these people can go home in peace.”

EXO.18.24.t: Moses listened to his father-in-law and did everything he said.
s: Moses listened to his father-in-law and did everything he said.

EXO.20.8.t: Remember the Sabbath day by keeping it holy.
s: Remember the Sabbath day by keeping it holy.

EXO.20.9.t: Six days you shall labor and do all your work,
s: Six days you shall labor and do all your work,

EXO.20.10.t: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to the LORD your God, on which you must not do any work—neither you, nor your son or daughter, nor your manservant or maidservant or livestock, nor the foreigner within your gates.
s: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to the LORD your God, on which you must not do any work—neither you, nor your son or daughter, nor your manservant or maidservant or livestock, nor the foreigner within your gates.

EXO.20.11.t: For in six days the LORD made the heavens and the earth and the sea and all that is in them, but on the seventh day He rested. Therefore the LORD blessed the Sabbath day and set it apart as holy.
s: For in six days the LORD made the heavens and the earth and the sea and all that is in them, but on the seventh day He rested. Therefore the LORD blessed the Sabbath day and set it apart as holy.

EXO.31.1.t: Then the LORD said to Moses,
s: Then the LORD said to Moses,

EXO.31.2.t: “See, I have called by name Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.
s: “See, I have called by name Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.

EXO.31.3.t: And I have filled him with the Spirit of God, with skill, ability, and knowledge in all kinds of craftsmanship,
s: And I have filled him with the Spirit of God, with skill, ability, and knowledge in all kinds of craftsmanship,

EXO.31.4.t: to design artistic works in gold, silver, and bronze,
s: to design artistic works in gold, silver, and bronze,

EXO.31.5.t: to cut gemstones for settings, and to carve wood, so that he may be a master of every craft.
s: to cut gemstones for settings, and to carve wood, so that he may be a master of every craft.

EXO.31.6.t: Moreover, I have selected Oholiab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, as his assistant. I have also given skill to all the craftsmen, that they may fashion all that I have commanded you:
s: Moreover, I have selected Oholiab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, as his assistant.
I have also given skill to all the craftsmen, that they may fashion all that I have commanded you:

EXO.33.12.t: Then Moses said to the LORD, “Look, You have been telling me, ‘Lead this people up,’ but You have not let me know whom You will send with me. Yet You have said, ‘I know you by name, and you have found favor in My sight.’
s: Then Moses said to the LORD, “Look, You have been telling me, ‘Lead this people up,’ but You have not let me know whom You will send with me. Yet You have said, ‘I know you by name, and you have found favor in My sight.’

EXO.33.13.t: Now if indeed I have found favor in Your sight, please let me know Your ways, that I may know You and find favor in Your sight. Remember that this nation is Your people.”
s: Now if indeed I have found favor in Your sight, please let me know Your ways, that I may know You and find favor in Your sight. Remember that this nation is Your people.”

EXO.33.14.t: And the LORD answered, “My Presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.”
s: And the LORD answered, “My Presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.”

EXO.33.15.t: “If Your Presence does not go with us,” Moses replied, “do not lead us up from here.
s: “If Your Presence does not go with us,” Moses replied, “do not lead us up from here.

EXO.33.16.t: For how then can it be known that Your people and I have found favor in Your sight, unless You go with us? How else will we be distinguished from all the other people on the face of the earth?”
s: For how then can it be known that Your people and I have found favor in Your sight, unless You go with us? How else will we be distinguished from all the other people on the face of the earth?”

EXO.33.17.t: So the LORD said to Moses, “I will do this very thing you have asked, for you have found favor in My sight, and I know you by name.”
s: So the LORD said to Moses, “I will do this very thing you have asked, for you have found favor in My sight, and I know you by name.”

EZR.8.21.t: And there by the Ahava Canal I proclaimed a fast, so that we might humble ourselves before our God and ask Him for a safe journey for us and our children, with all our possessions.
s: And there by the Ahava Canal I proclaimed a fast, so that we might humble ourselves before our God and ask Him for a safe journey for us and our children, with all our possessions.

EZR.8.22.t: For I was ashamed to ask the king for an escort of soldiers and horsemen to protect us from our enemies on the road, since we had told him, “The hand of our God is gracious to all who seek Him, but His great anger is against all who forsake Him.”
s: For I was ashamed to ask the king for an escort of soldiers and horsemen to protect us from our enemies on the road, since we had told him, “The hand of our God is gracious to all who seek Him, but His great anger is against all who forsake Him.”

EZR.8.23.t: So we fasted and petitioned our God about this, and He granted our request.
s: So we fasted and petitioned our God about this, and He granted our request.

EZR.8.24.t: Then I set apart twelve of the leading priests, together with Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and ten of their brothers,
s: Then I set apart twelve of the leading priests, together with Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and ten of their brothers,

EZR.8.25.t: and I weighed out to them the contribution of silver and gold and the articles that the king, his counselors, his leaders, and all the Israelites there had offered for the house of our God.
s: and I weighed out to them the contribution of silver and gold and the articles that the king, his counselors, his leaders, and all the Israelites there had offered for the house of our God.

EZR.8.26.t: I weighed out into their hands 650 talents of silver, articles of silver weighing 100 talents, 100 talents of gold,
s: I weighed out into their hands 650 talents of silver, articles of silver weighing 100 talents, 100 talents of gold,

EZR.8.27.t: 20 gold bowls valued at 1,000 darics, and two articles of fine polished bronze, as precious as gold.
s: 20 gold bowls valued at 1,000 darics, and two articles of fine polished bronze, as precious as gold.

EZR.8.28.t: Then I told them, “You are holy to the LORD, and these articles are holy. The silver and gold are a freewill offering to the LORD, the God of your fathers.
s: Then I told them, “You are holy to the LORD, and these articles are holy. The silver and gold are a freewill offering to the LORD, the God of your fathers.

EZR.8.29.t: Guard them carefully until you weigh them out in the chambers of the house of the LORD in Jerusalem before the leading priests, Levites, and heads of the Israelite families.”
s: Guard them carefully until you weigh them out in the chambers of the house of the LORD in Jerusalem before the leading priests, Levites, and heads of the Israelite families.”

EZR.8.30.t: So the priests and Levites took charge of the silver and gold and sacred articles that had been weighed out to be taken to the house of our God in Jerusalem.
s: So the priests and Levites took charge of the silver and gold and sacred articles that had been weighed out to be taken to the house of our God in Jerusalem.

EZR.8.31.t: On the twelfth day of the first month we set out from the Ahava Canal to go to Jerusalem, and the hand of our God was upon us to protect us from the hands of the enemies and bandits along the way.
s: On the twelfth day of the first month we set out from the Ahava Canal to go to Jerusalem, and the hand of our God was upon us to protect us from the hands of the enemies and bandits along the way.

GAL.2.16.t: know that a man is not justified by works of the law, but by faith in Jesus Christ. So we, too, have believed in Christ Jesus, that we may be justified by faith in Christ and not by works of the law, because by works of the law no one will be justified.
s: know that a man is not justified by works of the law, but by faith in Jesus Christ. So we, too, have believed in Christ Jesus, that we may be justified by faith in Christ and not by works of the law, because by works of the law no one will be justified.

GAL.2.17.t: But if, while we seek to be justified in Christ, we ourselves are found to be sinners, does that make Christ a minister of sin? Certainly not!
s: But if, while we seek to be justified in Christ, we ourselves are found to be sinners, does that make Christ a minister of sin? Certainly not!

GAL.2.18.t: If I rebuild what I have already torn down, I prove myself to be a lawbreaker.
s: If I rebuild what I have already torn down, I prove myself to be a lawbreaker.

GAL.2.19.t: For through the law I died to the law so that I might live to God.
s: For through the law I died to the law so that I might live to God.

GAL.2.20.t: I have been crucified with Christ, and I no longer live, but Christ lives in me. The life I live in the body, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave Himself up for me.
s: I have been crucified with Christ, and I no longer live, but Christ lives in me. The life I live in the body, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave Himself up for me.

GAL.2.21.t: I do not set aside the grace of God. For if righteousness comes through the law, Christ died for nothing.
s: I do not set aside the grace of God. For if righteousness comes through the law, Christ died for nothing.

GAL.4.1.t: What I am saying is that as long as the heir is a child, he is no different from a slave, although he is the owner of everything.
s: What I am saying is that as long as the heir is a child, he is no different from a slave, although he is the owner of everything.

GAL.4.2.t: He is subject to guardians and trustees until the date set by his father.
s: He is subject to guardians and trustees until the date set by his father.

GAL.4.3.t: So also, when we were children, we were enslaved under the basic principles of the world.
s: So also, when we were children, we were enslaved under the basic principles of the world.

GAL.4.4.t: But when the time had fully come, God sent His Son, born of a woman, born under the law,
s: But when the time had fully come, God sent His Son, born of a woman, born under the law,

GAL.4.5.t: to redeem those under the law, that we might receive our adoption as sons.
s: to redeem those under the law, that we might receive our adoption as sons.

GAL.4.6.t: And because you are sons, God sent the Spirit of His Son into our hearts, crying out, “Abba, Father!”
s: And because you are sons, God sent the Spirit of His Son into our hearts, crying out, “Abba, Father!”

GAL.4.7.t: So you are no longer a slave, but a son; and since you are a son, you are also an heir through God.
s: So you are no longer a slave, but a son; and since you are a son, you are also an heir through God.

GAL.5.16.t: So I say, walk by the Spirit, and you will not gratify the desires of the flesh.
s: So I say, walk by the Spirit, and you will not gratify the desires of the flesh.

GAL.5.17.t: For the flesh craves what is contrary to the Spirit, and the Spirit what is contrary to the flesh. They are opposed to each other, so that you do not do what you want.
s: For the flesh craves what is contrary to the Spirit, and the Spirit what is contrary to the flesh. They are opposed to each other, so that you do not do what you want.

GAL.5.18.t: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.
s: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.

GAL.5.19.t: The acts of the flesh are obvious: sexual immorality, impurity, and debauchery;
s: The acts of the flesh are obvious: sexual immorality, impurity, and debauchery;

GAL.5.20.t: idolatry and sorcery; hatred, discord, jealousy, and rage; rivalries, divisions, factions,
s: idolatry and sorcery; hatred, discord, jealousy, and rage; rivalries, divisions, factions,

GAL.5.21.t: and envy; drunkenness, orgies, and the like. I warn you, as I did before, that those who practice such things will not inherit the kingdom of God.
s: and envy; drunkenness, orgies, and the like. I warn you, as I did before, that those who practice such things will not inherit the kingdom of God.

GAL.5.22.t: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness,
s: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness,

GAL.5.23.t: gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.
s: gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.

GAL.5.24.t: Those who belong to Christ Jesus have crucified the flesh with its passions and desires.
s: Those who belong to Christ Jesus have crucified the flesh with its passions and desires.

GAL.5.25.t: Since we live by the Spirit, let us walk in step with the Spirit.
s: Since we live by the Spirit, let us walk in step with the Spirit.

GAL.5.26.t: Let us not become conceited, provoking and envying one another.
s: Let us not become conceited, provoking and envying one another.

GAL.6.1.t: Brothers, if someone is caught in a trespass, you who are spiritual should restore him with a spirit of gentleness. But watch yourself, or you also may be tempted.
s: Brothers, if someone is caught in a trespass, you who are spiritual should restore him with a spirit of gentleness. But watch yourself, or you also may be tempted.

GAL.6.2.t: Carry one another’s burdens, and in this way you will fulfill the law of Christ.
s: Carry one another’s burdens, and in this way you will fulfill the law of Christ.

GAL.6.3.t: If anyone thinks he is something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.
s: If anyone thinks he is something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.

GAL.6.4.t: Each one should test his own work. Then he will have reason to boast in himself alone, and not in someone else.
s: Each one should test his own work. Then he will have reason to boast in himself alone, and not in someone else.

GAL.6.5.t: For each one should carry his own load.
s: For each one should carry his own load.

GAL.6.6.t: Nevertheless, the one who receives instruction in the word must share in all good things with his instructor.
s: Nevertheless, the one who receives instruction in the word must share in all good things with his instructor.

GAL.6.7.t: Do not be deceived: God is not to be mocked. Whatever a man sows, he will reap in return.
s: Do not be deceived: God is not to be mocked. Whatever a man sows, he will reap in return.

GAL.6.8.t: The one who sows to please his flesh, from the flesh will reap destruction; but the one who sows to please the Spirit, from the Spirit will reap eternal life.
s: The one who sows to please his flesh, from the flesh will reap destruction; but the one who sows to please the Spirit, from the Spirit will reap eternal life.

GAL.6.9.t: Let us not grow weary in well-doing, for in due time we will reap a harvest if we do not give up.
s: Let us not grow weary in well-doing, for in due time we will reap a harvest if we do not give up.

GAL.6.10.t: Therefore, as we have opportunity, let us do good to everyone, and especially to the family of faith.
s: Therefore, as we have opportunity, let us do good to everyone, and especially to the family of faith.

GEN.1.26.t: Then God said, “Let Us make man in Our image, after Our likeness, to rule over the fish of the sea and the birds of the air, over the livestock, and over all the earth itself and every creature that crawls upon it.”
s: Then God said, “Let Us make man in Our image, after Our likeness, to rule over the fish of the sea and the birds of the air, over the livestock, and over all the earth itself and every creature that crawls upon it.”

GEN.1.27.t: So God created man in His own image; in the image of God He created him; male and female He created them.
s: So God created man in His own image;
in the image of God He created him;
male and female He created them.

GEN.1.28.t: God blessed them and said to them, “Be fruitful and multiply, and fill the earth and subdue it; rule over the fish of the sea and the birds of the air and every creature that crawls upon the earth.”
s: God blessed them and said to them, “Be fruitful and multiply, and fill the earth and subdue it; rule over the fish of the sea and the birds of the air and every creature that crawls upon the earth.”

GEN.1.29.t: Then God said, “Behold, I have given you every seed-bearing plant on the face of all the earth, and every tree whose fruit contains seed. They will be yours for food.
s: Then God said, “Behold, I have given you every seed-bearing plant on the face of all the earth, and every tree whose fruit contains seed. They will be yours for food.

GEN.1.30.t: And to every beast of the earth and every bird of the air and every creature that crawls upon the earth—everything that has the breath of life in it—I have given every green plant for food.” And it was so.
s: And to every beast of the earth and every bird of the air and every creature that crawls upon the earth—everything that has the breath of life in it—I have given every green plant for food.” And it was so.

GEN.1.31.t: And God looked upon all that He had made, and indeed, it was very good. And there was evening, and there was morning—the sixth day.
s: And God looked upon all that He had made, and indeed, it was very good.
And there was evening, and there was morning—the sixth day.

GEN.2.8.t: And the LORD God planted a garden in Eden, in the east, where He placed the man He had formed.
s: And the LORD God planted a garden in Eden, in the east, where He placed the man He had formed.

GEN.2.9.t: Out of the ground the LORD God gave growth to every tree that is pleasing to the eye and good for food. And in the middle of the garden were the tree of life and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.
s: Out of the ground the LORD God gave growth to every tree that is pleasing to the eye and good for food. And in the middle of the garden were the tree of life and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.

GEN.2.10.t: Now a river flowed out of Eden to water the garden, and from there it branched into four headwaters:
s: Now a river flowed out of Eden to water the garden, and from there it branched into four headwaters:

GEN.2.11.t: The name of the first river is Pishon; it winds through the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold.
s: The name of the first river is Pishon; it winds through the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold.

GEN.2.12.t: And the gold of that land is pure, and bdellium and onyx are found there.
s: And the gold of that land is pure, and bdellium and onyx are found there.

GEN.2.13.t: The name of the second river is Gihon; it winds through the whole land of Cush.
s: The name of the second river is Gihon; it winds through the whole land of Cush.

GEN.2.14.t: The name of the third river is Hiddekel; it runs along the east side of Assyria. And the fourth river is the Euphrates.
s: The name of the third river is Hiddekel; it runs along the east side of Assyria.
And the fourth river is the Euphrates.

GEN.2.15.t: Then the LORD God took the man and placed him in the Garden of Eden to cultivate and keep it.
s: Then the LORD God took the man and placed him in the Garden of Eden to cultivate and keep it.

GEN.2.18.t: The LORD God also said, “It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make for him a suitable helper.”
s: The LORD God also said, “It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make for him a suitable helper.”

GEN.2.19.t: And out of the ground the LORD God formed every beast of the field and every bird of the air, and He brought them to the man to see what he would name each one. And whatever the man called each living creature, that was its name.
s: And out of the ground the LORD God formed every beast of the field and every bird of the air, and He brought them to the man to see what he would name each one. And whatever the man called each living creature, that was its name.

GEN.2.20.t: The man gave names to all the livestock, to the birds of the air, and to every beast of the field. But for Adam no suitable helper was found.
s: The man gave names to all the livestock, to the birds of the air, and to every beast of the field. But for Adam no suitable helper was found.

GEN.4.3.t: So in the course of time, Cain brought some of the fruit of the soil as an offering to the LORD,
s: So in the course of time, Cain brought some of the fruit of the soil as an offering to the LORD,

GEN.45.13.t: Tell my father about all my splendor in Egypt and everything you have seen. And bring my father down here quickly.”
s: Tell my father about all my splendor in Egypt and everything you have seen. And bring my father down here quickly.”

GEN.45.14.t: Then Joseph threw his arms around his brother Benjamin and wept, and Benjamin wept as they embraced.
s: Then Joseph threw his arms around his brother Benjamin and wept, and Benjamin wept as they embraced.

GEN.45.15.t: Joseph kissed each of his brothers as he wept over them. And afterward his brothers talked with him.
s: Joseph kissed each of his brothers as he wept over them. And afterward his brothers talked with him.

GEN.50.1.t: Then Joseph fell upon his father’s face, wept over him, and kissed him.
s: Then Joseph fell upon his father’s face, wept over him, and kissed him.

GEN.50.2.t: And Joseph directed the physicians in his service to embalm his father Israel. So they embalmed him,
s: And Joseph directed the physicians in his service to embalm his father Israel. So they embalmed him,

GEN.50.3.t: taking the forty days required to complete the embalming. And the Egyptians mourned for him seventy days.
s: taking the forty days required to complete the embalming. And the Egyptians mourned for him seventy days.

GEN.50.15.t: When Joseph’s brothers saw that their father was dead, they said, “What if Joseph bears a grudge? Then he will surely repay us for all the evil that we did to him.”
s: When Joseph’s brothers saw that their father was dead, they said, “What if Joseph bears a grudge? Then he will surely repay us for all the evil that we did to him.”

GEN.50.16.t: So they sent word to Joseph, saying, “Before he died, your father commanded,
s: So they sent word to Joseph, saying, “Before he died, your father commanded,

GEN.50.17.t: ‘This is what you are to say to Joseph: I beg you, please forgive the transgression and sin of your brothers, for they did you wrong.’ So now, Joseph, please forgive the transgression of the servants of the God of your father.” When their message came to him, Joseph wept.
s: ‘This is what you are to say to Joseph: I beg you, please forgive the transgression and sin of your brothers, for they did you wrong.’ So now, Joseph, please forgive the transgression of the servants of the God of your father.”
When their message came to him, Joseph wept.

GEN.50.18.t: His brothers also came to him, bowed down before him, and said, “We are your slaves!”
s: His brothers also came to him, bowed down before him, and said, “We are your slaves!”

GEN.50.19.t: But Joseph replied, “Do not be afraid. Am I in the place of God?
s: But Joseph replied, “Do not be afraid. Am I in the place of God?

GEN.50.20.t: As for you, what you intended against me for evil, God intended for good, in order to accomplish a day like this—to preserve the lives of many people.
s: As for you, what you intended against me for evil, God intended for good, in order to accomplish a day like this—to preserve the lives of many people.

GEN.50.21.t: Therefore do not be afraid. I will provide for you and your little ones.” So Joseph reassured his brothers and spoke kindly to them.
s: Therefore do not be afraid. I will provide for you and your little ones.” So Joseph reassured his brothers and spoke kindly to them.

HAB.3.16.t: I heard and trembled within; my lips quivered at the sound. Decay entered my bones; I trembled where I stood. Yet I must wait patiently for the day of distress to come upon the people who invade us.
s: I heard and trembled within;
my lips quivered at the sound.
Decay entered my bones;
I trembled where I stood.
Yet I must wait patiently for the day of distress
to come upon the people who invade us.

HAB.3.17.t: Though the fig tree does not bud and no fruit is on the vines, though the olive crop fails and the fields produce no food, though the sheep are cut off from the fold and no cattle are in the stalls,
s: Though the fig tree does not bud
and no fruit is on the vines,
though the olive crop fails
and the fields produce no food,
though the sheep are cut off from the fold
and no cattle are in the stalls,

HAB.3.18.t: yet I will exult in the LORD; I will rejoice in the God of my salvation!
s: yet I will exult in the LORD;
I will rejoice in the God of my salvation!

HAB.3.19.t: GOD the Lord is my strength; He makes my feet like those of a deer; He makes me walk upon the heights! For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments.
s: GOD the Lord is my strength;
He makes my feet like those of a deer;
He makes me walk upon the heights!
For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments.

HAG.2.1.t: On the twenty-first day of the seventh month, the word of the LORD came through Haggai the prophet, saying:
s: On the twenty-first day of the seventh month, the word of the LORD came through Haggai the prophet, saying:

HAG.2.2.t: “Speak to Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and also to the remnant of the people. Ask them,
s: “Speak to Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and also to the remnant of the people. Ask them,

HAG.2.3.t: ‘Who is left among you who saw this house in its former glory? How does it look to you now? Does it not appear to you like nothing in comparison?’
s: ‘Who is left among you who saw this house in its former glory? How does it look to you now? Does it not appear to you like nothing in comparison?’

HAG.2.4.t: But now be strong, O Zerubbabel, declares the LORD. Be strong, O Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest. And be strong, all you people of the land, declares the LORD. Work! For I am with you, declares the LORD of Hosts.
s: But now be strong, O Zerubbabel,
declares the LORD.
Be strong, O Joshua son of Jehozadak,
the high priest.
And be strong, all you people of the land,
declares the LORD.
Work! For I am with you,
declares the LORD of Hosts.

HAG.2.5.t: This is the promise I made to you when you came out of Egypt. And My Spirit remains among you; do not be afraid.”
s: This is the promise I made to you
when you came out of Egypt.
And My Spirit remains among you;
do not be afraid.”

HEB.2.14.t: Now since the children have flesh and blood, He too shared in their humanity, so that by His death He might destroy him who holds the power of death, that is, the devil,
s: Now since the children have flesh and blood, He too shared in their humanity, so that by His death He might destroy him who holds the power of death, that is, the devil,

HEB.2.15.t: and free those who all their lives were held in slavery by their fear of death.
s: and free those who all their lives were held in slavery by their fear of death.

HEB.2.16.t: For surely it is not the angels He helps, but the descendants of Abraham.
s: For surely it is not the angels He helps, but the descendants of Abraham.

HEB.2.17.t: For this reason He had to be made like His brothers in every way, so that He might become a merciful and faithful high priest in service to God, in order to make atonement for the sins of the people.
s: For this reason He had to be made like His brothers in every way, so that He might become a merciful and faithful high priest in service to God, in order to make atonement for the sins of the people.

HEB.2.18.t: Because He Himself suffered when He was tempted, He is able to help those who are being tempted.
s: Because He Himself suffered when He was tempted, He is able to help those who are being tempted.

HEB.4.12.t: For the word of God is living and active. Sharper than any double-edged sword, it pierces even to dividing soul and spirit, joints and marrow. It judges the thoughts and intentions of the heart.
s: For the word of God is living and active. Sharper than any double-edged sword, it pierces even to dividing soul and spirit, joints and marrow. It judges the thoughts and intentions of the heart.

HEB.4.13.t: Nothing in all creation is hidden from God’s sight; everything is uncovered and exposed before the eyes of Him to whom we must give account.
s: Nothing in all creation is hidden from God’s sight; everything is uncovered and exposed before the eyes of Him to whom we must give account.

HEB.4.14.t: Therefore, since we have a great high priest who has passed through the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold firmly to what we profess.
s: Therefore, since we have a great high priest who has passed through the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold firmly to what we profess.

HEB.4.15.t: For we do not have a high priest who is unable to sympathize with our weaknesses, but we have one who was tempted in every way that we are, yet was without sin.
s: For we do not have a high priest who is unable to sympathize with our weaknesses, but we have one who was tempted in every way that we are, yet was without sin.

HEB.4.16.t: Let us then approach the throne of grace with confidence, so that we may receive mercy and find grace to help us in our time of need.
s: Let us then approach the throne of grace with confidence, so that we may receive mercy and find grace to help us in our time of need.

HEB.5.11.t: We have much to say about this, but it is hard to explain, because you are dull of hearing.
s: We have much to say about this, but it is hard to explain, because you are dull of hearing.

HEB.5.12.t: Although by this time you ought to be teachers, you need someone to reteach you the basic principles of God’s word. You need milk, not solid food!
s: Although by this time you ought to be teachers, you need someone to reteach you the basic principles of God’s word. You need milk, not solid food!

HEB.5.13.t: For everyone who lives on milk is still an infant, inexperienced in the message of righteousness.
s: For everyone who lives on milk is still an infant, inexperienced in the message of righteousness.

HEB.5.14.t: But solid food is for the mature, who by constant use have trained their senses to distinguish good from evil.
s: But solid food is for the mature, who by constant use have trained their senses to distinguish good from evil.

HEB.10.19.t: Therefore, brothers, since we have confidence to enter the Most Holy Place by the blood of Jesus,
s: Therefore, brothers, since we have confidence to enter the Most Holy Place by the blood of Jesus,

HEB.10.20.t: by the new and living way opened for us through the curtain of His body,
s: by the new and living way opened for us through the curtain of His body,

HEB.10.21.t: and since we have a great priest over the house of God,
s: and since we have a great priest over the house of God,

HEB.10.22.t: let us draw near with a sincere heart in full assurance of faith, having our hearts sprinkled to cleanse us from a guilty conscience and our bodies washed with pure water.
s: let us draw near with a sincere heart in full assurance of faith, having our hearts sprinkled to cleanse us from a guilty conscience and our bodies washed with pure water.

HEB.10.23.t: Let us hold resolutely to the hope we profess, for He who promised is faithful.
s: Let us hold resolutely to the hope we profess, for He who promised is faithful.

HEB.10.24.t: And let us consider how to spur one another on to love and good deeds.
s: And let us consider how to spur one another on to love and good deeds.

HEB.10.25.t: Let us not neglect meeting together, as some have made a habit, but let us encourage one another, and all the more as you see the Day approaching.
s: Let us not neglect meeting together, as some have made a habit, but let us encourage one another, and all the more as you see the Day approaching.

HEB.11.8.t: By faith Abraham, when called to go to a place he would later receive as his inheritance, obeyed and went, without knowing where he was going.
s: By faith Abraham, when called to go to a place he would later receive as his inheritance, obeyed and went, without knowing where he was going.

HEB.11.9.t: By faith he dwelt in the promised land as a stranger in a foreign country. He lived in tents, as did Isaac and Jacob, who were heirs with him of the same promise.
s: By faith he dwelt in the promised land as a stranger in a foreign country. He lived in tents, as did Isaac and Jacob, who were heirs with him of the same promise.

HEB.11.10.t: For he was looking forward to the city with foundations, whose architect and builder is God.
s: For he was looking forward to the city with foundations, whose architect and builder is God.

HEB.12.1.t: Therefore, since we are surrounded by such a great cloud of witnesses, let us throw off every encumbrance and the sin that so easily entangles, and let us run with endurance the race set out for us.
s: Therefore, since we are surrounded by such a great cloud of witnesses, let us throw off every encumbrance and the sin that so easily entangles, and let us run with endurance the race set out for us.

HEB.12.2.t: Let us fix our eyes on Jesus, the author and perfecter of our faith, who for the joy set before Him endured the cross, scorning its shame, and sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.
s: Let us fix our eyes on Jesus, the author and perfecter of our faith, who for the joy set before Him endured the cross, scorning its shame, and sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.

HEB.12.3.t: Consider Him who endured such hostility from sinners, so that you will not grow weary and lose heart.
s: Consider Him who endured such hostility from sinners, so that you will not grow weary and lose heart.
Continue in brotherly love.

HEB.13.2.t: Do not neglect to show hospitality to strangers, for by so doing some people have entertained angels without knowing it.
s: Do not neglect to show hospitality to strangers, for by so doing some people have entertained angels without knowing it.

HEB.13.3.t: Remember those in prison as if you were bound with them, and those who are mistreated as if you were suffering with them.
s: Remember those in prison as if you were bound with them, and those who are mistreated as if you were suffering with them.

HEB.13.4.t: Marriage should be honored by all and the marriage bed kept undefiled, for God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.
s: Marriage should be honored by all and the marriage bed kept undefiled, for God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.

HEB.13.5.t: Keep your lives free from the love of money and be content with what you have, for God has said: “Never will I leave you, never will I forsake you.”
s: Keep your lives free from the love of money and be content with what you have, for God has said:
“Never will I leave you,
never will I forsake you.”

HEB.13.6.t: So we say with confidence: “The Lord is my helper; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?”
s: So we say with confidence:
“The Lord is my helper; I will not be afraid.
What can man do to me?”

HEB.13.7.t: Remember your leaders who spoke the word of God to you. Consider the outcome of their way of life and imitate their faith.
s: Remember your leaders who spoke the word of God to you. Consider the outcome of their way of life and imitate their faith.

HEB.13.8.t: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever.
s: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever.

HEB.13.9.t: Do not be carried away by all kinds of strange teachings, for it is good for the heart to be strengthened by grace and not by foods of no value to those devoted to them.
s: Do not be carried away by all kinds of strange teachings, for it is good for the heart to be strengthened by grace and not by foods of no value to those devoted to them.

ISA.6.1.t: In the year that King Uzziah died, I saw the Lord seated on a throne, high and exalted; and the train of His robe filled the temple.
s: In the year that King Uzziah died, I saw the Lord seated on a throne, high and exalted; and the train of His robe filled the temple.

ISA.6.2.t: Above Him stood seraphim, each having six wings: With two wings they covered their faces, with two they covered their feet, and with two they were flying.
s: Above Him stood seraphim, each having six wings: With two wings they covered their faces, with two they covered their feet, and with two they were flying.

ISA.6.3.t: And they were calling out to one another: “Holy, holy, holy is the LORD of Hosts; all the earth is full of His glory.”
s: And they were calling out to one another:
“Holy, holy, holy is the LORD of Hosts;
all the earth is full of His glory.”

ISA.6.4.t: At the sound of their voices the doorposts and thresholds shook, and the temple was filled with smoke.
s: At the sound of their voices the doorposts and thresholds shook, and the temple was filled with smoke.

ISA.6.5.t: Then I said: “Woe is me, for I am ruined, because I am a man of unclean lips dwelling among a people of unclean lips; for my eyes have seen the King, the LORD of Hosts.”
s: Then I said:
“Woe is me,
for I am ruined,
because I am a man of unclean lips
dwelling among a people of unclean lips;
for my eyes have seen the King,
the LORD of Hosts.”

ISA.6.6.t: Then one of the seraphim flew to me, and in his hand was a glowing coal that he had taken with tongs from the altar.
s: Then one of the seraphim flew to me, and in his hand was a glowing coal that he had taken with tongs from the altar.

ISA.6.7.t: And with it he touched my mouth and said: “Now that this has touched your lips, your iniquity is removed and your sin is atoned for.”
s: And with it he touched my mouth and said:
“Now that this has touched your lips,
your iniquity is removed
and your sin is atoned for.”

ISA.6.8.t: Then I heard the voice of the Lord saying: “Whom shall I send? Who will go for Us?” And I said: “Here am I. Send me!”
s: Then I heard the voice of the Lord saying:
“Whom shall I send?
Who will go for Us?”
And I said:
“Here am I. Send me!”

ISA.12.1.t: In that day you will say: “O LORD, I will praise You. Although You were angry with me, Your anger has turned away, and You have comforted me.
s: In that day you will say:
“O LORD, I will praise You.
Although You were angry with me,
Your anger has turned away,
and You have comforted me.

ISA.12.2.t: Surely God is my salvation; I will trust and not be afraid. For the LORD GOD is my strength and my song, and He also has become my salvation.”
s: Surely God is my salvation;
I will trust and not be afraid.
For the LORD GOD is my strength and my song,
and He also has become my salvation.”

ISA.12.3.t: With joy you will draw water from the springs of salvation,
s: With joy you will draw water from the springs of salvation,

ISA.12.4.t: and on that day you will say: “Give praise to the LORD; proclaim His name! Make His works known among the peoples; declare that His name is exalted.
s: and on that day you will say:
“Give praise to the LORD;
proclaim His name!
Make His works known among the peoples;
declare that His name is exalted.

ISA.12.5.t: Sing to the LORD, for He has done glorious things. Let this be known in all the earth.
s: Sing to the LORD, for He has done glorious things.
Let this be known in all the earth.

ISA.12.6.t: Cry out and sing, O citizen of Zion, for great among you is the Holy One of Israel.”
s: Cry out and sing, O citizen of Zion,
for great among you is the Holy One of Israel.”

ISA.25.1.t: O LORD, You are my God! I will exalt You; I will praise Your name. For You have worked wonders— plans formed long ago— in perfect faithfulness.
s: O LORD, You are my God!
I will exalt You;
I will praise Your name.
For You have worked wonders—
plans formed long ago—
in perfect faithfulness.

ISA.25.2.t: Indeed, You have made the city a heap of rubble, the fortified town a ruin. The fortress of strangers is a city no more; it will never be rebuilt.
s: Indeed, You have made the city a heap of rubble,
the fortified town a ruin.
The fortress of strangers is a city no more;
it will never be rebuilt.

ISA.25.3.t: Therefore, a strong people will honor You. The cities of ruthless nations will revere You.
s: Therefore, a strong people will honor You.
The cities of ruthless nations will revere You.

ISA.25.4.t: For You have been a refuge for the poor, a stronghold for the needy in distress, a refuge from the storm, a shade from the heat. For the breath of the ruthless is like rain against a wall,
s: For You have been a refuge for the poor,
a stronghold for the needy in distress,
a refuge from the storm,
a shade from the heat.
For the breath of the ruthless
is like rain against a wall,

ISA.25.5.t: like heat in a dry land. You subdue the uproar of foreigners. As the shade of a cloud cools the heat, so the song of the ruthless is silenced.
s: like heat in a dry land.
You subdue the uproar of foreigners.
As the shade of a cloud cools the heat,
so the song of the ruthless is silenced.

ISA.26.1.t: In that day this song will be sung in the land of Judah: We have a strong city; salvation is established as its walls and ramparts.
s: In that day this song will be sung in the land of Judah:
We have a strong city;
salvation is established as its walls and ramparts.

ISA.26.2.t: Open the gates so a righteous nation may enter— one that remains faithful.
s: Open the gates so a righteous nation may enter—
one that remains faithful.

ISA.26.3.t: You will keep in perfect peace the steadfast of mind, because he trusts in You.
s: You will keep in perfect peace the steadfast of mind,
because he trusts in You.

ISA.26.4.t: Trust in the LORD forever, because GOD the LORD is the Rock eternal.
s: Trust in the LORD forever,
because GOD the LORD is the Rock eternal.

ISA.26.5.t: For He has humbled those who dwell on high; He lays the lofty city low. He brings it down to the ground; He casts it into the dust.
s: For He has humbled those who dwell on high;
He lays the lofty city low.
He brings it down to the ground;
He casts it into the dust.

ISA.26.6.t: Feet trample it down— the feet of the oppressed, the steps of the poor.
s: Feet trample it down—
the feet of the oppressed,
the steps of the poor.

ISA.26.7.t: The path of the righteous is level; You clear a straight path for the upright.
s: The path of the righteous is level;
You clear a straight path for the upright.

ISA.26.8.t: Yes, we wait for You, O LORD; we walk in the path of Your judgments. Your name and renown are the desire of our souls.
s: Yes, we wait for You, O LORD;
we walk in the path of Your judgments.
Your name and renown
are the desire of our souls.

ISA.26.9.t: My soul longs for You in the night; indeed, my spirit seeks You at dawn. For when Your judgments come upon the earth, the people of the world learn righteousness.
s: My soul longs for You in the night;
indeed, my spirit seeks You at dawn.
For when Your judgments come upon the earth,
the people of the world learn righteousness.

ISA.28.23.t: Listen and hear my voice. Pay attention and hear what I say.
s: Listen and hear my voice.
Pay attention and hear what I say.

ISA.28.24.t: Does the plowman plow for planting every day? Does he continuously loosen and harrow the soil?
s: Does the plowman plow for planting every day?
Does he continuously loosen and harrow the soil?

ISA.28.25.t: When he has leveled its surface, does he not sow caraway and scatter cumin? He plants wheat in rows and barley in plots, and rye within its border.
s: When he has leveled its surface,
does he not sow caraway and scatter cumin?
He plants wheat in rows and barley in plots,
and rye within its border.

ISA.28.26.t: For his God instructs and teaches him properly.
s: For his God instructs
and teaches him properly.

ISA.28.27.t: Surely caraway is not threshed with a sledge, and the wheel of a cart is not rolled over the cumin. But caraway is beaten out with a stick, and cumin with a rod.
s: Surely caraway is not threshed with a sledge,
and the wheel of a cart is not rolled over the cumin.
But caraway is beaten out with a stick,
and cumin with a rod.

ISA.28.28.t: Grain for bread must be ground, but it is not endlessly threshed. Though the wheels of the cart roll over it, the horses do not crush it.
s: Grain for bread must be ground,
but it is not endlessly threshed.
Though the wheels of the cart roll over it,
the horses do not crush it.

ISA.28.29.t: This also comes from the LORD of Hosts, who is wonderful in counsel and excellent in wisdom.
s: This also comes from the LORD of Hosts,
who is wonderful in counsel
and excellent in wisdom.

ISA.30.15.t: For the Lord GOD, the Holy One of Israel, has said: “By repentance and rest you would be saved; your strength would lie in quiet confidence— but you were not willing.”
s: For the Lord GOD, the Holy One of Israel, has said:
“By repentance and rest
you would be saved;
your strength would lie in quiet confidence—
but you were not willing.”

ISA.30.16.t: “No,” you say, “we will flee on horses.” Therefore you will flee! “We will ride swift horses,” but your pursuers will be faster.
s: “No,” you say, “we will flee on horses.”
Therefore you will flee!
“We will ride swift horses,”
but your pursuers will be faster.

ISA.30.17.t: A thousand will flee at the threat of one; at the threat of five you will all flee, until you are left alone like a pole on a mountaintop, like a banner on a hill.
s: A thousand will flee at the threat of one;
at the threat of five you will all flee,
until you are left alone like a pole on a mountaintop,
like a banner on a hill.

ISA.30.18.t: Therefore the LORD longs to be gracious to you; therefore He rises to show you compassion, for the LORD is a just God. Blessed are all who wait for Him.
s: Therefore the LORD longs to be gracious to you;
therefore He rises to show you compassion,
for the LORD is a just God.
Blessed are all who wait for Him.

ISA.30.19.t: O people in Zion who dwell in Jerusalem, you will weep no more. He will surely be gracious when you cry for help; when He hears, He will answer you.
s: O people in Zion who dwell in Jerusalem, you will weep no more. He will surely be gracious when you cry for help; when He hears, He will answer you.

ISA.30.20.t: The Lord will give you the bread of adversity and the water of affliction, but your Teacher will no longer hide Himself—with your own eyes you will see Him.
s: The Lord will give you the bread of adversity and the water of affliction, but your Teacher will no longer hide Himself—with your own eyes you will see Him.

ISA.30.21.t: And whether you turn to the right or to the left, your ears will hear this command behind you: “This is the way. Walk in it.”
s: And whether you turn to the right or to the left, your ears will hear this command behind you: “This is the way. Walk in it.”

ISA.32.15.t: until the Spirit is poured out upon us from on high. Then the desert will be an orchard, and the orchard will seem like a forest.
s: until the Spirit is poured out
upon us from on high.
Then the desert will be an orchard,
and the orchard will seem like a forest.

ISA.32.16.t: Then justice will inhabit the wilderness, and righteousness will dwell in the fertile field.
s: Then justice will inhabit the wilderness,
and righteousness will dwell in the fertile field.

ISA.32.17.t: The work of righteousness will be peace; the service of righteousness will be quiet confidence forever.
s: The work of righteousness will be peace;
the service of righteousness will be quiet confidence forever.

ISA.32.18.t: Then my people will dwell in a peaceful place, in safe and secure places of rest.
s: Then my people will dwell in a peaceful place,
in safe and secure places of rest.

ISA.33.2.t: O LORD, be gracious to us! We wait for You. Be our strength every morning and our salvation in time of trouble.
s: O LORD, be gracious to us!
We wait for You.
Be our strength every morning
and our salvation in time of trouble.

ISA.33.3.t: The peoples flee the thunder of Your voice; the nations scatter when You rise.
s: The peoples flee the thunder of Your voice;
the nations scatter when You rise.

ISA.33.4.t: Your spoil, O nations, is gathered as by locusts; like a swarm of locusts men sweep over it.
s: Your spoil, O nations, is gathered as by locusts;
like a swarm of locusts men sweep over it.

ISA.33.5.t: The LORD is exalted, for He dwells on high; He has filled Zion with justice and righteousness.
s: The LORD is exalted, for He dwells on high;
He has filled Zion with justice and righteousness.

ISA.33.6.t: He will be the sure foundation for your times, a storehouse of salvation, wisdom, and knowledge. The fear of the LORD is Zion’s treasure.
s: He will be the sure foundation for your times,
a storehouse of salvation, wisdom, and knowledge.
The fear of the LORD is Zion’s treasure.

ISA.35.1.t: The wilderness and the land will be glad; the desert will rejoice and blossom like a rose.
s: The wilderness and the land will be glad;
the desert will rejoice and blossom like a rose.

ISA.35.2.t: It will bloom profusely and rejoice with joy and singing. The glory of Lebanon will be given to it, the splendor of Carmel and Sharon. They will see the glory of the LORD, the splendor of our God.
s: It will bloom profusely
and rejoice with joy and singing.
The glory of Lebanon will be given to it,
the splendor of Carmel and Sharon.
They will see the glory of the LORD,
the splendor of our God.

ISA.35.3.t: Strengthen the limp hands and steady the feeble knees!
s: Strengthen the limp hands
and steady the feeble knees!

ISA.35.4.t: Say to those with anxious hearts: “Be strong, do not fear! Behold, your God will come with vengeance. With divine retribution He will come to save you.”
s: Say to those with anxious hearts:
“Be strong, do not fear!
Behold, your God will come with vengeance.
With divine retribution He will come to save you.”

ISA.35.5.t: Then the eyes of the blind will be opened and the ears of the deaf unstopped.
s: Then the eyes of the blind will be opened
and the ears of the deaf unstopped.

ISA.35.6.t: Then the lame will leap like a deer and the mute tongue will shout for joy. For waters will gush forth in the wilderness, and streams in the desert.
s: Then the lame will leap like a deer
and the mute tongue will shout for joy.
For waters will gush forth in the wilderness,
and streams in the desert.

ISA.35.7.t: The parched ground will become a pool, the thirsty land springs of water. In the haunt where jackals once lay, there will be grass and reeds and papyrus.
s: The parched ground will become a pool,
the thirsty land springs of water.
In the haunt where jackals once lay,
there will be grass and reeds and papyrus.

ISA.35.8.t: And there will be a highway called the Way of Holiness. The unclean will not travel it— only those who walk in the Way— and fools will not stray onto it.
s: And there will be a highway
called the Way of Holiness.
The unclean will not travel it—
only those who walk in the Way—
and fools will not stray onto it.

ISA.35.9.t: No lion will be there, and no vicious beast will go up on it. Such will not be found there, but the redeemed will walk upon it.
s: No lion will be there,
and no vicious beast will go up on it.
Such will not be found there,
but the redeemed will walk upon it.

ISA.35.10.t: So the redeemed of the LORD will return and enter Zion with singing, crowned with everlasting joy. Gladness and joy will overtake them, and sorrow and sighing will flee.
s: So the redeemed of the LORD will return
and enter Zion with singing,
crowned with everlasting joy.
Gladness and joy will overtake them,
and sorrow and sighing will flee.

ISA.40.6.t: A voice says, “Cry out!” And I asked, “What should I cry out?” “All flesh is like grass, and all its glory like the flowers of the field.
s: A voice says, “Cry out!”
And I asked, “What should I cry out?”
“All flesh is like grass,
and all its glory like the flowers of the field.

ISA.40.7.t: The grass withers and the flowers fall when the breath of the LORD blows on them; indeed, the people are grass.
s: The grass withers and the flowers fall
when the breath of the LORD blows on them;
indeed, the people are grass.

ISA.40.8.t: The grass withers and the flowers fall, but the word of our God stands forever.”
s: The grass withers and the flowers fall,
but the word of our God stands forever.”

ISA.40.9.t: Go up on a high mountain, O Zion, herald of good news. Raise your voice loudly, O Jerusalem, herald of good news. Lift it up, do not be afraid! Say to the cities of Judah, “Here is your God!”
s: Go up on a high mountain,
O Zion, herald of good news.
Raise your voice loudly,
O Jerusalem, herald of good news.
Lift it up,
do not be afraid!
Say to the cities of Judah,
“Here is your God!”

ISA.40.10.t: Behold, the Lord GOD comes with might, and His arm establishes His rule. His reward is with Him, and His recompense accompanies Him.
s: Behold, the Lord GOD comes with might,
and His arm establishes His rule.
His reward is with Him,
and His recompense accompanies Him.

ISA.40.11.t: He tends His flock like a shepherd; He gathers the lambs in His arms and carries them close to His heart. He gently leads the nursing ewes.
s: He tends His flock like a shepherd;
He gathers the lambs in His arms
and carries them close to His heart.
He gently leads the nursing ewes.

ISA.40.27.t: Why do you say, O Jacob, and why do you assert, O Israel, “My way is hidden from the LORD, and my claim is ignored by my God”?
s: Why do you say, O Jacob,
and why do you assert, O Israel,
“My way is hidden from the LORD,
and my claim is ignored by my God”?

ISA.40.28.t: Do you not know? Have you not heard? The LORD is the everlasting God, the Creator of the ends of the earth. He will not grow tired or weary; His understanding is beyond searching out.
s: Do you not know?
Have you not heard?
The LORD is the everlasting God,
the Creator of the ends of the earth.
He will not grow tired or weary;
His understanding is beyond searching out.

ISA.40.29.t: He gives power to the faint and increases the strength of the weak.
s: He gives power to the faint
and increases the strength of the weak.

ISA.40.30.t: Even youths grow tired and weary, and young men stumble and fall.
s: Even youths grow tired and weary,
and young men stumble and fall.

ISA.40.31.t: But those who wait upon the LORD will renew their strength; they will mount up with wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary, they will walk and not faint.
s: But those who wait upon the LORD will renew their strength;
they will mount up with wings like eagles;
they will run and not grow weary,
they will walk and not faint.

ISA.41.8.t: “But you, O Israel, My servant, Jacob, whom I have chosen, descendant of Abraham My friend—
s: “But you, O Israel, My servant,
Jacob, whom I have chosen,
descendant of Abraham My friend—

ISA.41.9.t: I brought you from the ends of the earth and called you from its farthest corners. I said, ‘You are My servant.’ I have chosen and not rejected you.
s: I brought you from the ends of the earth
and called you from its farthest corners.
I said, ‘You are My servant.’
I have chosen and not rejected you.

ISA.41.10.t: Do not fear, for I am with you; do not be afraid, for I am your God. I will strengthen you; I will surely help you; I will uphold you with My right hand of righteousness.
s: Do not fear, for I am with you;
do not be afraid, for I am your God.
I will strengthen you; I will surely help you;
I will uphold you with My right hand of righteousness.

ISA.41.11.t: Behold, all who rage against you will be ashamed and disgraced; those who contend with you will be reduced to nothing and will perish.
s: Behold, all who rage against you
will be ashamed and disgraced;
those who contend with you
will be reduced to nothing and will perish.

ISA.41.12.t: You will seek them but will not find them. Those who wage war against you will come to nothing.
s: You will seek them but will not find them.
Those who wage war against you will come to nothing.

ISA.41.13.t: For I am the LORD your God, who takes hold of your right hand and tells you: Do not fear, I will help you.
s: For I am the LORD your God,
who takes hold of your right hand
and tells you: Do not fear,
I will help you.

ISA.42.10.t: Sing to the LORD a new song— His praise from the ends of the earth— you who go down to the sea, and all that is in it, you islands, and all who dwell in them.
s: Sing to the LORD a new song—
His praise from the ends of the earth—
you who go down to the sea, and all that is in it,
you islands, and all who dwell in them.

ISA.42.11.t: Let the desert and its cities raise their voices; let the villages of Kedar cry aloud. Let the people of Sela sing for joy; let them cry out from the mountaintops.
s: Let the desert and its cities raise their voices;
let the villages of Kedar cry aloud.
Let the people of Sela sing for joy;
let them cry out from the mountaintops.

ISA.42.12.t: Let them give glory to the LORD and declare His praise in the islands.
s: Let them give glory to the LORD
and declare His praise in the islands.

ISA.42.13.t: The LORD goes forth like a mighty one; He stirs up His zeal like a warrior. He shouts; yes, He roars in triumph over His enemies:
s: The LORD goes forth like a mighty one;
He stirs up His zeal like a warrior.
He shouts; yes, He roars
in triumph over His enemies:

ISA.42.14.t: “I have kept silent from ages past; I have remained quiet and restrained. But now I will groan like a woman in labor; I will at once gasp and pant.
s: “I have kept silent from ages past;
I have remained quiet and restrained.
But now I will groan like a woman in labor;
I will at once gasp and pant.

ISA.42.15.t: I will lay waste the mountains and hills and dry up all their vegetation. I will turn the rivers into dry land and drain the marshes.
s: I will lay waste the mountains and hills
and dry up all their vegetation.
I will turn the rivers into dry land
and drain the marshes.

ISA.42.16.t: I will lead the blind by a way they did not know; I will guide them on unfamiliar paths. I will turn darkness into light before them and rough places into level ground. These things I will do for them, and I will not forsake them.
s: I will lead the blind by a way they did not know;
I will guide them on unfamiliar paths.
I will turn darkness into light before them
and rough places into level ground.
These things I will do for them,
and I will not forsake them.

ISA.43.1.t: Now this is what the LORD says— He who created you, O Jacob, and He who formed you, O Israel: “Do not fear, for I have redeemed you; I have called you by your name; you are Mine!
s: Now this is what the LORD says—
He who created you, O Jacob,
and He who formed you, O Israel:
“Do not fear, for I have redeemed you;
I have called you by your name; you are Mine!

ISA.43.2.t: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you; and when you go through the rivers, they will not overwhelm you. When you walk through the fire, you will not be scorched; the flames will not set you ablaze.
s: When you pass through the waters,
I will be with you;
and when you go through the rivers,
they will not overwhelm you.
When you walk through the fire,
you will not be scorched;
the flames will not set you ablaze.

ISA.43.3.t: For I am the LORD your God, the Holy One of Israel, your Savior; I give Egypt for your ransom, Cush and Seba in your place.
s: For I am the LORD your God,
the Holy One of Israel, your Savior;
I give Egypt for your ransom,
Cush and Seba in your place.

ISA.43.4.t: Because you are precious and honored in My sight, and because I love you, I will give men in exchange for you and nations in place of your life.
s: Because you are precious and honored in My sight,
and because I love you,
I will give men in exchange for you
and nations in place of your life.

ISA.43.5.t: Do not be afraid, for I am with you; I will bring your offspring from the east and gather you from the west.
s: Do not be afraid, for I am with you;
I will bring your offspring from the east
and gather you from the west.

ISA.43.6.t: I will say to the north, ‘Give them up!’ and to the south, ‘Do not hold them back!’ Bring My sons from afar, and My daughters from the ends of the earth—
s: I will say to the north, ‘Give them up!’
and to the south, ‘Do not hold them back!’
Bring My sons from afar,
and My daughters from the ends of the earth—

ISA.43.7.t: everyone called by My name and created for My glory, whom I have indeed formed and made.”
s: everyone called by My name and created for My glory,
whom I have indeed formed and made.”

ISA.43.16.t: Thus says the LORD, who makes a way in the sea and a path through the surging waters,
s: Thus says the LORD, who makes a way in the sea
and a path through the surging waters,

ISA.43.17.t: who brings out the chariots and horses, the armies and warriors together, to lie down, never to rise again; to be extinguished, snuffed out like a wick:
s: who brings out the chariots and horses,
the armies and warriors together,
to lie down, never to rise again;
to be extinguished, snuffed out like a wick:

ISA.43.18.t: “Do not call to mind the former things; pay no attention to the things of old.
s: “Do not call to mind the former things;
pay no attention to the things of old.

ISA.43.19.t: Behold, I am about to do something new; even now it is coming. Do you not see it? Indeed, I will make a way in the wilderness and streams in the desert.
s: Behold, I am about to do something new;
even now it is coming. Do you not see it?
Indeed, I will make a way in the wilderness
and streams in the desert.

ISA.43.20.t: The beasts of the field will honor Me, the jackals and the ostriches, because I provide water in the wilderness and rivers in the desert, to give drink to My chosen people.
s: The beasts of the field will honor Me,
the jackals and the ostriches,
because I provide water in the wilderness
and rivers in the desert,
to give drink to My chosen people.

ISA.43.21.t: The people I formed for Myself will declare My praise.
s: The people I formed for Myself
will declare My praise.

ISA.46.1.t: Bel crouches; Nebo cowers. Their idols weigh down beasts and cattle. The images you carry are burdensome, a load to the weary animal.
s: Bel crouches; Nebo cowers.
Their idols weigh down beasts and cattle.
The images you carry are burdensome,
a load to the weary animal.

ISA.46.2.t: The gods cower; they crouch together, unable to relieve the burden; but they themselves go into captivity.
s: The gods cower; they crouch together,
unable to relieve the burden;
but they themselves go into captivity.

ISA.46.3.t: “Listen to Me, O house of Jacob, all the remnant of the house of Israel, who have been sustained from the womb, carried along since birth.
s: “Listen to Me, O house of Jacob,
all the remnant of the house of Israel,
who have been sustained from the womb,
carried along since birth.

ISA.46.4.t: Even to your old age, I will be the same, and I will bear you up when you turn gray. I have made you, and I will carry you; I will sustain you and deliver you.
s: Even to your old age, I will be the same,
and I will bear you up when you turn gray.
I have made you, and I will carry you;
I will sustain you and deliver you.

ISA.49.13.t: Shout for joy, O heavens; rejoice, O earth; break forth in song, O mountains! For the LORD has comforted His people, and He will have compassion on His afflicted ones.
s: Shout for joy, O heavens; rejoice, O earth;
break forth in song, O mountains!
For the LORD has comforted His people,
and He will have compassion on His afflicted ones.

ISA.49.14.t: But Zion said, “The LORD has forsaken me; the Lord has forgotten me!”
s: But Zion said, “The LORD has forsaken me;
the Lord has forgotten me!”

ISA.49.15.t: “Can a woman forget her nursing child, or lack compassion for the son of her womb? Even if she could forget, I will not forget you!
s: “Can a woman forget her nursing child,
or lack compassion for the son of her womb?
Even if she could forget,
I will not forget you!

ISA.49.16.t: Behold, I have inscribed you on the palms of My hands; your walls are ever before Me.
s: Behold, I have inscribed you on the palms of My hands;
your walls are ever before Me.

ISA.50.4.t: The Lord GOD has given Me the tongue of discipleship, to sustain the weary with a word. He awakens Me morning by morning; He awakens My ear to listen as a disciple.
s: The Lord GOD has given Me
the tongue of discipleship,
to sustain the weary with a word.
He awakens Me morning by morning;
He awakens My ear to listen as a disciple.

ISA.50.5.t: The Lord GOD has opened My ears, and I have not been rebellious, nor have I turned back.
s: The Lord GOD has opened My ears,
and I have not been rebellious,
nor have I turned back.

ISA.50.6.t: I offered My back to those who struck Me, and My cheeks to those who tore out My beard. I did not hide My face from scorn and spittle.
s: I offered My back to those who struck Me,
and My cheeks to those who tore out My beard.
I did not hide My face from scorn and spittle.

ISA.50.7.t: Because the Lord GOD helps Me, I have not been disgraced; therefore I have set My face like flint, and I know that I will not be put to shame.
s: Because the Lord GOD helps Me,
I have not been disgraced;
therefore I have set My face like flint,
and I know that I will not be put to shame.

ISA.52.7.t: How beautiful on the mountains are the feet of those who bring good news, who proclaim peace, who bring good tidings, who proclaim salvation, who say to Zion, “Your God reigns!”
s: How beautiful on the mountains
are the feet of those who bring good news,
who proclaim peace, who bring good tidings,
who proclaim salvation,
who say to Zion, “Your God reigns!”

ISA.52.8.t: Listen! Your watchmen lift up their voices, together they shout for joy. For every eye will see when the LORD returns to Zion.
s: Listen! Your watchmen lift up their voices,
together they shout for joy.
For every eye will see
when the LORD returns to Zion.

ISA.52.9.t: Break forth in joy, sing together, O ruins of Jerusalem, for the LORD has comforted His people; He has redeemed Jerusalem.
s: Break forth in joy, sing together,
O ruins of Jerusalem,
for the LORD has comforted His people;
He has redeemed Jerusalem.

ISA.52.10.t: The LORD has bared His holy arm in the sight of all the nations; all the ends of the earth will see the salvation of our God.
s: The LORD has bared His holy arm
in the sight of all the nations;
all the ends of the earth will see
the salvation of our God.

ISA.52.11.t: Depart, depart, go out from there! Touch no unclean thing; come out from it, purify yourselves, you who carry the vessels of the LORD.
s: Depart, depart, go out from there!
Touch no unclean thing;
come out from it, purify yourselves,
you who carry the vessels of the LORD.

ISA.52.12.t: For you will not leave in a hurry nor flee in haste, for the LORD goes before you, and the God of Israel is your rear guard.
s: For you will not leave in a hurry
nor flee in haste,
for the LORD goes before you,
and the God of Israel is your rear guard.

ISA.53.1.t: Who has believed our message? And to whom has the arm of the LORD been revealed?
s: Who has believed our message?
And to whom has the arm of the LORD been revealed?

ISA.53.2.t: He grew up before Him like a tender shoot, and like a root out of dry ground. He had no stately form or majesty to attract us, no beauty that we should desire Him.
s: He grew up before Him like a tender shoot,
and like a root out of dry ground.
He had no stately form or majesty to attract us,
no beauty that we should desire Him.

ISA.53.3.t: He was despised and rejected by men, a man of sorrows, acquainted with grief. Like one from whom men hide their faces, He was despised, and we esteemed Him not.
s: He was despised and rejected by men,
a man of sorrows, acquainted with grief.
Like one from whom men hide their faces,
He was despised, and we esteemed Him not.

ISA.53.4.t: Surely He took on our infirmities and carried our sorrows; yet we considered Him stricken by God, struck down and afflicted.
s: Surely He took on our infirmities
and carried our sorrows;
yet we considered Him stricken by God,
struck down and afflicted.

ISA.53.5.t: But He was pierced for our transgressions, He was crushed for our iniquities; the punishment that brought us peace was upon Him, and by His stripes we are healed.
s: But He was pierced for our transgressions,
He was crushed for our iniquities;
the punishment that brought us peace was upon Him,
and by His stripes we are healed.

ISA.53.6.t: We all like sheep have gone astray, each one has turned to his own way; and the LORD has laid upon Him the iniquity of us all.
s: We all like sheep have gone astray,
each one has turned to his own way;
and the LORD has laid upon Him
the iniquity of us all.

ISA.54.7.t: “For a brief moment I forsook you, but with great compassion I will bring you back.
s: “For a brief moment I forsook you,
but with great compassion I will bring you back.

ISA.54.8.t: In a surge of anger I hid My face from you for a moment, but with everlasting kindness I will have compassion on you,” says the LORD your Redeemer.
s: In a surge of anger
I hid My face from you for a moment,
but with everlasting kindness I will have compassion on you,”
says the LORD your Redeemer.

ISA.54.9.t: “For to Me this is like the days of Noah, when I swore that the waters of Noah would never again cover the earth. So I have sworn that I will not be angry with you or rebuke you.
s: “For to Me this is like the days of Noah,
when I swore that the waters of Noah
would never again cover the earth.
So I have sworn that I will not be angry with you
or rebuke you.

ISA.54.10.t: Though the mountains may be removed and the hills may be shaken, My loving devotion will not depart from you, and My covenant of peace will not be broken,” says the LORD, who has compassion on you.
s: Though the mountains may be removed
and the hills may be shaken,
My loving devotion will not depart from you,
and My covenant of peace will not be broken,”
says the LORD, who has compassion on you.

JAS.1.2.t: Consider it pure joy, my brothers, when you encounter trials of many kinds,
s: Consider it pure joy, my brothers, when you encounter trials of many kinds,

JAS.1.3.t: because you know that the testing of your faith develops perseverance.
s: because you know that the testing of your faith develops perseverance.

JAS.1.4.t: Allow perseverance to finish its work, so that you may be mature and complete, not lacking anything.
s: Allow perseverance to finish its work, so that you may be mature and complete, not lacking anything.

JAS.1.5.t: Now if any of you lacks wisdom, he should ask God, who gives generously to all without finding fault, and it will be given to him.
s: Now if any of you lacks wisdom, he should ask God, who gives generously to all without finding fault, and it will be given to him.

JAS.1.6.t: But he must ask in faith, without doubting, because he who doubts is like a wave of the sea, blown and tossed by the wind.
s: But he must ask in faith, without doubting, because he who doubts is like a wave of the sea, blown and tossed by the wind.

JAS.1.7.t: That man should not expect to receive anything from the Lord.
s: That man should not expect to receive anything from the Lord.

JAS.1.8.t: He is a double-minded man, unstable in all his ways.
s: He is a double-minded man, unstable in all his ways.

JAS.1.12.t: Blessed is the man who perseveres under trial, because when he has stood the test, he will receive the crown of life that God has promised to those who love Him.
s: Blessed is the man who perseveres under trial, because when he has stood the test, he will receive the crown of life that God has promised to those who love Him.

JAS.1.13.t: When tempted, no one should say, “God is tempting me.” For God cannot be tempted by evil, nor does He tempt anyone.
s: When tempted, no one should say, “God is tempting me.” For God cannot be tempted by evil, nor does He tempt anyone.

JAS.1.14.t: But each one is tempted when by his own evil desires he is lured away and enticed.
s: But each one is tempted when by his own evil desires he is lured away and enticed.

JAS.1.15.t: Then after desire has conceived, it gives birth to sin; and sin, when it is full-grown, gives birth to death.
s: Then after desire has conceived, it gives birth to sin; and sin, when it is full-grown, gives birth to death.

JAS.1.16.t: Do not be deceived, my beloved brothers.
s: Do not be deceived, my beloved brothers.

JAS.1.17.t: Every good and perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of the heavenly lights, with whom there is no change or shifting shadow.
s: Every good and perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of the heavenly lights, with whom there is no change or shifting shadow.

JAS.1.18.t: He chose to give us birth through the word of truth, that we would be a kind of firstfruits of His creation.
s: He chose to give us birth through the word of truth, that we would be a kind of firstfruits of His creation.

JAS.1.19.t: My beloved brothers, understand this: Everyone should be quick to listen, slow to speak, and slow to anger,
s: My beloved brothers, understand this: Everyone should be quick to listen, slow to speak, and slow to anger,

JAS.1.20.t: for man’s anger does not bring about the righteousness that God desires.
s: for man’s anger does not bring about the righteousness that God desires.

JAS.1.21.t: Therefore, get rid of all moral filth and every expression of evil, and humbly accept the word planted in you, which can save your souls.
s: Therefore, get rid of all moral filth and every expression of evil, and humbly accept the word planted in you, which can save your souls.

JAS.1.22.t: Be doers of the word, and not hearers only. Otherwise, you are deceiving yourselves.
s: Be doers of the word, and not hearers only. Otherwise, you are deceiving yourselves.

JAS.1.23.t: For anyone who hears the word but does not carry it out is like a man who looks at his face in a mirror,
s: For anyone who hears the word but does not carry it out is like a man who looks at his face in a mirror,

JAS.1.24.t: and after observing himself goes away and immediately forgets what he looks like.
s: and after observing himself goes away and immediately forgets what he looks like.

JAS.1.25.t: But the one who looks intently into the perfect law of freedom, and continues to do so—not being a forgetful hearer, but an effective doer—he will be blessed in what he does.
s: But the one who looks intently into the perfect law of freedom, and continues to do so—not being a forgetful hearer, but an effective doer—he will be blessed in what he does.

JAS.1.26.t: If anyone considers himself religious and yet does not bridle his tongue, he deceives his heart and his religion is worthless.
s: If anyone considers himself religious and yet does not bridle his tongue, he deceives his heart and his religion is worthless.

JAS.1.27.t: Pure and undefiled religion before our God and Father is this: to care for orphans and widows in their distress, and to keep oneself from being polluted by the world.
s: Pure and undefiled religion before our God and Father is this: to care for orphans and widows in their distress, and to keep oneself from being polluted by the world.

JAS.3.13.t: Who is wise and understanding among you? Let him show it by his good conduct, by deeds done in the humility that comes from wisdom.
s: Who is wise and understanding among you? Let him show it by his good conduct, by deeds done in the humility that comes from wisdom.

JAS.3.14.t: But if you harbor bitter jealousy and selfish ambition in your hearts, do not boast in it or deny the truth.
s: But if you harbor bitter jealousy and selfish ambition in your hearts, do not boast in it or deny the truth.

JAS.3.15.t: Such wisdom does not come from above, but is earthly, unspiritual, demonic.
s: Such wisdom does not come from above, but is earthly, unspiritual, demonic.

JAS.3.16.t: For where jealousy and selfish ambition exist, there will be disorder and every evil practice.
s: For where jealousy and selfish ambition exist, there will be disorder and every evil practice.

JAS.3.17.t: But the wisdom from above is first of all pure, then peace-loving, gentle, accommodating, full of mercy and good fruit, impartial, and sincere.
s: But the wisdom from above is first of all pure, then peace-loving, gentle, accommodating, full of mercy and good fruit, impartial, and sincere.

JAS.3.18.t: Peacemakers who sow in peace reap the fruit of righteousness.
s: Peacemakers who sow in peace reap the fruit of righteousness.

JAS.4.1.t: What causes conflicts and quarrels among you? Don’t they come from the passions at war within you?
s: What causes conflicts and quarrels among you? Don’t they come from the passions at war within you?

JAS.4.2.t: You crave what you do not have; you kill and covet, but are unable to obtain it. You quarrel and fight. You do not have, because you do not ask.
s: You crave what you do not have; you kill and covet, but are unable to obtain it. You quarrel and fight. You do not have, because you do not ask.

JAS.4.3.t: And when you do ask, you do not receive, because you ask with wrong motives, that you may squander it on your pleasures.
s: And when you do ask, you do not receive, because you ask with wrong motives, that you may squander it on your pleasures.

JAS.4.4.t: You adulteresses! Do you not know that friendship with the world is hostility toward God? Therefore, whoever chooses to be a friend of the world renders himself an enemy of God.
