s: You adulteresses! Do you not know that friendship with the world is hostility toward God? Therefore, whoever chooses to be a friend of the world renders himself an enemy of God.

JAS.4.5.t: Or do you think the Scripture says without reason that the Spirit He caused to dwell in us yearns with envy?
s: Or do you think the Scripture says without reason that the Spirit He caused to dwell in us yearns with envy?

JAS.4.6.t: But He gives us more grace. This is why it says: “God opposes the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
s: But He gives us more grace. This is why it says:
“God opposes the proud,
but gives grace to the humble.”

JAS.4.7.t: Submit yourselves, then, to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
s: Submit yourselves, then, to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

JAS.4.8.t: Draw near to God, and He will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners, and purify your hearts, you double-minded.
s: Draw near to God, and He will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners, and purify your hearts, you double-minded.

JAS.4.9.t: Grieve, mourn, and weep. Turn your laughter to mourning, and your joy to gloom.
s: Grieve, mourn, and weep. Turn your laughter to mourning, and your joy to gloom.

JAS.4.10.t: Humble yourselves before the Lord, and He will exalt you.
s: Humble yourselves before the Lord, and He will exalt you.

JDG.6.11.t: Then the angel of the LORD came and sat down under the oak in Ophrah that belonged to Joash the Abiezrite, where his son Gideon was threshing wheat in a winepress to hide it from the Midianites.
s: Then the angel of the LORD came and sat down under the oak in Ophrah that belonged to Joash the Abiezrite, where his son Gideon was threshing wheat in a winepress to hide it from the Midianites.

JDG.6.12.t: And the angel of the LORD appeared to Gideon and said, “The LORD is with you, O mighty man of valor.”
s: And the angel of the LORD appeared to Gideon and said, “The LORD is with you, O mighty man of valor.”

JDG.6.13.t: “Please, my Lord,” Gideon replied, “if the LORD is with us, why has all this happened to us? And where are all His wonders of which our fathers told us, saying, ‘Has not the LORD brought us up out of Egypt?’ But now the LORD has forsaken us and delivered us into the hand of Midian.”
s: “Please, my Lord,” Gideon replied, “if the LORD is with us, why has all this happened to us? And where are all His wonders of which our fathers told us, saying, ‘Has not the LORD brought us up out of Egypt?’ But now the LORD has forsaken us and delivered us into the hand of Midian.”

JDG.6.14.t: The LORD turned to him and said, “Go in the strength you have and save Israel from the hand of Midian. Am I not sending you?”
s: The LORD turned to him and said, “Go in the strength you have and save Israel from the hand of Midian. Am I not sending you?”

JDG.6.15.t: “Please, my Lord,” Gideon replied, “how can I save Israel? Indeed, my clan is the weakest in Manasseh, and I am the youngest in my father’s house.”
s: “Please, my Lord,” Gideon replied, “how can I save Israel? Indeed, my clan is the weakest in Manasseh, and I am the youngest in my father’s house.”

JDG.6.16.t: “Surely I will be with you,” the LORD replied, “and you will strike down all the Midianites as one man.”
s: “Surely I will be with you,” the LORD replied, “and you will strike down all the Midianites as one man.”

JER.1.4.t: The word of the LORD came to me, saying:
s: The word of the LORD came to me, saying:

JER.1.5.t: “Before I formed you in the womb I knew you, and before you were born I set you apart and appointed you as a prophet to the nations.”
s: “Before I formed you in the womb I knew you,
and before you were born I set you apart
and appointed you as a prophet to the nations.”

JER.1.6.t: “Ah, Lord GOD,” I said, “I surely do not know how to speak, for I am only a child!”
s: “Ah, Lord GOD,” I said, “I surely do not know how to speak, for I am only a child!”

JER.1.7.t: But the LORD told me: “Do not say, ‘I am only a child.’ For to everyone I send you, you must go, and all that I command you, you must speak.
s: But the LORD told me:
“Do not say,
‘I am only a child.’
For to everyone I send you,
you must go,
and all that I command you,
you must speak.

JER.1.8.t: Do not be afraid of them, for I am with you to deliver you,” declares the LORD.
s: Do not be afraid of them,
for I am with you to deliver you,”
declares the LORD.

JER.1.9.t: Then the LORD reached out His hand, touched my mouth, and said to me: “Behold, I have put My words in your mouth.
s: Then the LORD reached out His hand, touched my mouth, and said to me:
“Behold, I have put My words
in your mouth.

JER.1.10.t: See, I have appointed you today over nations and kingdoms to uproot and tear down, to destroy and overthrow, to build and plant.”
s: See, I have appointed you today
over nations and kingdoms
to uproot and tear down,
to destroy and overthrow,
to build and plant.”

JER.17.5.t: This is what the LORD says: “Cursed is the man who trusts in mankind, who makes the flesh his strength and turns his heart from the LORD.
s: This is what the LORD says:
“Cursed is the man who trusts in mankind,
who makes the flesh his strength
and turns his heart from the LORD.

JER.17.6.t: He will be like a shrub in the desert; he will not see when prosperity comes. He will dwell in the parched places of the desert, in a salt land where no one lives.
s: He will be like a shrub in the desert;
he will not see when prosperity comes.
He will dwell in the parched places of the desert,
in a salt land where no one lives.

JER.17.7.t: But blessed is the man who trusts in the LORD, whose confidence is in Him.
s: But blessed is the man who trusts in the LORD,
whose confidence is in Him.

JER.17.8.t: He is like a tree planted by the waters that sends out its roots toward the stream. It does not fear when the heat comes, and its leaves are always green. It does not worry in a year of drought, nor does it cease to produce fruit.
s: He is like a tree planted by the waters
that sends out its roots toward the stream.
It does not fear when the heat comes,
and its leaves are always green.
It does not worry in a year of drought,
nor does it cease to produce fruit.

JER.17.12.t: A glorious throne, exalted from the beginning, is the place of our sanctuary.
s: A glorious throne, exalted from the beginning,
is the place of our sanctuary.

JER.17.13.t: O LORD, the hope of Israel, all who abandon You will be put to shame. All who turn away will be written in the dust, for they have abandoned the LORD, the fountain of living water.
s: O LORD, the hope of Israel,
all who abandon You will be put to shame.
All who turn away will be written in the dust,
for they have abandoned the LORD,
the fountain of living water.

JER.17.14.t: Heal me, O LORD, and I will be healed; save me, and I will be saved, for You are my praise.
s: Heal me, O LORD, and I will be healed;
save me, and I will be saved,
for You are my praise.

JER.17.15.t: Behold, they keep saying to me, “Where is the word of the LORD? Let it come now!”
s: Behold, they keep saying to me,
“Where is the word of the LORD?
Let it come now!”

JER.17.16.t: But I have not run away from being Your shepherd; I have not desired the day of despair. You know that the utterance of my lips was spoken in Your presence.
s: But I have not run away from being Your shepherd;
I have not desired the day of despair.
You know that the utterance of my lips
was spoken in Your presence.

JER.17.17.t: Do not become a terror to me; You are my refuge in the day of disaster.
s: Do not become a terror to me;
You are my refuge in the day of disaster.

JER.29.1.t: This is the text of the letter that Jeremiah the prophet sent from Jerusalem to the surviving elders among the exiles and to the priests, the prophets, and all the others Nebuchadnezzar had carried into exile from Jerusalem to Babylon.
s: This is the text of the letter that Jeremiah the prophet sent from Jerusalem to the surviving elders among the exiles and to the priests, the prophets, and all the others Nebuchadnezzar had carried into exile from Jerusalem to Babylon.

JER.29.2.t: (This was after King Jeconiah, the queen mother, the court officials, the officials of Judah and Jerusalem, the craftsmen, and the metalsmiths had been exiled from Jerusalem.)
s: (This was after King Jeconiah, the queen mother, the court officials, the officials of Judah and Jerusalem, the craftsmen, and the metalsmiths had been exiled from Jerusalem.)

JER.29.3.t: The letter was entrusted to Elasah son of Shaphan and Gemariah son of Hilkiah, whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent to King Nebuchadnezzar in Babylon. It stated:
s: The letter was entrusted to Elasah son of Shaphan and Gemariah son of Hilkiah, whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent to King Nebuchadnezzar in Babylon. It stated:

JER.29.4.t: This is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says to all the exiles who were carried away from Jerusalem to Babylon:
s: This is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says to all the exiles who were carried away from Jerusalem to Babylon:

JER.29.5.t: “Build houses and settle down. Plant gardens and eat their produce.
s: “Build houses and settle down. Plant gardens and eat their produce.

JER.29.6.t: Take wives and have sons and daughters. Take wives for your sons and give your daughters in marriage, so that they too may have sons and daughters. Multiply there; do not decrease.
s: Take wives and have sons and daughters. Take wives for your sons and give your daughters in marriage, so that they too may have sons and daughters. Multiply there; do not decrease.

JER.29.7.t: Seek the prosperity of the city to which I have sent you as exiles. Pray to the LORD on its behalf, for if it prospers, you too will prosper.”
s: Seek the prosperity of the city to which I have sent you as exiles. Pray to the LORD on its behalf, for if it prospers, you too will prosper.”

JER.29.8.t: For this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: “Do not be deceived by the prophets and diviners among you, and do not listen to the dreams you elicit from them.
s: For this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: “Do not be deceived by the prophets and diviners among you, and do not listen to the dreams you elicit from them.

JER.29.9.t: For they are falsely prophesying to you in My name; I have not sent them, declares the LORD.”
s: For they are falsely prophesying to you in My name; I have not sent them, declares the LORD.”

JER.29.10.t: For this is what the LORD says: “When Babylon’s seventy years are complete, I will attend to you and confirm My promise to restore you to this place.
s: For this is what the LORD says: “When Babylon’s seventy years are complete, I will attend to you and confirm My promise to restore you to this place.

JER.29.11.t: For I know the plans I have for you, declares the LORD, plans to prosper you and not to harm you, to give you a future and a hope.
s: For I know the plans I have for you, declares the LORD, plans to prosper you and not to harm you, to give you a future and a hope.

JER.29.12.t: Then you will call upon Me and come and pray to Me, and I will listen to you.
s: Then you will call upon Me and come and pray to Me, and I will listen to you.

JER.29.13.t: You will seek Me and find Me when you search for Me with all your heart.
s: You will seek Me and find Me when you search for Me with all your heart.

JER.29.14.t: I will be found by you, declares the LORD, and I will restore you from captivity and gather you from all the nations and places to which I have banished you, declares the LORD. I will restore you to the place from which I sent you into exile.”
s: I will be found by you, declares the LORD, and I will restore you from captivity and gather you from all the nations and places to which I have banished you, declares the LORD. I will restore you to the place from which I sent you into exile.”

JER.31.1.t: “At that time,” declares the LORD, “I will be the God of all the families of Israel, and they will be My people.”
s: “At that time,” declares the LORD, “I will be the God of all the families of Israel, and they will be My people.”

JER.31.2.t: This is what the LORD says: “The people who survived the sword found favor in the wilderness when Israel went to find rest.”
s: This is what the LORD says:
“The people who survived the sword
found favor in the wilderness
when Israel went to find rest.”

JER.31.3.t: The LORD appeared to us in the past, saying: “I have loved you with an everlasting love; therefore I have drawn you with loving devotion.
s: The LORD appeared to us in the past, saying:
“I have loved you with an everlasting love;
therefore I have drawn you with loving devotion.

JER.31.4.t: Again I will build you, and you will be rebuilt, O Virgin Israel. Again you will take up your tambourines and go out in joyful dancing.
s: Again I will build you, and you will be rebuilt,
O Virgin Israel.
Again you will take up your tambourines
and go out in joyful dancing.

JER.31.5.t: Again you will plant vineyards on the hills of Samaria; the farmers will plant and enjoy the fruit.
s: Again you will plant vineyards on the hills of Samaria;
the farmers will plant and enjoy the fruit.

JER.31.6.t: For there will be a day when watchmen will call out on the hills of Ephraim, ‘Arise, let us go up to Zion, to the LORD our God!’”
s: For there will be a day when watchmen will call out
on the hills of Ephraim,
‘Arise, let us go up to Zion,
to the LORD our God!’”

JER.31.15.t: This is what the LORD says: “A voice is heard in Ramah, mourning and great weeping, Rachel weeping for her children, and refusing to be comforted, because they are no more.”
s: This is what the LORD says:
“A voice is heard in Ramah,
mourning and great weeping,
Rachel weeping for her children,
and refusing to be comforted,
because they are no more.”

JER.31.16.t: This is what the LORD says: “Keep your voice from weeping and your eyes from tears, for the reward for your work will come, declares the LORD. Then your children will return from the land of the enemy.
s: This is what the LORD says:
“Keep your voice from weeping
and your eyes from tears,
for the reward for your work will come,
declares the LORD.
Then your children will return
from the land of the enemy.

JER.31.17.t: So there is hope for your future, declares the LORD, and your children will return to their own land.
s: So there is hope for your future,
declares the LORD,
and your children will return
to their own land.

JER.31.18.t: I have surely heard Ephraim’s moaning: ‘You disciplined me severely, like an untrained calf. Restore me, that I may return, for You are the LORD my God.
s: I have surely heard Ephraim’s moaning:
‘You disciplined me severely,
like an untrained calf.
Restore me, that I may return,
for You are the LORD my God.

JER.31.19.t: After I returned, I repented; and after I was instructed, I struck my thigh in grief. I was ashamed and humiliated because I bore the disgrace of my youth.’
s: After I returned, I repented;
and after I was instructed, I struck my thigh in grief.
I was ashamed and humiliated
because I bore the disgrace of my youth.’

JER.31.20.t: Is not Ephraim a precious son to Me, a delightful child? Though I often speak against him, I still remember him. Therefore My heart yearns for him; I have great compassion for him,” declares the LORD.
s: Is not Ephraim a precious son to Me,
a delightful child?
Though I often speak against him,
I still remember him.
Therefore My heart yearns for him;
I have great compassion for him,”
declares the LORD.

JHN.1.9.t: The true Light who gives light to every man was coming into the world.
s: The true Light who gives light to every man was coming into the world.

JHN.1.10.t: He was in the world, and though the world was made through Him, the world did not recognize Him.
s: He was in the world, and though the world was made through Him, the world did not recognize Him.

JHN.1.11.t: He came to His own, and His own did not receive Him.
s: He came to His own, and His own did not receive Him.

JHN.1.12.t: But to all who did receive Him, to those who believed in His name, He gave the right to become children of God—
s: But to all who did receive Him, to those who believed in His name, He gave the right to become children of God—

JHN.1.13.t: children born not of blood, nor of the desire or will of man, but born of God.
s: children born not of blood, nor of the desire or will of man, but born of God.

JHN.1.35.t: The next day John was there again with two of his disciples.
s: The next day John was there again with two of his disciples.

JHN.1.36.t: When he saw Jesus walking by, he said, “Look, the Lamb of God!”
s: When he saw Jesus walking by, he said, “Look, the Lamb of God!”

JHN.1.37.t: And when the two disciples heard him say this, they followed Jesus.
s: And when the two disciples heard him say this, they followed Jesus.

JHN.1.38.t: Jesus turned and saw them following. “What do you want?” He asked. They said to Him, “Rabbi” (which means Teacher), “where are You staying?”
s: Jesus turned and saw them following. “What do you want?” He asked.
They said to Him, “Rabbi” (which means Teacher), “where are You staying?”

JHN.1.39.t: “Come and see,” He replied. So they went and saw where He was staying, and spent that day with Him. It was about the tenth hour.
s: “Come and see,” He replied. So they went and saw where He was staying, and spent that day with Him. It was about the tenth hour.

JHN.1.40.t: Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, was one of the two who heard John’s testimony and followed Jesus.
s: Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, was one of the two who heard John’s testimony and followed Jesus.

JHN.1.41.t: He first found his brother Simon and told him, “We have found the Messiah” (which is translated as Christ).
s: He first found his brother Simon and told him, “We have found the Messiah” (which is translated as Christ).

JHN.1.42.t: Andrew brought him to Jesus, who looked at him and said, “You are Simon son of John. You will be called Cephas” (which is translated as Peter).
s: Andrew brought him to Jesus, who looked at him and said, “You are Simon son of John. You will be called Cephas” (which is translated as Peter).
“How can this be?” Nicodemus asked.

JHN.3.10.t: “You are Israel’s teacher,” said Jesus, “and you do not understand these things?
s: “You are Israel’s teacher,” said Jesus, “and you do not understand these things?

JHN.3.11.t: Truly, truly, I tell you, we speak of what we know, and we testify to what we have seen, and yet you people do not accept our testimony.
s: Truly, truly, I tell you, we speak of what we know, and we testify to what we have seen, and yet you people do not accept our testimony.

JHN.3.12.t: If I have told you about earthly things and you do not believe, how will you believe if I tell you about heavenly things?
s: If I have told you about earthly things and you do not believe, how will you believe if I tell you about heavenly things?

JHN.3.13.t: No one has ascended into heaven except the One who descended from heaven—the Son of Man.
s: No one has ascended into heaven except the One who descended from heaven—the Son of Man.

JHN.3.14.t: Just as Moses lifted up the snake in the wilderness, so the Son of Man must be lifted up,
s: Just as Moses lifted up the snake in the wilderness, so the Son of Man must be lifted up,

JHN.3.15.t: that everyone who believes in Him may have eternal life.
s: that everyone who believes in Him may have eternal life.

JHN.3.16.t: For God so loved the world that He gave His one and only Son, that everyone who believes in Him shall not perish but have eternal life.
s: For God so loved the world that He gave His one and only Son, that everyone who believes in Him shall not perish but have eternal life.

JHN.3.17.t: For God did not send His Son into the world to condemn the world, but to save the world through Him.
s: For God did not send His Son into the world to condemn the world, but to save the world through Him.

JHN.3.26.t: So John’s disciples came to him and said, “Look, Rabbi, the One who was with you beyond the Jordan, the One you testified about—He is baptizing, and everyone is going to Him.”
s: So John’s disciples came to him and said, “Look, Rabbi, the One who was with you beyond the Jordan, the One you testified about—He is baptizing, and everyone is going to Him.”

JHN.3.27.t: John replied, “A man can receive only what is given him from heaven.
s: John replied, “A man can receive only what is given him from heaven.

JHN.3.28.t: You yourselves can testify that I said, ‘I am not the Christ, but am sent ahead of Him.’
s: You yourselves can testify that I said, ‘I am not the Christ, but am sent ahead of Him.’

JHN.3.29.t: The bride belongs to the bridegroom. The friend of the bridegroom stands and listens for him, and is overjoyed to hear the bridegroom’s voice. That joy is mine, and it is now complete.
s: The bride belongs to the bridegroom. The friend of the bridegroom stands and listens for him, and is overjoyed to hear the bridegroom’s voice. That joy is mine, and it is now complete.

JHN.3.30.t: He must increase; I must decrease.
s: He must increase; I must decrease.

JHN.4.4.t: Now He had to pass through Samaria.
s: Now He had to pass through Samaria.

JHN.4.5.t: So He came to a town of Samaria called Sychar, near the plot of ground that Jacob had given to his son Joseph.
s: So He came to a town of Samaria called Sychar, near the plot of ground that Jacob had given to his son Joseph.

JHN.4.6.t: Since Jacob’s well was there, Jesus, weary from His journey, sat down by the well. It was about the sixth hour.
s: Since Jacob’s well was there, Jesus, weary from His journey, sat down by the well. It was about the sixth hour.

JHN.4.7.t: When a Samaritan woman came to draw water, Jesus said to her, “Give Me a drink.”
s: When a Samaritan woman came to draw water, Jesus said to her, “Give Me a drink.”

JHN.4.8.t: (His disciples had gone into the town to buy food.)
s: (His disciples had gone into the town to buy food.)

JHN.4.9.t: “You are a Jew,” said the woman. “How can You ask for a drink from me, a Samaritan woman?” (For Jews do not associate with Samaritans.)
s: “You are a Jew,” said the woman. “How can You ask for a drink from me, a Samaritan woman?” (For Jews do not associate with Samaritans.)

JHN.4.10.t: Jesus answered, “If you knew the gift of God and who is asking you for a drink, you would have asked Him, and He would have given you living water.”
s: Jesus answered, “If you knew the gift of God and who is asking you for a drink, you would have asked Him, and He would have given you living water.”

JHN.5.5.t: One man there had been an invalid for thirty-eight years.
s: One man there had been an invalid for thirty-eight years.

JHN.5.6.t: When Jesus saw him lying there and realized that he had spent a long time in this condition, He asked him, “Do you want to get well?”
s: When Jesus saw him lying there and realized that he had spent a long time in this condition, He asked him, “Do you want to get well?”

JHN.5.7.t: “Sir,” the invalid replied, “I have no one to help me into the pool when the water is stirred. While I am on my way, someone else goes in before me.”
s: “Sir,” the invalid replied, “I have no one to help me into the pool when the water is stirred. While I am on my way, someone else goes in before me.”

JHN.5.8.t: Then Jesus told him, “Get up, pick up your mat, and walk.”
s: Then Jesus told him, “Get up, pick up your mat, and walk.”

JHN.5.9.t: Immediately the man was made well, and he picked up his mat and began to walk. Now this happened on the Sabbath day,
s: Immediately the man was made well, and he picked up his mat and began to walk.
Now this happened on the Sabbath day,

JHN.6.35.t: Jesus answered, “I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to Me will never hunger, and whoever believes in Me will never thirst.
s: Jesus answered, “I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to Me will never hunger, and whoever believes in Me will never thirst.

JHN.6.36.t: But as I stated, you have seen Me and still you do not believe.
s: But as I stated, you have seen Me and still you do not believe.

JHN.6.37.t: Everyone the Father gives Me will come to Me, and the one who comes to Me I will never drive away.
s: Everyone the Father gives Me will come to Me, and the one who comes to Me I will never drive away.

JHN.6.38.t: For I have come down from heaven, not to do My own will, but to do the will of Him who sent Me.
s: For I have come down from heaven, not to do My own will, but to do the will of Him who sent Me.

JHN.6.39.t: And this is the will of Him who sent Me, that I shall lose none of those He has given Me, but raise them up at the last day.
s: And this is the will of Him who sent Me, that I shall lose none of those He has given Me, but raise them up at the last day.

JHN.6.40.t: For it is My Father’s will that everyone who looks to the Son and believes in Him shall have eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.”
s: For it is My Father’s will that everyone who looks to the Son and believes in Him shall have eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.”

JHN.9.1.t: Now as Jesus was passing by, He saw a man blind from birth,
s: Now as Jesus was passing by, He saw a man blind from birth,

JHN.9.2.t: and His disciples asked Him, “Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind?”
s: and His disciples asked Him, “Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind?”

JHN.9.3.t: Jesus answered, “Neither this man nor his parents sinned, but this happened so that the works of God would be displayed in him.
s: Jesus answered, “Neither this man nor his parents sinned, but this happened so that the works of God would be displayed in him.

JHN.9.4.t: While it is daytime, we must do the works of Him who sent Me. Night is coming, when no one can work.
s: While it is daytime, we must do the works of Him who sent Me. Night is coming, when no one can work.

JHN.9.5.t: While I am in the world, I am the light of the world.”
s: While I am in the world, I am the light of the world.”

JHN.9.6.t: When Jesus had said this, He spit on the ground, made some mud, and applied it to the man’s eyes.
s: When Jesus had said this, He spit on the ground, made some mud, and applied it to the man’s eyes.

JHN.9.7.t: Then He told him, “Go, wash in the Pool of Siloam” (which means “Sent”). So the man went and washed, and came back seeing.
s: Then He told him, “Go, wash in the Pool of Siloam” (which means “Sent”). So the man went and washed, and came back seeing.

JHN.10.1.t: “Truly, truly, I tell you, whoever does not enter the sheepfold by the gate, but climbs in some other way, is a thief and a robber.
s: “Truly, truly, I tell you, whoever does not enter the sheepfold by the gate, but climbs in some other way, is a thief and a robber.

JHN.10.2.t: But the one who enters by the gate is the shepherd of the sheep.
s: But the one who enters by the gate is the shepherd of the sheep.

JHN.10.3.t: The gatekeeper opens the gate for him, and the sheep listen for his voice. He calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.
s: The gatekeeper opens the gate for him, and the sheep listen for his voice. He calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.

JHN.10.4.t: When he has brought out all his own, he goes on ahead of them, and his sheep follow him because they know his voice.
s: When he has brought out all his own, he goes on ahead of them, and his sheep follow him because they know his voice.

JHN.10.5.t: But they will never follow a stranger; in fact, they will flee from him because they do not recognize his voice.”
s: But they will never follow a stranger; in fact, they will flee from him because they do not recognize his voice.”

JHN.10.6.t: Jesus spoke to them using this illustration, but they did not understand what He was telling them.
s: Jesus spoke to them using this illustration, but they did not understand what He was telling them.

JHN.10.7.t: So He said to them again, “Truly, truly, I tell you, I am the gate for the sheep.
s: So He said to them again, “Truly, truly, I tell you, I am the gate for the sheep.

JHN.10.8.t: All who came before Me were thieves and robbers, but the sheep did not listen to them.
s: All who came before Me were thieves and robbers, but the sheep did not listen to them.

JHN.10.9.t: I am the gate. If anyone enters through Me, he will be saved. He will come in and go out and find pasture.
s: I am the gate. If anyone enters through Me, he will be saved. He will come in and go out and find pasture.

JHN.10.10.t: The thief comes only to steal and kill and destroy. I have come that they may have life, and have it in all its fullness.
s: The thief comes only to steal and kill and destroy. I have come that they may have life, and have it in all its fullness.

JHN.10.11.t: I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down His life for the sheep.
s: I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down His life for the sheep.

JHN.11.1.t: At this time a man named Lazarus was sick. He lived in Bethany, the village of Mary and her sister Martha.
s: At this time a man named Lazarus was sick. He lived in Bethany, the village of Mary and her sister Martha.

JHN.11.2.t: (Mary, whose brother Lazarus was sick, was to anoint the Lord with perfume and wipe His feet with her hair.)
s: (Mary, whose brother Lazarus was sick, was to anoint the Lord with perfume and wipe His feet with her hair.)

JHN.11.3.t: So the sisters sent word to Jesus, “Lord, the one You love is sick.”
s: So the sisters sent word to Jesus, “Lord, the one You love is sick.”

JHN.11.4.t: When Jesus heard this, He said, “This sickness will not end in death. No, it is for the glory of God, so that the Son of God may be glorified through it.”
s: When Jesus heard this, He said, “This sickness will not end in death. No, it is for the glory of God, so that the Son of God may be glorified through it.”

JHN.11.5.t: Now Jesus loved Martha and her sister and Lazarus.
s: Now Jesus loved Martha and her sister and Lazarus.

JHN.11.6.t: So on hearing that Lazarus was sick, He stayed where He was for two days,
s: So on hearing that Lazarus was sick, He stayed where He was for two days,

JHN.11.32.t: When Mary came to Jesus and saw Him, she fell at His feet and said, “Lord, if You had been here, my brother would not have died.”
s: When Mary came to Jesus and saw Him, she fell at His feet and said, “Lord, if You had been here, my brother would not have died.”

JHN.11.33.t: When Jesus saw her weeping, and the Jews who had come with her also weeping, He was deeply moved in spirit and troubled.
s: When Jesus saw her weeping, and the Jews who had come with her also weeping, He was deeply moved in spirit and troubled.

JHN.11.34.t: “Where have you put him?” He asked. “Come and see, Lord,” they answered.
s: “Where have you put him?” He asked.
“Come and see, Lord,” they answered.
Jesus wept.

JHN.11.36.t: Then the Jews said, “See how He loved him!”
s: Then the Jews said, “See how He loved him!”

JHN.11.37.t: But some of them asked, “Could not this man who opened the eyes of the blind also have kept Lazarus from dying?”
s: But some of them asked, “Could not this man who opened the eyes of the blind also have kept Lazarus from dying?”

JHN.13.1.t: It was now just before the Passover Feast, and Jesus knew that His hour had come to leave this world and return to the Father. Having loved His own who were in the world, He loved them to the very end.
s: It was now just before the Passover Feast, and Jesus knew that His hour had come to leave this world and return to the Father. Having loved His own who were in the world, He loved them to the very end.

JHN.13.2.t: The evening meal was underway, and the devil had already put into the heart of Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, to betray Jesus.
s: The evening meal was underway, and the devil had already put into the heart of Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, to betray Jesus.

JHN.13.3.t: Jesus knew that the Father had delivered all things into His hands, and that He had come from God and was returning to God.
s: Jesus knew that the Father had delivered all things into His hands, and that He had come from God and was returning to God.

JHN.13.4.t: So He got up from the supper, laid aside His outer garments, and wrapped a towel around His waist.
s: So He got up from the supper, laid aside His outer garments, and wrapped a towel around His waist.

JHN.13.5.t: After that, He poured water into a basin and began to wash the disciples’ feet and dry them with the towel that was around Him.
s: After that, He poured water into a basin and began to wash the disciples’ feet and dry them with the towel that was around Him.

JHN.13.6.t: He came to Simon Peter, who asked Him, “Lord, are You going to wash my feet?”
s: He came to Simon Peter, who asked Him, “Lord, are You going to wash my feet?”

JHN.13.7.t: Jesus replied, “You do not realize now what I am doing, but later you will understand.”
s: Jesus replied, “You do not realize now what I am doing, but later you will understand.”

JHN.13.8.t: “Never shall You wash my feet!” Peter told Him. Jesus answered, “Unless I wash you, you have no part with Me.”
s: “Never shall You wash my feet!” Peter told Him.
Jesus answered, “Unless I wash you, you have no part with Me.”

JHN.13.9.t: “Then, Lord,” Simon Peter replied, “not only my feet, but my hands and my head as well!”
s: “Then, Lord,” Simon Peter replied, “not only my feet, but my hands and my head as well!”

JHN.13.10.t: Jesus told him, “Whoever has already bathed needs only to wash his feet, and he will be completely clean. And you are clean, though not all of you.”
s: Jesus told him, “Whoever has already bathed needs only to wash his feet, and he will be completely clean. And you are clean, though not all of you.”

JHN.13.11.t: For He knew who would betray Him. That is why He said, “Not all of you are clean.”
s: For He knew who would betray Him. That is why He said, “Not all of you are clean.”

JHN.13.12.t: When Jesus had washed their feet and put on His outer garments, He reclined with them again and asked, “Do you know what I have done for you?
s: When Jesus had washed their feet and put on His outer garments, He reclined with them again and asked, “Do you know what I have done for you?

JHN.13.13.t: You call Me Teacher and Lord, and rightly so, because I am.
s: You call Me Teacher and Lord, and rightly so, because I am.

JHN.13.14.t: So if I, your Lord and Teacher, have washed your feet, you also should wash one another’s feet.
s: So if I, your Lord and Teacher, have washed your feet, you also should wash one another’s feet.

JHN.13.15.t: I have set you an example so that you should do as I have done for you.
s: I have set you an example so that you should do as I have done for you.

JHN.14.1.t: “Do not let your hearts be troubled. You believe in God; believe in Me as well.
s: “Do not let your hearts be troubled. You believe in God; believe in Me as well.

JHN.14.2.t: In My Father’s house are many rooms. If it were not so, would I have told you that I am going there to prepare a place for you?
s: In My Father’s house are many rooms. If it were not so, would I have told you that I am going there to prepare a place for you?

JHN.14.3.t: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come back and welcome you into My presence, so that you also may be where I am.
s: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come back and welcome you into My presence, so that you also may be where I am.

JHN.14.4.t: You know the way to the place where I am going.”
s: You know the way to the place where I am going.”

JHN.14.5.t: “Lord,” said Thomas, “we do not know where You are going, so how can we know the way?”
s: “Lord,” said Thomas, “we do not know where You are going, so how can we know the way?”

JHN.14.6.t: Jesus answered, “I am the way and the truth and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me.
s: Jesus answered, “I am the way and the truth and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me.

JHN.14.15.t: If you love Me, you will keep My commandments.
s: If you love Me, you will keep My commandments.

JHN.14.16.t: And I will ask the Father, and He will give you another Advocate to be with you forever—
s: And I will ask the Father, and He will give you another Advocate to be with you forever—

JHN.14.17.t: the Spirit of truth. The world cannot receive Him, because it neither sees Him nor knows Him. But you do know Him, for He abides with you and will be in you.
s: the Spirit of truth. The world cannot receive Him, because it neither sees Him nor knows Him. But you do know Him, for He abides with you and will be in you.

JHN.14.18.t: I will not leave you as orphans; I will come to you.
s: I will not leave you as orphans; I will come to you.

JHN.14.19.t: In a little while the world will see Me no more, but you will see Me. Because I live, you also will live.
s: In a little while the world will see Me no more, but you will see Me. Because I live, you also will live.

JHN.14.20.t: On that day you will know that I am in My Father, and you are in Me, and I am in you.
s: On that day you will know that I am in My Father, and you are in Me, and I am in you.

JHN.14.21.t: Whoever has My commandments and keeps them is the one who loves Me. The one who loves Me will be loved by My Father, and I will love him and reveal Myself to him.”
s: Whoever has My commandments and keeps them is the one who loves Me. The one who loves Me will be loved by My Father, and I will love him and reveal Myself to him.”

JHN.14.25.t: All this I have spoken to you while I am still with you.
s: All this I have spoken to you while I am still with you.

JHN.14.26.t: But the Advocate, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in My name, will teach you all things and will remind you of everything I have told you.
s: But the Advocate, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in My name, will teach you all things and will remind you of everything I have told you.

JHN.14.27.t: Peace I leave with you; My peace I give to you. I do not give to you as the world gives. Do not let your hearts be troubled; do not be afraid.
s: Peace I leave with you; My peace I give to you. I do not give to you as the world gives. Do not let your hearts be troubled; do not be afraid.

JHN.14.28.t: You heard Me say, ‘I am going away, and I am coming back to you.’ If you loved Me, you would rejoice that I am going to the Father, because the Father is greater than I.
s: You heard Me say, ‘I am going away, and I am coming back to you.’ If you loved Me, you would rejoice that I am going to the Father, because the Father is greater than I.

JHN.14.29.t: And now I have told you before it happens, so that when it does happen, you will believe.
s: And now I have told you before it happens, so that when it does happen, you will believe.

JHN.14.30.t: I will not speak with you much longer, for the prince of this world is coming, and he has no claim on Me.
s: I will not speak with you much longer, for the prince of this world is coming, and he has no claim on Me.

JHN.14.31.t: But I do exactly what the Father has commanded Me, so that the world may know that I love the Father. Get up! Let us go on from here.
s: But I do exactly what the Father has commanded Me, so that the world may know that I love the Father.
Get up! Let us go on from here.

JHN.15.9.t: As the Father has loved Me, so have I loved you. Remain in My love.
s: As the Father has loved Me, so have I loved you. Remain in My love.

JHN.15.10.t: If you keep My commandments, you will remain in My love, just as I have kept My Father’s commandments and remain in His love.
s: If you keep My commandments, you will remain in My love, just as I have kept My Father’s commandments and remain in His love.

JHN.15.11.t: I have told you these things so that My joy may be in you and your joy may be complete.
s: I have told you these things so that My joy may be in you and your joy may be complete.

JHN.15.12.t: This is My commandment, that you love one another as I have loved you.
s: This is My commandment, that you love one another as I have loved you.

JHN.15.13.t: Greater love has no one than this, that he lay down his life for his friends.
s: Greater love has no one than this, that he lay down his life for his friends.

JHN.15.14.t: You are My friends if you do what I command you.
s: You are My friends if you do what I command you.

JHN.15.15.t: No longer do I call you servants, for a servant does not understand what his master is doing. But I have called you friends, because everything I have learned from My Father I have made known to you.
s: No longer do I call you servants, for a servant does not understand what his master is doing. But I have called you friends, because everything I have learned from My Father I have made known to you.

JHN.15.16.t: You did not choose Me, but I chose you. And I appointed you to go and bear fruit—fruit that will remain—so that whatever you ask the Father in My name, He will give you.
s: You did not choose Me, but I chose you. And I appointed you to go and bear fruit—fruit that will remain—so that whatever you ask the Father in My name, He will give you.

JHN.15.17.t: This is My command to you: Love one another.
s: This is My command to you: Love one another.

JHN.16.20.t: Truly, truly, I tell you, you will weep and wail while the world rejoices. You will grieve, but your grief will turn to joy.
s: Truly, truly, I tell you, you will weep and wail while the world rejoices. You will grieve, but your grief will turn to joy.

JHN.16.21.t: A woman has pain in childbirth because her time has come; but when she brings forth her child, she forgets her anguish because of her joy that a child has been born into the world.
s: A woman has pain in childbirth because her time has come; but when she brings forth her child, she forgets her anguish because of her joy that a child has been born into the world.

JHN.16.22.t: So also you have sorrow now, but I will see you again and your hearts will rejoice, and no one will take away your joy.
s: So also you have sorrow now, but I will see you again and your hearts will rejoice, and no one will take away your joy.

JHN.16.23.t: In that day you will no longer ask Me anything. Truly, truly, I tell you, whatever you ask the Father in My name, He will give you.
s: In that day you will no longer ask Me anything. Truly, truly, I tell you, whatever you ask the Father in My name, He will give you.

JHN.16.24.t: Until now you have not asked for anything in My name. Ask and you will receive, so that your joy may be complete.
s: Until now you have not asked for anything in My name. Ask and you will receive, so that your joy may be complete.

JHN.16.28.t: I came from the Father and entered the world. In turn, I will leave the world and go to the Father.”
s: I came from the Father and entered the world. In turn, I will leave the world and go to the Father.”

JHN.16.29.t: His disciples said, “See, now You are speaking plainly and without figures of speech.
s: His disciples said, “See, now You are speaking plainly and without figures of speech.

JHN.16.30.t: Now we understand that You know all things and that You have no need for anyone to question You. Because of this, we believe that You came from God.”
s: Now we understand that You know all things and that You have no need for anyone to question You. Because of this, we believe that You came from God.”
“Do you finally believe?” Jesus replied.

JHN.16.32.t: “Look, an hour is coming and has already come when you will be scattered, each to his own home, and you will leave Me all alone. Yet I am not alone, because the Father is with Me.
s: “Look, an hour is coming and has already come when you will be scattered, each to his own home, and you will leave Me all alone. Yet I am not alone, because the Father is with Me.

JHN.16.33.t: I have told you these things so that in Me you may have peace. In the world you will have tribulation. But take courage; I have overcome the world!”
s: I have told you these things so that in Me you may have peace. In the world you will have tribulation. But take courage; I have overcome the world!”

JHN.17.11.t: I will no longer be in the world, but they are in the world, and I am coming to You. Holy Father, protect them by Your name, the name You gave Me, so that they may be one as We are one.
s: I will no longer be in the world, but they are in the world, and I am coming to You.
Holy Father, protect them by Your name, the name You gave Me, so that they may be one as We are one.

JHN.17.12.t: While I was with them, I protected and preserved them by Your name, the name You gave Me. Not one of them has been lost, except the son of destruction, so that the Scripture would be fulfilled.
s: While I was with them, I protected and preserved them by Your name, the name You gave Me. Not one of them has been lost, except the son of destruction, so that the Scripture would be fulfilled.

JHN.17.13.t: But now I am coming to You; and I am saying these things while I am in the world, so that they may have My joy fulfilled within them.
s: But now I am coming to You; and I am saying these things while I am in the world, so that they may have My joy fulfilled within them.

JHN.17.14.t: I have given them Your word and the world has hated them; for they are not of the world, just as I am not of the world.
s: I have given them Your word and the world has hated them; for they are not of the world, just as I am not of the world.

JHN.17.15.t: I am not asking that You take them out of the world, but that You keep them from the evil one.
s: I am not asking that You take them out of the world, but that You keep them from the evil one.

JHN.17.16.t: They are not of the world, just as I am not of the world.
s: They are not of the world, just as I am not of the world.

JHN.17.17.t: Sanctify them by the truth; Your word is truth.
s: Sanctify them by the truth; Your word is truth.

JHN.17.18.t: As You sent Me into the world, I have also sent them into the world.
s: As You sent Me into the world, I have also sent them into the world.

JHN.17.19.t: For them I sanctify Myself, so that they too may be sanctified by the truth.
s: For them I sanctify Myself, so that they too may be sanctified by the truth.

JHN.17.20.t: I am not asking on behalf of them alone, but also on behalf of those who will believe in Me through their message,
s: I am not asking on behalf of them alone, but also on behalf of those who will believe in Me through their message,

JHN.17.21.t: that all of them may be one, as You, Father, are in Me, and I am in You. May they also be in Us, so that the world may believe that You sent Me.
s: that all of them may be one, as You, Father, are in Me, and I am in You. May they also be in Us, so that the world may believe that You sent Me.

JHN.17.22.t: I have given them the glory You gave Me, so that they may be one as We are one—
s: I have given them the glory You gave Me, so that they may be one as We are one—

JHN.17.23.t: I in them and You in Me—that they may be perfectly united, so that the world may know that You sent Me and have loved them just as You have loved Me.
s: I in them and You in Me—that they may be perfectly united, so that the world may know that You sent Me and have loved them just as You have loved Me.

JHN.17.24.t: Father, I want those You have given Me to be with Me where I am, that they may see the glory You gave Me because You loved Me before the foundation of the world.
s: Father, I want those You have given Me to be with Me where I am, that they may see the glory You gave Me because You loved Me before the foundation of the world.

JHN.17.25.t: Righteous Father, although the world has not known You, I know You, and they know that You sent Me.
s: Righteous Father, although the world has not known You, I know You, and they know that You sent Me.

JHN.17.26.t: And I have made Your name known to them and will continue to make it known, so that the love You have for Me may be in them, and I in them.”
s: And I have made Your name known to them and will continue to make it known, so that the love You have for Me may be in them, and I in them.”

JHN.19.25.t: Near the cross of Jesus stood His mother and her sister, as well as Mary the wife of Clopas and Mary Magdalene.
s: Near the cross of Jesus stood His mother and her sister, as well as Mary the wife of Clopas and Mary Magdalene.

JHN.19.26.t: When Jesus saw His mother and the disciple whom He loved standing nearby, He said to His mother, “Woman, here is your son.”
s: When Jesus saw His mother and the disciple whom He loved standing nearby, He said to His mother, “Woman, here is your son.”

JHN.19.27.t: Then He said to the disciple, “Here is your mother.” So from that hour, this disciple took her into his home.
s: Then He said to the disciple, “Here is your mother.” So from that hour, this disciple took her into his home.

JHN.20.11.t: But Mary stood outside the tomb weeping. And as she wept, she bent down to look into the tomb,
s: But Mary stood outside the tomb weeping. And as she wept, she bent down to look into the tomb,

JHN.20.12.t: and she saw two angels in white sitting where the body of Jesus had lain, one at the head and the other at the feet.
s: and she saw two angels in white sitting where the body of Jesus had lain, one at the head and the other at the feet.

JHN.20.13.t: “Woman, why are you weeping?” they asked. “Because they have taken my Lord away,” she said, “and I do not know where they have put Him.”
s: “Woman, why are you weeping?” they asked.
“Because they have taken my Lord away,” she said, “and I do not know where they have put Him.”

JHN.20.14.t: When she had said this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing there; but she did not recognize that it was Jesus.
s: When she had said this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing there; but she did not recognize that it was Jesus.

JHN.20.15.t: “Woman, why are you weeping?” Jesus asked. “Whom are you seeking?” Thinking He was the gardener, she said, “Sir, if you have carried Him off, tell me where you have put Him, and I will get Him.”
s: “Woman, why are you weeping?” Jesus asked. “Whom are you seeking?”
Thinking He was the gardener, she said, “Sir, if you have carried Him off, tell me where you have put Him, and I will get Him.”

JHN.20.16.t: Jesus said to her, “Mary.” She turned and said to Him in Hebrew, “Rabboni!” (which means “Teacher”).
s: Jesus said to her, “Mary.”
She turned and said to Him in Hebrew, “Rabboni!” (which means “Teacher”).

JHN.20.17.t: “Do not cling to Me,” Jesus said, “for I have not yet ascended to the Father. But go and tell My brothers, ‘I am ascending to My Father and your Father, to My God and your God.’”
s: “Do not cling to Me,” Jesus said, “for I have not yet ascended to the Father. But go and tell My brothers, ‘I am ascending to My Father and your Father, to My God and your God.’”

JHN.20.18.t: Mary Magdalene went and announced to the disciples, “I have seen the Lord!” And she told them what He had said to her.
s: Mary Magdalene went and announced to the disciples, “I have seen the Lord!” And she told them what He had said to her.

JHN.20.24.t: Now Thomas called Didymus, one of the Twelve, was not with the disciples when Jesus came.
s: Now Thomas called Didymus, one of the Twelve, was not with the disciples when Jesus came.

JHN.20.25.t: So the other disciples told him, “We have seen the Lord!” But he replied, “Unless I see the nail marks in His hands, and put my finger where the nails have been, and put my hand into His side, I will never believe.”
s: So the other disciples told him, “We have seen the Lord!”
But he replied, “Unless I see the nail marks in His hands, and put my finger where the nails have been, and put my hand into His side, I will never believe.”

JHN.20.26.t: Eight days later, His disciples were once again inside with the doors locked, and Thomas was with them. Jesus came and stood among them and said, “Peace be with you.”
s: Eight days later, His disciples were once again inside with the doors locked, and Thomas was with them. Jesus came and stood among them and said, “Peace be with you.”

JHN.20.27.t: Then Jesus said to Thomas, “Put your finger here and look at My hands. Reach out your hand and put it into My side. Stop doubting and believe.”
s: Then Jesus said to Thomas, “Put your finger here and look at My hands. Reach out your hand and put it into My side. Stop doubting and believe.”

JHN.20.28.t: Thomas replied, “My Lord and my God!”
s: Thomas replied, “My Lord and my God!”

JHN.20.29.t: Jesus said to him, “Because you have seen Me, you have believed; blessed are those who have not seen and yet have believed.”
s: Jesus said to him, “Because you have seen Me, you have believed; blessed are those who have not seen and yet have believed.”

JHN.20.30.t: Jesus performed many other signs in the presence of His disciples, which are not written in this book.
s: Jesus performed many other signs in the presence of His disciples, which are not written in this book.

JHN.20.31.t: But these are written so that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that by believing you may have life in His name.
s: But these are written so that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that by believing you may have life in His name.

JHN.21.9.t: When they landed, they saw a charcoal fire there with fish on it, and some bread.
s: When they landed, they saw a charcoal fire there with fish on it, and some bread.

JHN.21.10.t: Jesus told them, “Bring some of the fish you have just caught.”
s: Jesus told them, “Bring some of the fish you have just caught.”

JHN.21.11.t: So Simon Peter went aboard and dragged the net ashore. It was full of large fish, 153, but even with so many, the net was not torn.
s: So Simon Peter went aboard and dragged the net ashore. It was full of large fish, 153, but even with so many, the net was not torn.

JHN.21.12.t: “Come, have breakfast,” Jesus said to them. None of the disciples dared to ask Him, “Who are You?” They knew it was the Lord.
s: “Come, have breakfast,” Jesus said to them. None of the disciples dared to ask Him, “Who are You?” They knew it was the Lord.

JHN.21.13.t: Jesus came and took the bread and gave it to them, and He did the same with the fish.
s: Jesus came and took the bread and gave it to them, and He did the same with the fish.

JHN.21.14.t: This was now the third time that Jesus appeared to the disciples after He was raised from the dead.
s: This was now the third time that Jesus appeared to the disciples after He was raised from the dead.

JHN.21.15.t: When they had finished eating, Jesus asked Simon Peter, “Simon son of John, do you love Me more than these?” “Yes, Lord,” he answered, “You know I love You.” Jesus replied, “Feed My lambs.”
s: When they had finished eating, Jesus asked Simon Peter, “Simon son of John, do you love Me more than these?”
“Yes, Lord,” he answered, “You know I love You.”
Jesus replied, “Feed My lambs.”

JHN.21.16.t: Jesus asked a second time, “Simon son of John, do you love Me?” “Yes, Lord,” he answered, “You know I love You.” Jesus told him, “Shepherd My sheep.”
s: Jesus asked a second time, “Simon son of John, do you love Me?”
“Yes, Lord,” he answered, “You know I love You.”
Jesus told him, “Shepherd My sheep.”

JHN.21.17.t: Jesus asked a third time, “Simon son of John, do you love Me?” Peter was deeply hurt that Jesus had asked him a third time, “Do you love Me?” “Lord, You know all things,” he replied. “You know I love You.” Jesus said to him, “Feed My sheep.
s: Jesus asked a third time, “Simon son of John, do you love Me?”
Peter was deeply hurt that Jesus had asked him a third time, “Do you love Me?”
“Lord, You know all things,” he replied. “You know I love You.”
Jesus said to him, “Feed My sheep.

JOB.2.7.t: So Satan went out from the presence of the LORD and infected Job with terrible boils from the soles of his feet to the crown of his head.
s: So Satan went out from the presence of the LORD and infected Job with terrible boils from the soles of his feet to the crown of his head.

JOB.2.8.t: And Job took a piece of broken pottery to scrape himself as he sat among the ashes.
s: And Job took a piece of broken pottery to scrape himself as he sat among the ashes.

JOB.2.9.t: Then Job’s wife said to him, “Do you still retain your integrity? Curse God and die!”
s: Then Job’s wife said to him, “Do you still retain your integrity? Curse God and die!”

JOB.2.10.t: “You speak as a foolish woman speaks,” he told her. “Should we accept from God only good and not adversity?” In all this, Job did not sin in what he said.
s: “You speak as a foolish woman speaks,” he told her. “Should we accept from God only good and not adversity?”
In all this, Job did not sin in what he said.

JOB.2.11.t: Now when Job’s three friends—Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite—heard about all this adversity that had come upon him, each of them came from his home, and they met together to go and sympathize with Job and comfort him.
s: Now when Job’s three friends—Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite—heard about all this adversity that had come upon him, each of them came from his home, and they met together to go and sympathize with Job and comfort him.

JOB.2.12.t: When they lifted up their eyes from afar, they could barely recognize Job. They began to weep aloud, and each man tore his robe and threw dust in the air over his head.
s: When they lifted up their eyes from afar, they could barely recognize Job. They began to weep aloud, and each man tore his robe and threw dust in the air over his head.

JOB.2.13.t: Then they sat on the ground with him for seven days and seven nights, but no one spoke a word to him because they saw how intense his suffering was.
s: Then they sat on the ground with him for seven days and seven nights, but no one spoke a word to him because they saw how intense his suffering was.

JOB.12.7.t: But ask the animals, and they will instruct you; ask the birds of the air, and they will tell you.
s: But ask the animals, and they will instruct you;
ask the birds of the air, and they will tell you.

JOB.12.8.t: Or speak to the earth, and it will teach you; let the fish of the sea inform you.
s: Or speak to the earth, and it will teach you;
let the fish of the sea inform you.

JOB.12.9.t: Which of all these does not know that the hand of the LORD has done this?
s: Which of all these does not know
that the hand of the LORD has done this?

JOB.12.10.t: The life of every living thing is in His hand, as well as the breath of all mankind.
s: The life of every living thing is in His hand,
as well as the breath of all mankind.
Job continued his discourse:

JOB.27.2.t: “As surely as God lives, who has deprived me of justice— the Almighty, who has embittered my soul—
s: “As surely as God lives, who has deprived me of justice—
the Almighty, who has embittered my soul—

JOB.27.3.t: as long as my breath is still within me and the breath of God remains in my nostrils,
s: as long as my breath is still within me
and the breath of God remains in my nostrils,

JOB.27.4.t: my lips will not speak wickedness, and my tongue will not utter deceit.
s: my lips will not speak wickedness,
and my tongue will not utter deceit.

JOB.27.5.t: I will never say that you are right; I will maintain my integrity until I die.
s: I will never say that you are right;
I will maintain my integrity until I die.

JOB.27.6.t: I will cling to my righteousness and never let go. As long as I live, my conscience will not accuse me.
s: I will cling to my righteousness and never let go.
As long as I live, my conscience will not accuse me.

JOB.33.1.t: “But now, O Job, hear my speech, and listen to all my words.
s: “But now, O Job, hear my speech,
and listen to all my words.

JOB.33.2.t: Behold, I will open my mouth; my address is on the tip of my tongue.
s: Behold, I will open my mouth;
my address is on the tip of my tongue.

JOB.33.3.t: My words are from an upright heart, and my lips speak sincerely what I know.
s: My words are from an upright heart,
and my lips speak sincerely what I know.

JOB.33.4.t: The Spirit of God has made me, and the breath of the Almighty gives me life.
s: The Spirit of God has made me,
and the breath of the Almighty gives me life.

JOB.33.5.t: Refute me if you can; prepare your case and confront me.
s: Refute me if you can;
prepare your case and confront me.

JOB.33.6.t: I am just like you before God; I was also formed from clay.
s: I am just like you before God;
I was also formed from clay.

JOB.33.7.t: Surely no fear of me should terrify you; nor will my hand be heavy upon you.
s: Surely no fear of me should terrify you;
nor will my hand be heavy upon you.

JON.3.1.t: Then the word of the LORD came to Jonah a second time:
s: Then the word of the LORD came to Jonah a second time:

JON.3.2.t: “Get up! Go to the great city of Nineveh and proclaim to it the message that I give you.”
s: “Get up! Go to the great city of Nineveh and proclaim to it the message that I give you.”

JON.3.3.t: This time Jonah got up and went to Nineveh, in accordance with the word of the LORD. Now Nineveh was an exceedingly great city, requiring a three-day journey.
s: This time Jonah got up and went to Nineveh, in accordance with the word of the LORD.
Now Nineveh was an exceedingly great city, requiring a three-day journey.

JON.3.4.t: On the first day of his journey, Jonah set out into the city and proclaimed, “Forty more days and Nineveh will be overturned!”
s: On the first day of his journey, Jonah set out into the city and proclaimed, “Forty more days and Nineveh will be overturned!”

JON.3.5.t: And the Ninevites believed God. They proclaimed a fast and dressed in sackcloth, from the greatest of them to the least.
s: And the Ninevites believed God. They proclaimed a fast and dressed in sackcloth, from the greatest of them to the least.

JON.4.1.t: Jonah, however, was greatly displeased, and he became angry.
s: Jonah, however, was greatly displeased, and he became angry.

JON.4.2.t: So he prayed to the LORD, saying, “O LORD, is this not what I said while I was still in my own country? This is why I was so quick to flee toward Tarshish. I knew that You are a gracious and compassionate God, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion—One who relents from sending disaster.
s: So he prayed to the LORD, saying, “O LORD, is this not what I said while I was still in my own country? This is why I was so quick to flee toward Tarshish. I knew that You are a gracious and compassionate God, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion—One who relents from sending disaster.

JON.4.3.t: And now, O LORD, please take my life from me, for it is better for me to die than to live.”
s: And now, O LORD, please take my life from me, for it is better for me to die than to live.”

JON.4.4.t: But the LORD replied, “Have you any right to be angry?”
s: But the LORD replied, “Have you any right to be angry?”

JON.4.5.t: Then Jonah left the city and sat down east of it, where he made himself a shelter and sat in its shade to see what would happen to the city.
s: Then Jonah left the city and sat down east of it, where he made himself a shelter and sat in its shade to see what would happen to the city.

JON.4.6.t: So the LORD God appointed a vine, and it grew up to provide shade over Jonah’s head to ease his discomfort, and Jonah was greatly pleased with the plant.
s: So the LORD God appointed a vine, and it grew up to provide shade over Jonah’s head to ease his discomfort, and Jonah was greatly pleased with the plant.

JON.4.7.t: When dawn came the next day, God appointed a worm that attacked the plant so that it withered.
s: When dawn came the next day, God appointed a worm that attacked the plant so that it withered.

JON.4.8.t: As the sun was rising, God appointed a scorching east wind, and the sun beat down on Jonah’s head so that he grew faint and wished to die, saying, “It is better for me to die than to live.”
s: As the sun was rising, God appointed a scorching east wind, and the sun beat down on Jonah’s head so that he grew faint and wished to die, saying, “It is better for me to die than to live.”

JON.4.9.t: Then God asked Jonah, “Have you any right to be angry about the plant?” “I do,” he replied. “I am angry enough to die!”
s: Then God asked Jonah, “Have you any right to be angry about the plant?”
“I do,” he replied. “I am angry enough to die!”

JON.4.10.t: But the LORD said, “You cared about the plant, which you neither tended nor made grow. It sprang up in a night and perished in a night.
s: But the LORD said, “You cared about the plant, which you neither tended nor made grow. It sprang up in a night and perished in a night.

JON.4.11.t: So should I not care about the great city of Nineveh, which has more than 120,000 people who cannot tell their right hand from their left, and many cattle as well?”
s: So should I not care about the great city of Nineveh, which has more than 120,000 people who cannot tell their right hand from their left, and many cattle as well?”

JOS.1.1.t: Now after the death of His servant Moses, the LORD spoke to Joshua son of Nun, Moses’ assistant, saying,
s: Now after the death of His servant Moses, the LORD spoke to Joshua son of Nun, Moses’ assistant, saying,

JOS.1.2.t: “Moses My servant is dead. Now therefore arise, you and all these people, and cross over the Jordan into the land that I am giving to the children of Israel.
s: “Moses My servant is dead. Now therefore arise, you and all these people, and cross over the Jordan into the land that I am giving to the children of Israel.

JOS.1.3.t: I have given you every place where the sole of your foot will tread, just as I promised to Moses.
s: I have given you every place where the sole of your foot will tread, just as I promised to Moses.

JOS.1.4.t: Your territory shall extend from the wilderness and Lebanon to the great River Euphrates—all the land of the Hittites—and west as far as the Great Sea.
s: Your territory shall extend from the wilderness and Lebanon to the great River Euphrates—all the land of the Hittites—and west as far as the Great Sea.

JOS.1.5.t: No one shall stand against you all the days of your life. As I was with Moses, so will I be with you; I will never leave you nor forsake you.
s: No one shall stand against you all the days of your life. As I was with Moses, so will I be with you; I will never leave you nor forsake you.

JOS.1.6.t: Be strong and courageous, for you shall give these people the inheritance of the land that I swore to their fathers I would give them.
s: Be strong and courageous, for you shall give these people the inheritance of the land that I swore to their fathers I would give them.

JOS.1.7.t: Above all, be strong and very courageous. Be careful to observe all the law that My servant Moses commanded you. Do not turn from it to the right or to the left, so that you may prosper wherever you go.
s: Above all, be strong and very courageous. Be careful to observe all the law that My servant Moses commanded you. Do not turn from it to the right or to the left, so that you may prosper wherever you go.

JOS.1.8.t: This Book of the Law must not depart from your mouth; meditate on it day and night, so that you may be careful to do everything written in it. For then you will prosper and succeed in all you do.
s: This Book of the Law must not depart from your mouth; meditate on it day and night, so that you may be careful to do everything written in it. For then you will prosper and succeed in all you do.

JOS.1.9.t: Have I not commanded you to be strong and courageous? Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged, for the LORD your God is with you wherever you go.”
s: Have I not commanded you to be strong and courageous? Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged, for the LORD your God is with you wherever you go.”

JOS.3.1.t: Early the next morning Joshua got up and left Shittim with all the Israelites. They went as far as the Jordan, where they camped before crossing over.
s: Early the next morning Joshua got up and left Shittim with all the Israelites. They went as far as the Jordan, where they camped before crossing over.

JOS.3.2.t: After three days the officers went through the camp
s: After three days the officers went through the camp

JOS.3.3.t: and commanded the people: “When you see the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God being carried by the Levitical priests, you are to set out from your positions and follow it.
s: and commanded the people: “When you see the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God being carried by the Levitical priests, you are to set out from your positions and follow it.

JOS.3.4.t: But keep a distance of about two thousand cubits between yourselves and the ark. Do not go near it, so that you can see the way to go, since you have never traveled this way before.”
s: But keep a distance of about two thousand cubits between yourselves and the ark. Do not go near it, so that you can see the way to go, since you have never traveled this way before.”

JOS.3.5.t: Then Joshua told the people, “Consecrate yourselves, for tomorrow the LORD will do wonders among you.”
s: Then Joshua told the people, “Consecrate yourselves, for tomorrow the LORD will do wonders among you.”

JOS.3.6.t: And he said to the priests, “Take the ark of the covenant and go on ahead of the people.” So they carried the ark of the covenant and went ahead of them.
s: And he said to the priests, “Take the ark of the covenant and go on ahead of the people.” So they carried the ark of the covenant and went ahead of them.

JOS.9.3.t: But the people of Gibeon, having heard what Joshua had done to Jericho and Ai,
s: But the people of Gibeon, having heard what Joshua had done to Jericho and Ai,

JOS.9.4.t: acted deceptively and set out as envoys, carrying on their donkeys worn-out sacks and old wineskins, cracked and mended.
s: acted deceptively and set out as envoys, carrying on their donkeys worn-out sacks and old wineskins, cracked and mended.

JOS.9.5.t: They put worn, patched sandals on their feet and threadbare clothing on their bodies, and their whole supply of bread was dry and moldy.
s: They put worn, patched sandals on their feet and threadbare clothing on their bodies, and their whole supply of bread was dry and moldy.

JOS.9.6.t: They went to Joshua in the camp at Gilgal and said to him and the men of Israel, “We have come from a distant land; please make a treaty with us.”
s: They went to Joshua in the camp at Gilgal and said to him and the men of Israel, “We have come from a distant land; please make a treaty with us.”

JOS.9.7.t: But the men of Israel said to the Hivites, “Perhaps you dwell near us. How can we make a treaty with you?”
s: But the men of Israel said to the Hivites, “Perhaps you dwell near us. How can we make a treaty with you?”

JOS.9.8.t: “We are your servants,” they said to Joshua. Then Joshua asked them, “Who are you and where have you come from?”
s: “We are your servants,” they said to Joshua.
Then Joshua asked them, “Who are you and where have you come from?”

JOS.9.9.t: “Your servants have come from a very distant land,” they replied, “because of the fame of the LORD your God. For we have heard the reports about Him: all that He did in Egypt,
s: “Your servants have come from a very distant land,” they replied, “because of the fame of the LORD your God. For we have heard the reports about Him: all that He did in Egypt,

JOS.9.10.t: and all that He did to the two kings of the Amorites beyond the Jordan—Sihon king of Heshbon and Og king of Bashan, who reigned in Ashtaroth.
s: and all that He did to the two kings of the Amorites beyond the Jordan—Sihon king of Heshbon and Og king of Bashan, who reigned in Ashtaroth.

JOS.9.11.t: So the elders and inhabitants of our land told us, ‘Take provisions for your journey; go to meet them and say to them: We are your servants. Please make a treaty with us.’
s: So the elders and inhabitants of our land told us, ‘Take provisions for your journey; go to meet them and say to them: We are your servants. Please make a treaty with us.’

JOS.9.12.t: This bread of ours was warm when we packed it at home on the day we left to come to you. But take a look, it is now dry and moldy.
s: This bread of ours was warm when we packed it at home on the day we left to come to you. But take a look, it is now dry and moldy.

JOS.9.13.t: These wineskins were new when we filled them, but look, they are cracked. And these clothes and sandals are worn out from our very long journey.”
s: These wineskins were new when we filled them, but look, they are cracked. And these clothes and sandals are worn out from our very long journey.”

JOS.9.14.t: Then the men of Israel sampled their provisions, but did not seek the counsel of the LORD.
s: Then the men of Israel sampled their provisions, but did not seek the counsel of the LORD.

JOS.9.15.t: And Joshua made a treaty of peace with them to let them live, and the leaders of the congregation swore an oath to them.
s: And Joshua made a treaty of peace with them to let them live, and the leaders of the congregation swore an oath to them.

JOS.24.14.t: Now, therefore, fear the LORD and serve Him in sincerity and truth; cast aside the gods your fathers served beyond the Euphrates and in Egypt, and serve the LORD.
s: Now, therefore, fear the LORD and serve Him in sincerity and truth; cast aside the gods your fathers served beyond the Euphrates and in Egypt, and serve the LORD.

JOS.24.15.t: But if it is unpleasing in your sight to serve the LORD, then choose for yourselves this day whom you will serve, whether the gods your fathers served beyond the Euphrates, or the gods of the Amorites in whose land you are living. As for me and my house, we will serve the LORD!”
s: But if it is unpleasing in your sight to serve the LORD, then choose for yourselves this day whom you will serve, whether the gods your fathers served beyond the Euphrates, or the gods of the Amorites in whose land you are living. As for me and my house, we will serve the LORD!”

JOS.24.16.t: The people replied, “Far be it from us to forsake the LORD to serve other gods!
s: The people replied, “Far be it from us to forsake the LORD to serve other gods!

JOS.24.17.t: For the LORD our God brought us and our fathers out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery, and performed these great signs before our eyes. He also protected us throughout our journey and among all the nations through which we traveled.
s: For the LORD our God brought us and our fathers out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery, and performed these great signs before our eyes. He also protected us throughout our journey and among all the nations through which we traveled.

JOS.24.18.t: And the LORD drove out before us all the nations, including the Amorites who lived in the land. We too will serve the LORD, because He is our God!”
s: And the LORD drove out before us all the nations, including the Amorites who lived in the land. We too will serve the LORD, because He is our God!”

LAM.3.19.t: Remember my affliction and wandering, the wormwood and the gall.
s: Remember my affliction and wandering,
the wormwood and the gall.

LAM.3.20.t: Surely my soul remembers and is humbled within me.
s: Surely my soul remembers
and is humbled within me.

LAM.3.21.t: Yet I call this to mind, and therefore I have hope:
s: Yet I call this to mind,
and therefore I have hope:

LAM.3.22.t: Because of the loving devotion of the LORD we are not consumed, for His mercies never fail.
s: Because of the loving devotion of the LORD we are not consumed,
for His mercies never fail.

LAM.3.23.t: They are new every morning; great is Your faithfulness!
s: They are new every morning;
great is Your faithfulness!

LAM.3.24.t: “The LORD is my portion,” says my soul, “therefore I will hope in Him.”
s: “The LORD is my portion,” says my soul,
“therefore I will hope in Him.”

LAM.3.25.t: The LORD is good to those who wait for Him, to the soul who seeks Him.
s: The LORD is good to those who wait for Him,
to the soul who seeks Him.

LAM.3.26.t: It is good to wait quietly for the salvation of the LORD.
s: It is good to wait quietly
for the salvation of the LORD.

LUK.1.39.t: In those days Mary got ready and hurried to a town in the hill country of Judah,
s: In those days Mary got ready and hurried to a town in the hill country of Judah,

LUK.1.40.t: where she entered the home of Zechariah and greeted Elizabeth.
s: where she entered the home of Zechariah and greeted Elizabeth.

LUK.1.41.t: When Elizabeth heard Mary’s greeting, the baby leaped in her womb, and Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit.
s: When Elizabeth heard Mary’s greeting, the baby leaped in her womb, and Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit.

LUK.1.42.t: In a loud voice she exclaimed, “Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb!
s: In a loud voice she exclaimed, “Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb!

LUK.1.43.t: And why am I so honored, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?
s: And why am I so honored, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?

LUK.1.44.t: For as soon as the sound of your greeting reached my ears, the baby in my womb leaped for joy.
s: For as soon as the sound of your greeting reached my ears, the baby in my womb leaped for joy.

LUK.1.45.t: Blessed is she who has believed that the Lord’s word to her will be fulfilled.”
s: Blessed is she who has believed that the Lord’s word to her will be fulfilled.”

LUK.1.57.t: When the time came for Elizabeth to have her child, she gave birth to a son.
s: When the time came for Elizabeth to have her child, she gave birth to a son.

LUK.1.58.t: Her neighbors and relatives heard that the Lord had shown her great mercy, and they rejoiced with her.
s: Her neighbors and relatives heard that the Lord had shown her great mercy, and they rejoiced with her.

LUK.1.59.t: On the eighth day, when they came to circumcise the child, they were going to name him after his father Zechariah.
s: On the eighth day, when they came to circumcise the child, they were going to name him after his father Zechariah.

LUK.1.60.t: But his mother replied, “No! He shall be called John.”
s: But his mother replied, “No! He shall be called John.”

LUK.1.61.t: They said to her, “There is no one among your relatives who bears this name.”
s: They said to her, “There is no one among your relatives who bears this name.”

LUK.1.62.t: So they made signs to his father to find out what he wanted to name the child.
s: So they made signs to his father to find out what he wanted to name the child.

LUK.1.63.t: Zechariah asked for a tablet and wrote, “His name is John.” And they were all amazed.
s: Zechariah asked for a tablet and wrote, “His name is John.” And they were all amazed.

LUK.1.64.t: Immediately Zechariah’s mouth was opened and his tongue was released, and he began to speak, praising God.
s: Immediately Zechariah’s mouth was opened and his tongue was released, and he began to speak, praising God.

LUK.1.65.t: All their neighbors were filled with awe, and people throughout the hill country of Judea were talking about these events.
s: All their neighbors were filled with awe, and people throughout the hill country of Judea were talking about these events.

LUK.1.66.t: And all who heard this wondered in their hearts and asked, “What then will this child become?” For the Lord’s hand was with him.
s: And all who heard this wondered in their hearts and asked, “What then will this child become?” For the Lord’s hand was with him.
