s: These are the words of King Lemuel—the burden that his mother taught him:

PRO.31.2.t: What shall I say, O my son? What, O son of my womb? What, O son of my vows?
s: What shall I say, O my son?
What, O son of my womb?
What, O son of my vows?

PRO.31.3.t: Do not spend your strength on women or your vigor on those who ruin kings.
s: Do not spend your strength on women
or your vigor on those who ruin kings.

PRO.31.4.t: It is not for kings, O Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine, or for rulers to crave strong drink,
s: It is not for kings, O Lemuel,
it is not for kings to drink wine,
or for rulers to crave strong drink,

PRO.31.5.t: lest they drink and forget what is decreed, depriving all the oppressed of justice.
s: lest they drink and forget what is decreed,
depriving all the oppressed of justice.

PRO.31.6.t: Give strong drink to one who is perishing, and wine to the bitter in soul.
s: Give strong drink to one who is perishing,
and wine to the bitter in soul.

PRO.31.7.t: Let him drink and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.
s: Let him drink and forget his poverty,
and remember his misery no more.

PRO.31.8.t: Open your mouth for those with no voice, for the cause of all the dispossessed.
s: Open your mouth for those with no voice,
for the cause of all the dispossessed.

PRO.31.9.t: Open your mouth, judge righteously, and defend the cause of the poor and needy.
s: Open your mouth, judge righteously,
and defend the cause of the poor and needy.

PRO.31.25.t: Strength and honor are her clothing, and she can laugh at the days to come.
s: Strength and honor are her clothing,
and she can laugh at the days to come.

PRO.31.26.t: She opens her mouth with wisdom, and faithful instruction is on her tongue.
s: She opens her mouth with wisdom,
and faithful instruction is on her tongue.

PRO.31.27.t: She watches over the affairs of her household and does not eat the bread of idleness.
s: She watches over the affairs of her household
and does not eat the bread of idleness.

PRO.31.28.t: Her children rise up and call her blessed; her husband praises her as well:
s: Her children rise up and call her blessed;
her husband praises her as well:

PRO.31.29.t: “Many daughters have done noble things, but you surpass them all!”
s: “Many daughters have done noble things,
but you surpass them all!”

PRO.31.30.t: Charm is deceptive and beauty is fleeting, but a woman who fears the LORD is to be praised.
s: Charm is deceptive and beauty is fleeting,
but a woman who fears the LORD is to be praised.

PRO.31.31.t: Give her the fruit of her hands, and let her works praise her at the gates.
s: Give her the fruit of her hands,
and let her works praise her at the gates.

PSA.1.1.t: Blessed is the man who does not walk in the counsel of the wicked, or set foot on the path of sinners, or sit in the seat of mockers.
s: Blessed is the man
who does not walk in the counsel of the wicked,
or set foot on the path of sinners,
or sit in the seat of mockers.

PSA.1.2.t: But his delight is in the Law of the LORD, and on His law he meditates day and night.
s: But his delight is in the Law of the LORD,
and on His law he meditates day and night.

PSA.1.3.t: He is like a tree planted by streams of water, yielding its fruit in season, whose leaf does not wither, and who prospers in all he does.
s: He is like a tree planted by streams of water,
yielding its fruit in season,
whose leaf does not wither,
and who prospers in all he does.

PSA.1.4.t: Not so the wicked! For they are like chaff driven off by the wind.
s: Not so the wicked!
For they are like chaff driven off by the wind.

PSA.1.5.t: Therefore the wicked will not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the assembly of the righteous.
s: Therefore the wicked will not stand in the judgment,
nor sinners in the assembly of the righteous.

PSA.1.6.t: For the LORD guards the path of the righteous, but the way of the wicked will perish.
s: For the LORD guards the path of the righteous,
but the way of the wicked will perish.

PSA.3.1.t: O LORD, how my foes have increased! How many rise up against me!
s: O LORD, how my foes have increased!
How many rise up against me!
PSA.3.1.h: A Psalms of David, when he fled from his son Absalom.

PSA.3.2.t: Many say of me, “God will not deliver him.” Selah
s: Many say of me,
“God will not deliver him.”
Selah

PSA.3.3.t: But You, O LORD, are a shield around me, my glory, and the One who lifts my head.
s: But You, O LORD, are a shield around me,
my glory, and the One who lifts my head.

PSA.3.4.t: To the LORD I cry aloud, and He answers me from His holy mountain. Selah
s: To the LORD I cry aloud,
and He answers me from His holy mountain.
Selah

PSA.3.5.t: I lie down and sleep; I wake again, for the LORD sustains me.
s: I lie down and sleep;
I wake again, for the LORD sustains me.

PSA.3.6.t: I will not fear the myriads set against me on every side.
s: I will not fear the myriads
set against me on every side.

PSA.4.1.t: Answer me when I call, O God of my righteousness! You have relieved my distress; show me grace and hear my prayer.
s: Answer me when I call,
O God of my righteousness!
You have relieved my distress;
show me grace and hear my prayer.
PSA.4.1.h: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. A Psalm of David.

PSA.4.2.t: How long, O men, will my honor be maligned? How long will you love vanity and seek after lies ? Selah
s: How long, O men, will my honor be maligned?
How long will you love vanity and seek after lies ?
Selah

PSA.4.3.t: Know that the LORD has set apart the godly for Himself; the LORD hears when I call to Him.
s: Know that the LORD has set apart the godly for Himself;
the LORD hears when I call to Him.

PSA.4.4.t: Be angry, yet do not sin; on your bed, search your heart and be still. Selah
s: Be angry, yet do not sin;
on your bed, search your heart and be still.
Selah

PSA.4.5.t: Offer the sacrifices of the righteous and trust in the LORD.
s: Offer the sacrifices of the righteous
and trust in the LORD.

PSA.4.6.t: Many ask, “Who can show us the good?” Shine the light of Your face upon us, O LORD.
s: Many ask, “Who can show us the good?”
Shine the light of Your face upon us, O LORD.

PSA.4.7.t: You have filled my heart with more joy than when grain and new wine abound.
s: You have filled my heart with more joy
than when grain and new wine abound.

PSA.4.8.t: I will lie down and sleep in peace, for You alone, O LORD, make me dwell in safety.
s: I will lie down and sleep in peace,
for You alone, O LORD, make me dwell in safety.

PSA.5.1.t: Give ear to my words, O LORD; consider my groaning.
s: Give ear to my words, O LORD;
consider my groaning.
PSA.5.1.h: For the choirmaster, to be accompanied by flutes. A Psalm of David.

PSA.5.2.t: Attend to the sound of my cry, my King and my God, for to You I pray.
s: Attend to the sound of my cry,
my King and my God,
for to You I pray.

PSA.5.3.t: In the morning, O LORD, You hear my voice; at daybreak I lay my plea before You and wait in expectation.
s: In the morning, O LORD, You hear my voice;
at daybreak I lay my plea before You
and wait in expectation.

PSA.5.4.t: For You are not a God who delights in wickedness; no evil can dwell with You.
s: For You are not a God who delights in wickedness;
no evil can dwell with You.

PSA.5.5.t: The boastful cannot stand in Your presence; You hate all workers of iniquity.
s: The boastful cannot stand in Your presence;
You hate all workers of iniquity.

PSA.5.6.t: You destroy those who tell lies; the LORD abhors the man of bloodshed and deceit.
s: You destroy those who tell lies;
the LORD abhors the man of bloodshed and deceit.

PSA.5.7.t: But I will enter Your house by the abundance of Your loving devotion; in reverence I will bow down toward Your holy temple.
s: But I will enter Your house
by the abundance of Your loving devotion;
in reverence I will bow down
toward Your holy temple.

PSA.5.8.t: Lead me, O LORD, in Your righteousness because of my enemies; make straight Your way before me.
s: Lead me, O LORD, in Your righteousness
because of my enemies;
make straight Your way before me.

PSA.5.9.t: For not a word they speak can be trusted; destruction lies within them. Their throats are open graves; their tongues practice deceit.
s: For not a word they speak can be trusted;
destruction lies within them.
Their throats are open graves;
their tongues practice deceit.

PSA.5.10.t: Declare them guilty, O God; let them fall by their own devices. Drive them out for their many transgressions, for they have rebelled against You.
s: Declare them guilty, O God;
let them fall by their own devices.
Drive them out for their many transgressions,
for they have rebelled against You.

PSA.5.11.t: But let all who take refuge in You rejoice; let them ever shout for joy. May You shelter them, that those who love Your name may rejoice in You.
s: But let all who take refuge in You rejoice;
let them ever shout for joy.
May You shelter them,
that those who love Your name may rejoice in You.

PSA.5.12.t: For surely You, O LORD, bless the righteous; You surround them with the shield of Your favor.
s: For surely You, O LORD, bless the righteous;
You surround them with the shield of Your favor.

PSA.6.1.t: O LORD, do not rebuke me in Your anger or discipline me in Your wrath.
s: O LORD, do not rebuke me in Your anger
or discipline me in Your wrath.
PSA.6.1.h: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments, according to Sheminith. A Psalm of David.

PSA.6.2.t: Be merciful to me, O LORD, for I am frail; heal me, O LORD, for my bones are in agony.
s: Be merciful to me, O LORD, for I am frail;
heal me, O LORD, for my bones are in agony.

PSA.6.3.t: My soul is deeply distressed. How long, O LORD, how long?
s: My soul is deeply distressed.
How long, O LORD, how long?

PSA.6.4.t: Turn, O LORD, and deliver my soul; save me because of Your loving devotion.
s: Turn, O LORD, and deliver my soul;
save me because of Your loving devotion.

PSA.6.5.t: For there is no mention of You in death; who can praise You from Sheol?
s: For there is no mention of You in death;
who can praise You from Sheol?

PSA.6.6.t: I am weary from groaning; all night I flood my bed with weeping and drench my couch with tears.
s: I am weary from groaning;
all night I flood my bed with weeping
and drench my couch with tears.

PSA.6.7.t: My eyes fail from grief; they grow dim because of all my foes.
s: My eyes fail from grief;
they grow dim because of all my foes.

PSA.6.8.t: Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity, for the LORD has heard my weeping.
s: Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity,
for the LORD has heard my weeping.

PSA.6.9.t: The LORD has heard my cry for mercy; the LORD accepts my prayer.
s: The LORD has heard my cry for mercy;
the LORD accepts my prayer.

PSA.6.10.t: All my enemies will be ashamed and dismayed; they will turn back in sudden disgrace.
s: All my enemies will be ashamed and dismayed;
they will turn back in sudden disgrace.

PSA.8.1.t: O LORD, our Lord, how majestic is Your name in all the earth! You have set Your glory above the heavens.
s: O LORD, our Lord,
how majestic is Your name in all the earth!
You have set Your glory
above the heavens.
PSA.8.1.h: For the choirmaster. According to Gittith. A Psalm of David.

PSA.8.2.t: From the mouths of children and infants You have ordained praise on account of Your adversaries, to silence the enemy and avenger.
s: From the mouths of children and infants
You have ordained praise
on account of Your adversaries,
to silence the enemy and avenger.

PSA.8.3.t: When I behold Your heavens, the work of Your fingers, the moon and the stars, which You have set in place—
s: When I behold Your heavens,
the work of Your fingers,
the moon and the stars,
which You have set in place—

PSA.8.4.t: what is man that You are mindful of him, or the son of man that You care for him?
s: what is man that You are mindful of him,
or the son of man that You care for him?

PSA.8.5.t: You made him a little lower than the angels; You crowned him with glory and honor.
s: You made him a little lower than the angels;
You crowned him with glory and honor.

PSA.8.6.t: You made him ruler of the works of Your hands; You have placed everything under his feet:
s: You made him ruler of the works of Your hands;
You have placed everything under his feet:

PSA.8.7.t: all sheep and oxen, and even the beasts of the field,
s: all sheep and oxen,
and even the beasts of the field,

PSA.8.8.t: the birds of the air and the fish of the sea, all that swim the paths of the seas.
s: the birds of the air and the fish of the sea,
all that swim the paths of the seas.

PSA.8.9.t: O LORD, our Lord, how majestic is Your name in all the earth!
s: O LORD, our Lord,
how majestic is Your name in all the earth!

PSA.9.7.t: But the LORD abides forever; He has established His throne for judgment.
s: But the LORD abides forever;
He has established His throne for judgment.

PSA.9.8.t: He judges the world with justice; He governs the people with equity.
s: He judges the world with justice;
He governs the people with equity.

PSA.9.9.t: The LORD is a refuge for the oppressed, a stronghold in times of trouble.
s: The LORD is a refuge for the oppressed,
a stronghold in times of trouble.

PSA.9.10.t: Those who know Your name trust in You, for You, O LORD, have not forsaken those who seek You.
s: Those who know Your name trust in You,
for You, O LORD, have not forsaken those who seek You.

PSA.9.11.t: Sing praises to the LORD, who dwells in Zion; proclaim His deeds among the nations.
s: Sing praises to the LORD, who dwells in Zion;
proclaim His deeds among the nations.

PSA.9.12.t: For the Avenger of bloodshed remembers; He does not ignore the cry of the afflicted.
s: For the Avenger of bloodshed remembers;
He does not ignore the cry of the afflicted.

PSA.10.12.t: Arise, O LORD! Lift up Your hand, O God! Do not forget the helpless.
s: Arise, O LORD! Lift up Your hand, O God!
Do not forget the helpless.

PSA.10.13.t: Why has the wicked man renounced God? He says to himself, “You will never call me to account.”
s: Why has the wicked man renounced God?
He says to himself, “You will never call me to account.”

PSA.10.14.t: But You have regarded trouble and grief; You see to repay it by Your hand. The victim entrusts himself to You; You are the helper of the fatherless.
s: But You have regarded trouble and grief;
You see to repay it by Your hand.
The victim entrusts himself to You;
You are the helper of the fatherless.

PSA.10.15.t: Break the arm of the wicked and evildoer; call him to account for his wickedness until none is left to be found.
s: Break the arm of the wicked and evildoer;
call him to account for his wickedness
until none is left to be found.

PSA.10.16.t: The LORD is King forever and ever; the nations perish from His land.
s: The LORD is King forever and ever;
the nations perish from His land.

PSA.10.17.t: You have heard, O LORD, the desire of the humble; You will strengthen their hearts. You will incline Your ear,
s: You have heard, O LORD, the desire of the humble;
You will strengthen their hearts.
You will incline Your ear,

PSA.10.18.t: to vindicate the fatherless and oppressed, that the men of the earth may strike terror no more.
s: to vindicate the fatherless and oppressed,
that the men of the earth
may strike terror no more.

PSA.13.1.t: How long, O LORD? Will You forget me forever? How long will You hide Your face from me?
s: How long, O LORD?
Will You forget me forever?
How long will You hide Your face from me?
PSA.13.1.h: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David.

PSA.13.2.t: How long must I wrestle in my soul, with sorrow in my heart each day? How long will my enemy dominate me?
s: How long must I wrestle in my soul,
with sorrow in my heart each day?
How long will my enemy dominate me?

PSA.13.3.t: Consider me and respond, O LORD my God. Give light to my eyes, lest I sleep in death,
s: Consider me and respond, O LORD my God.
Give light to my eyes, lest I sleep in death,

PSA.13.4.t: lest my enemy say, “I have overcome him,” and my foes rejoice when I fall.
s: lest my enemy say, “I have overcome him,”
and my foes rejoice when I fall.

PSA.13.5.t: But I have trusted in Your loving devotion; my heart will rejoice in Your salvation.
s: But I have trusted in Your loving devotion;
my heart will rejoice in Your salvation.

PSA.13.6.t: I will sing to the LORD, for He has been good to me.
s: I will sing to the LORD,
for He has been good to me.

PSA.15.1.t: O LORD, who may abide in Your tent? Who may dwell on Your holy mountain?
s: O LORD, who may abide in Your tent?
Who may dwell on Your holy mountain?

PSA.15.2.t: He who walks with integrity and practices righteousness, who speaks the truth from his heart,
s: He who walks with integrity
and practices righteousness,
who speaks the truth from his heart,

PSA.15.3.t: who has no slander on his tongue, who does no harm to his neighbor, who casts no scorn on his friend,
s: who has no slander on his tongue,
who does no harm to his neighbor,
who casts no scorn on his friend,

PSA.15.4.t: who despises the vile but honors those who fear the LORD, who does not revise a costly oath,
s: who despises the vile
but honors those who fear the LORD,
who does not revise a costly oath,

PSA.15.5.t: who lends his money without interest and refuses a bribe against the innocent. He who does these things will never be shaken.
s: who lends his money without interest
and refuses a bribe against the innocent.
He who does these things
will never be shaken.

PSA.16.1.t: Preserve me, O God, for in You I take refuge.
s: Preserve me, O God,
for in You I take refuge.

PSA.16.2.t: I said to the LORD, “You are my Lord; apart from You I have no good thing.”
s: I said to the LORD, “You are my Lord;
apart from You I have no good thing.”

PSA.16.3.t: As for the saints in the land, they are the excellence in whom all my delight resides.
s: As for the saints in the land,
they are the excellence
in whom all my delight resides.

PSA.16.4.t: Sorrows will multiply to those who chase other gods. I will not pour out their libations of blood, or speak their names with my lips.
s: Sorrows will multiply
to those who chase other gods.
I will not pour out their libations of blood,
or speak their names with my lips.

PSA.16.5.t: The LORD is my chosen portion and my cup; You have made my lot secure.
s: The LORD is my chosen portion and my cup;
You have made my lot secure.

PSA.16.6.t: The lines of my boundary have fallen in pleasant places; surely my inheritance is delightful.
s: The lines of my boundary have fallen in pleasant places;
surely my inheritance is delightful.

PSA.16.7.t: I will bless the LORD who counsels me; even at night my conscience instructs me.
s: I will bless the LORD who counsels me;
even at night my conscience instructs me.

PSA.16.8.t: I have set the LORD always before me. Because He is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.
s: I have set the LORD always before me.
Because He is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.

PSA.16.9.t: Therefore my heart is glad and my tongue rejoices; my body also will dwell securely.
s: Therefore my heart is glad and my tongue rejoices;
my body also will dwell securely.

PSA.16.10.t: For You will not abandon my soul to Sheol, nor will You let Your Holy One see decay.
s: For You will not abandon my soul to Sheol,
nor will You let Your Holy One see decay.

PSA.16.11.t: You have made known to me the path of life; You will fill me with joy in Your presence, with eternal pleasures at Your right hand.
s: You have made known to me the path of life;
You will fill me with joy in Your presence,
with eternal pleasures at Your right hand.

PSA.17.6.t: I call on You, O God, for You will answer me. Incline Your ear to me; hear my words.
s: I call on You, O God,
for You will answer me.
Incline Your ear to me;
hear my words.

PSA.17.7.t: Show the wonders of Your loving devotion, You who save by Your right hand those who seek refuge from their foes.
s: Show the wonders of Your loving devotion,
You who save by Your right hand
those who seek refuge from their foes.

PSA.17.8.t: Keep me as the apple of Your eye; hide me in the shadow of Your wings
s: Keep me as the apple of Your eye;
hide me in the shadow of Your wings

PSA.17.9.t: from the wicked who assail me, from my mortal enemies who surround me.
s: from the wicked who assail me,
from my mortal enemies who surround me.

PSA.18.16.t: He reached down from on high and took hold of me; He drew me out of deep waters.
s: He reached down from on high and took hold of me;
He drew me out of deep waters.

PSA.18.17.t: He rescued me from my powerful enemy, from foes too mighty for me.
s: He rescued me from my powerful enemy,
from foes too mighty for me.

PSA.18.18.t: They confronted me in my day of calamity, but the LORD was my support.
s: They confronted me in my day of calamity,
but the LORD was my support.

PSA.18.19.t: He brought me out into the open; He rescued me because He delighted in me.
s: He brought me out into the open;
He rescued me because He delighted in me.

PSA.18.30.t: As for God, His way is perfect; the word of the LORD is flawless. He is a shield to all who take refuge in Him.
s: As for God, His way is perfect;
the word of the LORD is flawless.
He is a shield to all who take refuge in Him.

PSA.18.31.t: For who is God besides the LORD? And who is the Rock except our God?
s: For who is God besides the LORD?
And who is the Rock except our God?

PSA.18.32.t: It is God who arms me with strength and makes my way clear.
s: It is God who arms me with strength
and makes my way clear.

PSA.18.33.t: He makes my feet like those of a deer and stations me upon the heights.
s: He makes my feet like those of a deer
and stations me upon the heights.

PSA.18.34.t: He trains my hands for battle; my arms can bend a bow of bronze.
s: He trains my hands for battle;
my arms can bend a bow of bronze.

PSA.18.35.t: You have given me Your shield of salvation; Your right hand upholds me, and Your gentleness exalts me.
s: You have given me Your shield of salvation;
Your right hand upholds me,
and Your gentleness exalts me.

PSA.18.36.t: You broaden the path beneath me so that my ankles do not give way.
s: You broaden the path beneath me
so that my ankles do not give way.

PSA.19.1.t: The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of His hands.
s: The heavens declare the glory of God;
the skies proclaim the work of His hands.
PSA.19.1.h: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David.

PSA.19.2.t: Day after day they pour forth speech; night after night they reveal knowledge.
s: Day after day they pour forth speech;
night after night they reveal knowledge.

PSA.19.3.t: Without speech or language, without a sound to be heard,
s: Without speech or language,
without a sound to be heard,

PSA.19.4.t: their voice has gone out into all the earth, their words to the ends of the world. In the heavens He has pitched a tent for the sun.
s: their voice has gone out into all the earth,
their words to the ends of the world.
In the heavens He has pitched
a tent for the sun.

PSA.19.5.t: Like a bridegroom emerging from his chamber, like a champion rejoicing to run his course,
s: Like a bridegroom emerging from his chamber,
like a champion rejoicing to run his course,

PSA.19.6.t: it rises at one end of the heavens and runs its circuit to the other; nothing is deprived of its warmth.
s: it rises at one end of the heavens
and runs its circuit to the other;
nothing is deprived of its warmth.

PSA.19.7.t: The Law of the LORD is perfect, reviving the soul; the testimony of the LORD is trustworthy, making wise the simple.
s: The Law of the LORD is perfect,
reviving the soul;
the testimony of the LORD is trustworthy,
making wise the simple.

PSA.19.8.t: The precepts of the LORD are right, bringing joy to the heart; the commandments of the LORD are radiant, giving light to the eyes.
s: The precepts of the LORD are right,
bringing joy to the heart;
the commandments of the LORD are radiant,
giving light to the eyes.

PSA.19.9.t: The fear of the LORD is pure, enduring forever; the judgments of the LORD are true, being altogether righteous.
s: The fear of the LORD is pure,
enduring forever;
the judgments of the LORD are true,
being altogether righteous.

PSA.19.10.t: They are more precious than gold, than much pure gold; they are sweeter than honey, than honey from the comb.
s: They are more precious than gold,
than much pure gold;
they are sweeter than honey,
than honey from the comb.

PSA.19.11.t: By them indeed Your servant is warned; in keeping them is great reward.
s: By them indeed Your servant is warned;
in keeping them is great reward.

PSA.19.12.t: Who can discern his own errors? Cleanse me from my hidden faults.
s: Who can discern his own errors?
Cleanse me from my hidden faults.

PSA.19.13.t: Keep Your servant also from willful sins; may they not rule over me. Then I will be blameless and cleansed of great transgression.
s: Keep Your servant also from willful sins;
may they not rule over me.
Then I will be blameless
and cleansed of great transgression.

PSA.19.14.t: May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be pleasing in Your sight, O LORD, my Rock and my Redeemer.
s: May the words of my mouth
and the meditation of my heart
be pleasing in Your sight,
O LORD, my Rock and my Redeemer.

PSA.20.1.t: May the LORD answer you in the day of trouble; may the name of the God of Jacob protect you.
s: May the LORD answer you in the day of trouble;
may the name of the God of Jacob protect you.
PSA.20.1.h: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David.

PSA.20.2.t: May He send you help from the sanctuary and sustain you from Zion.
s: May He send you help from the sanctuary
and sustain you from Zion.

PSA.20.3.t: May He remember all your gifts and look favorably on your burnt offerings. Selah
s: May He remember all your gifts
and look favorably on your burnt offerings.
Selah

PSA.20.4.t: May He give you the desires of your heart and make all your plans succeed.
s: May He give you the desires of your heart
and make all your plans succeed.

PSA.20.5.t: May we shout for joy at your victory and raise a banner in the name of our God. May the LORD grant all your petitions.
s: May we shout for joy at your victory
and raise a banner in the name of our God.
May the LORD grant all your petitions.

PSA.20.6.t: Now I know that the LORD saves His anointed; He answers him from His holy heaven with the saving power of His right hand.
s: Now I know that the LORD saves His anointed;
He answers him from His holy heaven
with the saving power of His right hand.

PSA.20.7.t: Some trust in chariots and others in horses, but we trust in the name of the LORD our God.
s: Some trust in chariots and others in horses,
but we trust in the name of the LORD our God.

PSA.20.8.t: They collapse and fall, but we rise up and stand firm.
s: They collapse and fall,
but we rise up and stand firm.

PSA.20.9.t: O LORD, save the king. Answer us on the day we call.
s: O LORD, save the king.
Answer us on the day we call.

PSA.23.1.t: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
s: The LORD is my shepherd;
I shall not want.

PSA.23.2.t: He makes me lie down in green pastures; He leads me beside quiet waters.
s: He makes me lie down in green pastures;
He leads me beside quiet waters.

PSA.23.3.t: He restores my soul; He guides me in the paths of righteousness for the sake of His name.
s: He restores my soul;
He guides me in the paths of righteousness
for the sake of His name.

PSA.23.4.t: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for You are with me; Your rod and Your staff, they comfort me.
s: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death,
I will fear no evil,
for You are with me;
Your rod and Your staff, they comfort me.

PSA.23.5.t: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil; my cup overflows.
s: You prepare a table before me
in the presence of my enemies.
You anoint my head with oil;
my cup overflows.

PSA.23.6.t: Surely goodness and mercy will follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the house of the LORD forever.
s: Surely goodness and mercy will follow me
all the days of my life,
and I will dwell in the house of the LORD
forever.

PSA.25.1.t: To You, O LORD, I lift up my soul;
s: To You, O LORD, I lift up my soul;

PSA.25.2.t: in You, my God, I trust. Do not let me be put to shame; do not let my enemies exult over me.
s: in You, my God, I trust.
Do not let me be put to shame;
do not let my enemies exult over me.

PSA.25.3.t: Surely none who wait for You will be put to shame; but those who are faithless without cause will be disgraced.
s: Surely none who wait for You will be put to shame;
but those who are faithless without cause will be disgraced.

PSA.25.4.t: Show me Your ways, O LORD; teach me Your paths.
s: Show me Your ways, O LORD;
teach me Your paths.

PSA.25.5.t: Guide me in Your truth and teach me, for You are the God of my salvation; all day long I wait for You.
s: Guide me in Your truth and teach me,
for You are the God of my salvation;
all day long I wait for You.

PSA.25.6.t: Remember, O LORD, Your compassion and loving devotion, for they are from age to age.
s: Remember, O LORD, Your compassion and loving devotion,
for they are from age to age.

PSA.25.7.t: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my rebellious acts; remember me according to Your loving devotion, because of Your goodness, O LORD.
s: Remember not the sins of my youth,
nor my rebellious acts;
remember me according to Your loving devotion,
because of Your goodness, O LORD.

PSA.25.8.t: Good and upright is the LORD; therefore He shows sinners the way.
s: Good and upright is the LORD;
therefore He shows sinners the way.

PSA.25.9.t: He guides the humble in what is right and teaches them His way.
s: He guides the humble in what is right
and teaches them His way.

PSA.25.10.t: All the LORD’s ways are loving and faithful to those who keep His covenant and His decrees.
s: All the LORD’s ways are loving and faithful
to those who keep His covenant and His decrees.

PSA.25.14.t: The LORD confides in those who fear Him, and reveals His covenant to them.
s: The LORD confides in those who fear Him,
and reveals His covenant to them.

PSA.25.15.t: My eyes are always on the LORD, for He will free my feet from the mesh.
s: My eyes are always on the LORD,
for He will free my feet from the mesh.

PSA.25.16.t: Turn to me and be gracious, for I am lonely and afflicted.
s: Turn to me and be gracious,
for I am lonely and afflicted.

PSA.25.17.t: The troubles of my heart increase; free me from my distress.
s: The troubles of my heart increase;
free me from my distress.

PSA.25.18.t: Consider my affliction and trouble, and take away all my sins.
s: Consider my affliction and trouble,
and take away all my sins.

PSA.25.19.t: Consider my enemies, for they are many, and they hate me with vicious hatred.
s: Consider my enemies, for they are many,
and they hate me with vicious hatred.

PSA.25.20.t: Guard my soul and deliver me; let me not be put to shame, for I take refuge in You.
s: Guard my soul and deliver me;
let me not be put to shame,
for I take refuge in You.

PSA.25.21.t: May integrity and uprightness preserve me, because I wait for You.
s: May integrity and uprightness preserve me,
because I wait for You.

PSA.27.1.t: The LORD is my light and my salvation— whom shall I fear? The LORD is the stronghold of my life— whom shall I dread?
s: The LORD is my light and my salvation—
whom shall I fear?
The LORD is the stronghold of my life—
whom shall I dread?

PSA.27.2.t: When the wicked came upon me to devour my flesh, my enemies and foes stumbled and fell.
s: When the wicked came upon me to devour my flesh,
my enemies and foes stumbled and fell.

PSA.27.3.t: Though an army encamps around me, my heart will not fear; though a war breaks out against me, I will keep my trust.
s: Though an army encamps around me,
my heart will not fear;
though a war breaks out against me,
I will keep my trust.

PSA.27.4.t: One thing I have asked of the LORD; this is what I desire: to dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to gaze on the beauty of the LORD and seek Him in His temple.
s: One thing I have asked of the LORD;
this is what I desire:
to dwell in the house of the LORD
all the days of my life,
to gaze on the beauty of the LORD
and seek Him in His temple.

PSA.27.5.t: For in the day of trouble He will hide me in His shelter; He will conceal me under the cover of His tent; He will set me high upon a rock.
s: For in the day of trouble
He will hide me in His shelter;
He will conceal me under the cover of His tent;
He will set me high upon a rock.

PSA.27.7.t: Hear, O LORD, my voice when I call; be merciful and answer me.
s: Hear, O LORD, my voice when I call;
be merciful and answer me.

PSA.27.8.t: My heart said, “Seek His face.” Your face, O LORD, I will seek.
s: My heart said, “Seek His face.”
Your face, O LORD, I will seek.

PSA.27.9.t: Hide not Your face from me, nor turn away Your servant in anger. You have been my helper; do not leave me or forsake me, O God of my salvation.
s: Hide not Your face from me,
nor turn away Your servant in anger.
You have been my helper;
do not leave me or forsake me,
O God of my salvation.

PSA.27.10.t: Though my father and mother forsake me, the LORD will receive me.
s: Though my father and mother forsake me,
the LORD will receive me.

PSA.27.11.t: Teach me Your way, O LORD, and lead me on a level path, because of my oppressors.
s: Teach me Your way, O LORD,
and lead me on a level path,
because of my oppressors.

PSA.27.12.t: Do not hand me over to the will of my foes, for false witnesses rise up against me, breathing out violence.
s: Do not hand me over to the will of my foes,
for false witnesses rise up against me,
breathing out violence.

PSA.27.13.t: Still I am certain to see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.
s: Still I am certain to see
the goodness of the LORD
in the land of the living.

PSA.27.14.t: Wait patiently for the LORD; be strong and courageous. Wait patiently for the LORD!
s: Wait patiently for the LORD;
be strong and courageous.
Wait patiently for the LORD!

PSA.29.3.t: The voice of the LORD is over the waters; the God of glory thunders; the LORD is heard over many waters.
s: The voice of the LORD is over the waters;
the God of glory thunders;
the LORD is heard over many waters.

PSA.29.4.t: The voice of the LORD is powerful; the voice of the LORD is majestic.
s: The voice of the LORD is powerful;
the voice of the LORD is majestic.

PSA.29.5.t: The voice of the LORD breaks the cedars; the LORD shatters the cedars of Lebanon.
s: The voice of the LORD breaks the cedars;
the LORD shatters the cedars of Lebanon.

PSA.29.6.t: He makes Lebanon skip like a calf, and Sirion like a young wild ox.
s: He makes Lebanon skip like a calf,
and Sirion like a young wild ox.

PSA.29.7.t: The voice of the LORD strikes with flames of fire.
s: The voice of the LORD
strikes with flames of fire.

PSA.29.8.t: The voice of the LORD shakes the wilderness; the LORD shakes the Wilderness of Kadesh.
s: The voice of the LORD shakes the wilderness;
the LORD shakes the Wilderness of Kadesh.

PSA.29.9.t: The voice of the LORD twists the oaks and strips the forests bare. And in His temple all cry, “Glory!”
s: The voice of the LORD twists the oaks
and strips the forests bare.
And in His temple all cry, “Glory!”

PSA.29.10.t: The LORD sits enthroned over the flood; the LORD is enthroned as King forever.
s: The LORD sits enthroned over the flood;
the LORD is enthroned as King forever.

PSA.29.11.t: The LORD gives His people strength; the LORD blesses His people with peace.
s: The LORD gives His people strength;
the LORD blesses His people with peace.

PSA.30.1.t: I will exalt You, O LORD, for You have lifted me up and have not allowed my foes to rejoice over me.
s: I will exalt You, O LORD,
for You have lifted me up
and have not allowed my foes
to rejoice over me.
PSA.30.1.h: A Psalm. A song for the dedication of the temple. Of David.

PSA.30.2.t: O LORD my God, I cried to You for help, and You healed me.
s: O LORD my God, I cried to You for help,
and You healed me.

PSA.30.3.t: O LORD, You pulled me up from Sheol; You spared me from descending into the Pit.
s: O LORD, You pulled me up from Sheol;
You spared me from descending into the Pit.

PSA.30.4.t: Sing to the LORD, O you His saints, and praise His holy name.
s: Sing to the LORD, O you His saints,
and praise His holy name.

PSA.30.5.t: For His anger is fleeting, but His favor lasts a lifetime. Weeping may stay the night, but joy comes in the morning.
s: For His anger is fleeting,
but His favor lasts a lifetime.
Weeping may stay the night,
but joy comes in the morning.

PSA.31.9.t: Be merciful to me, O LORD, for I am in distress; my eyes fail from sorrow, my soul and body as well.
s: Be merciful to me, O LORD,
for I am in distress;
my eyes fail from sorrow,
my soul and body as well.

PSA.31.10.t: For my life is consumed with grief and my years with groaning; my iniquity has drained my strength, and my bones are wasting away.
s: For my life is consumed with grief
and my years with groaning;
my iniquity has drained my strength,
and my bones are wasting away.

PSA.31.11.t: Among all my enemies I am a disgrace, and among my neighbors even more. I am dreaded by my friends— they flee when they see me on the street.
s: Among all my enemies I am a disgrace,
and among my neighbors even more.
I am dreaded by my friends—
they flee when they see me on the street.

PSA.31.12.t: I am forgotten like a dead man, out of mind. I am like a broken vessel.
s: I am forgotten like a dead man, out of mind.
I am like a broken vessel.

PSA.31.13.t: For I hear the slander of many; there is terror on every side. They conspire against me and plot to take my life.
s: For I hear the slander of many;
there is terror on every side.
They conspire against me
and plot to take my life.

PSA.31.14.t: But I trust in You, O LORD; I say, “You are my God.”
s: But I trust in You, O LORD;
I say, “You are my God.”

PSA.31.15.t: My times are in Your hands; deliver me from my enemies and from those who pursue me.
s: My times are in Your hands;
deliver me from my enemies
and from those who pursue me.

PSA.31.16.t: Make Your face shine on Your servant; save me by Your loving devotion.
s: Make Your face shine on Your servant;
save me by Your loving devotion.

PSA.31.19.t: How great is Your goodness which You have laid up for those who fear You, which You have bestowed before the sons of men on those who take refuge in You!
s: How great is Your goodness
which You have laid up for those who fear You,
which You have bestowed before the sons of men
on those who take refuge in You!

PSA.31.20.t: You hide them in the secret place of Your presence from the schemes of men. You conceal them in Your shelter from accusing tongues.
s: You hide them in the secret place of Your presence
from the schemes of men.
You conceal them in Your shelter
from accusing tongues.

PSA.31.21.t: Blessed be the LORD, for He has shown me His loving devotion in a city under siege.
s: Blessed be the LORD,
for He has shown me His loving devotion
in a city under siege.

PSA.31.22.t: In my alarm I said, “I am cut off from Your sight!” But You heard my plea for mercy when I called to You for help.
s: In my alarm I said,
“I am cut off from Your sight!”
But You heard my plea for mercy
when I called to You for help.

PSA.31.23.t: Love the LORD, all His saints. The LORD preserves the faithful, but fully repays the arrogant.
s: Love the LORD, all His saints.
The LORD preserves the faithful,
but fully repays the arrogant.

PSA.31.24.t: Be strong and courageous, all you who hope in the LORD.
s: Be strong and courageous,
all you who hope in the LORD.

PSA.32.1.t: Blessed is he whose transgressions are forgiven, whose sins are covered.
s: Blessed is he whose transgressions are forgiven,
whose sins are covered.

PSA.32.2.t: Blessed is the man whose iniquity the LORD does not count against him, in whose spirit there is no deceit.
s: Blessed is the man
whose iniquity the LORD does not count against him,
in whose spirit there is no deceit.

PSA.32.3.t: When I kept silent, my bones became brittle from my groaning all day long.
s: When I kept silent, my bones became brittle
from my groaning all day long.

PSA.32.4.t: For day and night Your hand was heavy upon me; my strength was drained as in the summer heat. Selah
s: For day and night
Your hand was heavy upon me;
my strength was drained
as in the summer heat.
Selah

PSA.32.5.t: Then I acknowledged my sin to You and did not hide my iniquity. I said, “I will confess my transgressions to the LORD,” and You forgave the guilt of my sin. Selah
s: Then I acknowledged my sin to You
and did not hide my iniquity.
I said, “I will confess my transgressions to the LORD,”
and You forgave the guilt of my sin.
Selah

PSA.32.6.t: Therefore let all the godly pray to You while You may be found. Surely when great waters rise, they will not come near.
s: Therefore let all the godly pray to You
while You may be found.
Surely when great waters rise,
they will not come near.

PSA.32.7.t: You are my hiding place. You protect me from trouble; You surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah
s: You are my hiding place.
You protect me from trouble;
You surround me with songs of deliverance.
Selah

PSA.32.8.t: I will instruct you and teach you the way you should go; I will give you counsel and watch over you.
s: I will instruct you and teach you the way you should go;
I will give you counsel and watch over you.

PSA.32.9.t: Do not be like the horse or mule, which have no understanding; they must be controlled with bit and bridle to make them come to you.
s: Do not be like the horse or mule,
which have no understanding;
they must be controlled with bit and bridle
to make them come to you.

PSA.32.10.t: Many are the sorrows of the wicked, but loving devotion surrounds him who trusts in the LORD.
s: Many are the sorrows of the wicked,
but loving devotion surrounds him who trusts in the LORD.

PSA.32.11.t: Be glad in the LORD and rejoice, O righteous ones; shout for joy, all you upright in heart.
s: Be glad in the LORD and rejoice, O righteous ones;
shout for joy, all you upright in heart.

PSA.34.4.t: I sought the LORD, and He answered me; He delivered me from all my fears.
s: I sought the LORD, and He answered me;
He delivered me from all my fears.

PSA.34.5.t: Those who look to Him are radiant with joy; their faces shall never be ashamed.
s: Those who look to Him are radiant with joy;
their faces shall never be ashamed.

PSA.34.6.t: This poor man called out, and the LORD heard him; He saved him from all his troubles.
s: This poor man called out, and the LORD heard him;
He saved him from all his troubles.

PSA.34.7.t: The angel of the LORD encamps around those who fear Him, and he delivers them.
s: The angel of the LORD encamps around those who fear Him,
and he delivers them.

PSA.34.8.t: Taste and see that the LORD is good; blessed is the man who takes refuge in Him!
s: Taste and see that the LORD is good;
blessed is the man who takes refuge in Him!

PSA.34.9.t: Fear the LORD, you His saints, for those who fear Him lack nothing.
s: Fear the LORD, you His saints,
for those who fear Him lack nothing.

PSA.34.10.t: Young lions go lacking and hungry, but those who seek the LORD lack no good thing.
s: Young lions go lacking and hungry,
but those who seek the LORD lack no good thing.

PSA.34.17.t: The righteous cry out, and the LORD hears; He delivers them from all their troubles.
s: The righteous cry out, and the LORD hears;
He delivers them from all their troubles.

PSA.34.18.t: The LORD is near to the brokenhearted; He saves the contrite in spirit.
s: The LORD is near to the brokenhearted;
He saves the contrite in spirit.

PSA.34.19.t: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but the LORD delivers him from them all.
s: Many are the afflictions of the righteous,
but the LORD delivers him from them all.

PSA.37.1.t: Do not fret over those who do evil; do not envy those who do wrong.
s: Do not fret over those who do evil;
do not envy those who do wrong.

PSA.37.2.t: For they wither quickly like grass and wilt like tender plants.
s: For they wither quickly like grass
and wilt like tender plants.

PSA.37.3.t: Trust in the LORD and do good; dwell in the land and cultivate faithfulness.
s: Trust in the LORD and do good;
dwell in the land and cultivate faithfulness.

PSA.37.4.t: Delight yourself in the LORD, and He will give you the desires of your heart.
s: Delight yourself in the LORD,
and He will give you the desires of your heart.

PSA.37.5.t: Commit your way to the LORD; trust in Him, and He will do it.
s: Commit your way to the LORD;
trust in Him, and He will do it.

PSA.37.6.t: He will bring forth your righteousness like the dawn, your justice like the noonday sun.
s: He will bring forth your righteousness like the dawn,
your justice like the noonday sun.

PSA.37.7.t: Be still before the LORD and wait patiently for Him; do not fret when men prosper in their ways, when they carry out wicked schemes.
s: Be still before the LORD
and wait patiently for Him;
do not fret when men prosper in their ways,
when they carry out wicked schemes.

PSA.37.23.t: The steps of a man are ordered by the LORD who takes delight in his journey.
s: The steps of a man are ordered by the LORD
who takes delight in his journey.

PSA.37.24.t: Though he falls, he will not be overwhelmed, for the LORD is holding his hand.
s: Though he falls, he will not be overwhelmed,
for the LORD is holding his hand.

PSA.37.25.t: I once was young and now am old, yet never have I seen the righteous abandoned or their children begging for bread.
s: I once was young and now am old,
yet never have I seen the righteous abandoned
or their children begging for bread.

PSA.37.26.t: They are ever generous and quick to lend, and their children are a blessing.
s: They are ever generous and quick to lend,
and their children are a blessing.

PSA.40.1.t: I waited patiently for the LORD; He inclined to me and heard my cry.
s: I waited patiently for the LORD;
He inclined to me and heard my cry.
PSA.40.1.h: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David.

PSA.40.2.t: He lifted me up from the pit of despair, out of the miry clay; He set my feet upon a rock, and made my footsteps firm.
s: He lifted me up from the pit of despair,
out of the miry clay;
He set my feet upon a rock,
and made my footsteps firm.

PSA.40.3.t: He put a new song in my mouth, a hymn of praise to our God. Many will see and fear and put their trust in the LORD.
s: He put a new song in my mouth,
a hymn of praise to our God.
Many will see and fear
and put their trust in the LORD.

PSA.40.4.t: Blessed is the man who has made the LORD his trust, who has not turned to the proud, nor to those who lapse into falsehood.
s: Blessed is the man
who has made the LORD his trust,
who has not turned to the proud,
nor to those who lapse into falsehood.

PSA.40.5.t: Many, O LORD my God, are the wonders You have done, and the plans You have for us— none can compare to You— if I proclaim and declare them, they are more than I can count.
s: Many, O LORD my God,
are the wonders You have done,
and the plans You have for us—
none can compare to You—
if I proclaim and declare them,
they are more than I can count.

PSA.41.1.t: Blessed is the one who cares for the poor; the LORD will deliver him in the day of trouble.
s: Blessed is the one who cares for the poor;
the LORD will deliver him in the day of trouble.
PSA.41.1.h: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David.

PSA.41.2.t: The LORD will protect and preserve him; He will bless him in the land and refuse to surrender him to the will of his foes.
s: The LORD will protect and preserve him;
He will bless him in the land
and refuse to surrender him
to the will of his foes.

PSA.41.3.t: The LORD will sustain him on his bed of illness and restore him from his bed of sickness.
s: The LORD will sustain him on his bed of illness
and restore him from his bed of sickness.

PSA.41.4.t: I said, “O LORD, be gracious to me; heal me, for I have sinned against You.”
s: I said, “O LORD, be gracious to me;
heal me, for I have sinned against You.”

PSA.42.5.t: Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why the unease within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him for the salvation of His presence.
s: Why are you downcast, O my soul?
Why the unease within me?
Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him
for the salvation of His presence.

PSA.42.6.t: O my God, my soul despairs within me. Therefore I remember You from the land of Jordan and the peaks of Hermon— even from Mount Mizar.
s: O my God, my soul despairs within me.
Therefore I remember You
from the land of Jordan and the peaks of Hermon—
even from Mount Mizar.

PSA.42.7.t: Deep calls to deep in the roar of Your waterfalls; all Your breakers and waves have rolled over me.
s: Deep calls to deep
in the roar of Your waterfalls;
all Your breakers and waves
have rolled over me.

PSA.42.8.t: The LORD decrees His loving devotion by day, and at night His song is with me as a prayer to the God of my life.
s: The LORD decrees His loving devotion by day,
and at night His song is with me
as a prayer to the God of my life.

PSA.42.9.t: I say to God my Rock, “Why have You forgotten me? Why must I walk in sorrow because of the enemy’s oppression?”
s: I say to God my Rock,
“Why have You forgotten me?
Why must I walk in sorrow
because of the enemy’s oppression?”

PSA.42.10.t: Like the crushing of my bones, my enemies taunt me, while they say to me all day long, “Where is your God?”
s: Like the crushing of my bones,
my enemies taunt me,
while they say to me all day long,
“Where is your God?”

PSA.42.11.t: Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why the unease within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him, my Savior and my God.
s: Why are you downcast, O my soul?
Why the unease within me?
Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him,
my Savior and my God.

PSA.46.1.t: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in times of trouble.
s: God is our refuge and strength,
an ever-present help in times of trouble.
PSA.46.1.h: For the choirmaster. Of the sons of Korah. According to Alamoth. A song.

PSA.46.2.t: Therefore we will not fear, though the earth is transformed and the mountains are toppled into the depths of the seas,
s: Therefore we will not fear,
though the earth is transformed
and the mountains are toppled
into the depths of the seas,

PSA.46.3.t: though their waters roar and foam and the mountains quake in the surge. Selah
s: though their waters roar and foam
and the mountains quake in the surge.
Selah

PSA.46.4.t: There is a river whose streams delight the city of God, the holy place where the Most High dwells.
s: There is a river whose streams delight the city of God,
the holy place where the Most High dwells.

PSA.46.5.t: God is within her; she will not be moved. God will help her when morning dawns.
s: God is within her; she will not be moved.
God will help her when morning dawns.

PSA.46.6.t: Nations rage, kingdoms crumble; the earth melts when He lifts His voice.
s: Nations rage, kingdoms crumble;
the earth melts when He lifts His voice.

PSA.46.7.t: The LORD of Hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our fortress. Selah
s: The LORD of Hosts is with us;
the God of Jacob is our fortress.
Selah

PSA.46.8.t: Come, see the works of the LORD, who brings devastation upon the earth.
s: Come, see the works of the LORD,
who brings devastation upon the earth.

PSA.46.9.t: He makes wars to cease throughout the earth; He breaks the bow and shatters the spear; He burns the shields in the fire.
s: He makes wars to cease throughout the earth;
He breaks the bow and shatters the spear;
He burns the shields in the fire.

PSA.46.10.t: “Be still and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted over the earth.”
s: “Be still and know that I am God;
I will be exalted among the nations,
I will be exalted over the earth.”

PSA.46.11.t: The LORD of Hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our fortress. Selah
s: The LORD of Hosts is with us;
the God of Jacob is our fortress.
Selah

PSA.51.1.t: Have mercy on me, O God, according to Your loving devotion; according to Your great compassion, blot out my transgressions.
s: Have mercy on me, O God,
according to Your loving devotion;
according to Your great compassion,
blot out my transgressions.
PSA.51.1.h: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. When Nathan the prophet came to him after his adultery with Bathsheba.

PSA.51.2.t: Wash me clean of my iniquity and cleanse me from my sin.
s: Wash me clean of my iniquity
and cleanse me from my sin.

PSA.51.3.t: For I know my transgressions, and my sin is always before me.
s: For I know my transgressions,
and my sin is always before me.

PSA.51.4.t: Against You, You only, have I sinned and done what is evil in Your sight, so that You may be proved right when You speak and blameless when You judge.
s: Against You, You only, have I sinned
and done what is evil in Your sight,
so that You may be proved right when You speak
and blameless when You judge.

PSA.51.5.t: Surely I was brought forth in iniquity; I was sinful when my mother conceived me.
s: Surely I was brought forth in iniquity;
I was sinful when my mother conceived me.

PSA.51.6.t: Surely You desire truth in the inmost being; You teach me wisdom in the inmost place.
s: Surely You desire truth in the inmost being;
You teach me wisdom in the inmost place.

PSA.51.7.t: Purify me with hyssop, and I will be clean; wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.
s: Purify me with hyssop, and I will be clean;
wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.

PSA.51.8.t: Let me hear joy and gladness; let the bones You have crushed rejoice.
s: Let me hear joy and gladness;
let the bones You have crushed rejoice.

PSA.51.9.t: Hide Your face from my sins and blot out all my iniquities.
s: Hide Your face from my sins
and blot out all my iniquities.

PSA.51.10.t: Create in me a clean heart, O God, and renew a right spirit within me.
s: Create in me a clean heart, O God,
and renew a right spirit within me.

PSA.55.16.t: But I call to God, and the LORD saves me.
s: But I call to God,
and the LORD saves me.

PSA.55.17.t: Morning, noon, and night, I cry out in distress, and He hears my voice.
s: Morning, noon, and night, I cry out in distress,
and He hears my voice.

PSA.55.18.t: He redeems my soul in peace from the battle waged against me, even though many oppose me.
s: He redeems my soul in peace
from the battle waged against me,
even though many oppose me.

PSA.55.19.t: God will hear and humiliate them— the One enthroned for the ages— Selah because they do not change and they have no fear of God.
s: God will hear and humiliate them—
the One enthroned for the ages—
Selah
because they do not change
and they have no fear of God.

PSA.55.20.t: My companion attacks his friends; he violates his covenant.
s: My companion attacks his friends;
he violates his covenant.

PSA.55.21.t: His speech is smooth as butter, but war is in his heart. His words are softer than oil, yet they are swords unsheathed.
s: His speech is smooth as butter,
but war is in his heart.
His words are softer than oil,
yet they are swords unsheathed.

PSA.55.22.t: Cast your burden upon the LORD and He will sustain you; He will never let the righteous be shaken.
s: Cast your burden upon the LORD
and He will sustain you;
He will never let the righteous be shaken.

PSA.56.1.t: Be merciful to me, O God, for men are hounding me; all day they press their attack.
s: Be merciful to me, O God,
for men are hounding me;
all day they press their attack.
PSA.56.1.h: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “A Dove on Distant Oaks.” A Miktam of David, when the Philistines seized him in Gath.

PSA.56.2.t: My enemies pursue me all day long, for many proudly assail me.
s: My enemies pursue me all day long,
for many proudly assail me.

PSA.56.3.t: When I am afraid, I put my trust in You.
s: When I am afraid,
I put my trust in You.

PSA.56.4.t: In God, whose word I praise— in God I trust. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
s: In God, whose word I praise—
in God I trust.
I will not be afraid.
What can man do to me?

PSA.56.5.t: All day long they twist my words; all their thoughts are on my demise.
s: All day long they twist my words;
all their thoughts are on my demise.

PSA.56.6.t: They conspire, they lurk, they watch my steps while they wait to take my life.
s: They conspire, they lurk,
they watch my steps
while they wait to take my life.

PSA.56.7.t: In spite of such sin, will they escape? In Your anger, O God, cast down the nations.
s: In spite of such sin, will they escape?
In Your anger, O God, cast down the nations.

PSA.56.8.t: You have taken account of my wanderings. Put my tears in Your bottle— are they not in Your book?
s: You have taken account of my wanderings.
Put my tears in Your bottle—
are they not in Your book?

PSA.56.9.t: Then my enemies will retreat on the day I cry for help. By this I will know that God is on my side.
s: Then my enemies will retreat
on the day I cry for help.
By this I will know that God is on my side.

PSA.56.10.t: In God, whose word I praise, in the LORD, whose word I praise,
s: In God, whose word I praise,
in the LORD, whose word I praise,

PSA.56.11.t: in God I trust; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
s: in God I trust; I will not be afraid.
What can man do to me?

PSA.56.12.t: Your vows are upon me, O God; I will render thank offerings to You.
s: Your vows are upon me, O God;
I will render thank offerings to You.

PSA.56.13.t: For You have delivered my soul from death, and my feet from stumbling, that I may walk before God in the light of life.
s: For You have delivered my soul from death,
and my feet from stumbling,
that I may walk before God
in the light of life.

PSA.57.1.t: Have mercy on me, O God, have mercy, for in You my soul takes refuge. In the shadow of Your wings I will take shelter until the danger has passed.
s: Have mercy on me, O God, have mercy,
for in You my soul takes refuge.
In the shadow of Your wings I will take shelter
until the danger has passed.
PSA.57.1.h: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A Miktam of David, when he fled from Saul into the cave.

PSA.57.2.t: I cry out to God Most High, to God who fulfills His purpose for me.
s: I cry out to God Most High,
to God who fulfills His purpose for me.

PSA.57.3.t: He reaches down from heaven and saves me; He rebukes those who trample me. Selah God sends forth His loving devotion and His truth.
s: He reaches down from heaven and saves me;
He rebukes those who trample me.
Selah
God sends forth
His loving devotion and His truth.

PSA.57.4.t: My soul is among the lions; I lie down with ravenous beasts— with men whose teeth are spears and arrows, whose tongues are sharp swords.
s: My soul is among the lions;
I lie down with ravenous beasts—
with men whose teeth are spears and arrows,
whose tongues are sharp swords.

PSA.57.5.t: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; may Your glory cover all the earth.
s: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens;
may Your glory cover all the earth.

PSA.57.6.t: They spread a net for my feet; my soul was despondent. They dug a pit before me, but they themselves have fallen into it! Selah
s: They spread a net for my feet;
my soul was despondent.
They dug a pit before me,
but they themselves have fallen into it!
Selah

PSA.57.7.t: My heart is steadfast, O God, my heart is steadfast. I will sing and make music.
s: My heart is steadfast, O God, my heart is steadfast.
I will sing and make music.

PSA.61.1.t: Hear my cry, O God; attend to my prayer.
s: Hear my cry, O God;
attend to my prayer.
PSA.61.1.h: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. Of David.

PSA.61.2.t: From the ends of the earth I call out to You whenever my heart is faint. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
s: From the ends of the earth I call out to You
whenever my heart is faint.
Lead me to the rock
that is higher than I.

PSA.61.3.t: For You have been my refuge, a tower of strength against the enemy.
s: For You have been my refuge,
a tower of strength against the enemy.

PSA.61.4.t: Let me dwell in Your tent forever and take refuge in the shelter of Your wings. Selah
s: Let me dwell in Your tent forever
and take refuge in the shelter of Your wings.
Selah

PSA.61.5.t: For You have heard my vows, O God; You have given me the inheritance reserved for those who fear Your name.
s: For You have heard my vows, O God;
You have given me the inheritance
reserved for those who fear Your name.

PSA.61.6.t: Increase the days of the king’s life; may his years span many generations.
s: Increase the days of the king’s life;
may his years span many generations.

PSA.61.7.t: May he sit enthroned in God’s presence forever; appoint Your loving devotion and Your faithfulness to guard him.
s: May he sit enthroned in God’s presence forever;
appoint Your loving devotion
and Your faithfulness to guard him.

PSA.61.8.t: Then I will ever sing praise to Your name and fulfill my vows day by day.
s: Then I will ever sing praise to Your name
and fulfill my vows day by day.

PSA.62.1.t: In God alone my soul finds rest; my salvation comes from Him.
s: In God alone my soul finds rest;
my salvation comes from Him.
PSA.62.1.h: For the choirmaster. According to Jeduthun. A Psalm of David.

PSA.62.2.t: He alone is my rock and my salvation. He is my fortress; I will never be shaken.
s: He alone is my rock and my salvation.
He is my fortress;
I will never be shaken.

PSA.62.3.t: How long will you threaten a man? Will all of you throw him down like a leaning wall or a tottering fence?
s: How long will you threaten a man?
Will all of you throw him down
like a leaning wall
or a tottering fence?

PSA.62.4.t: They fully intend to cast him down from his lofty perch; they delight in lies; with their mouths they bless, but inwardly they curse. Selah
s: They fully intend to cast him down from his lofty perch;
they delight in lies;
with their mouths they bless,
but inwardly they curse.
Selah

PSA.62.5.t: Rest in God alone, O my soul, for my hope comes from Him.
s: Rest in God alone, O my soul,
for my hope comes from Him.

PSA.62.6.t: He alone is my rock and my salvation; He is my fortress; I will not be shaken.
s: He alone is my rock and my salvation;
He is my fortress; I will not be shaken.

PSA.62.7.t: My salvation and my honor rest on God, my strong rock; my refuge is in God.
s: My salvation and my honor rest on God, my strong rock;
my refuge is in God.

PSA.62.8.t: Trust in Him at all times, O people; pour out your hearts before Him. God is our refuge. Selah
s: Trust in Him at all times, O people;
pour out your hearts before Him.
God is our refuge.
Selah

PSA.62.9.t: Lowborn men are but a vapor, the exalted but a lie. Weighed on the scale, they go up; together they are but a vapor.
s: Lowborn men are but a vapor,
the exalted but a lie.
Weighed on the scale, they go up;
together they are but a vapor.

PSA.62.10.t: Place no trust in extortion, or false hope in stolen goods. If your riches increase, do not set your heart upon them.
s: Place no trust in extortion,
or false hope in stolen goods.
If your riches increase,
do not set your heart upon them.

PSA.62.11.t: God has spoken once; I have heard this twice: that power belongs to God,
s: God has spoken once;
I have heard this twice:
that power belongs to God,

PSA.62.12.t: and loving devotion to You, O Lord. For You will repay each man according to his deeds.
s: and loving devotion to You, O Lord.
For You will repay each man
according to his deeds.

PSA.63.1.t: O God, You are my God. Earnestly I seek You; my soul thirsts for You. My body yearns for You in a dry and weary land without water.
s: O God, You are my God.
Earnestly I seek You;
my soul thirsts for You.
My body yearns for You
in a dry and weary land without water.
PSA.63.1.h: A Psalm of David, when he was in the Wilderness of Judah.

PSA.63.2.t: So I have seen You in the sanctuary and beheld Your power and glory.
s: So I have seen You in the sanctuary
and beheld Your power and glory.

PSA.63.3.t: Because Your loving devotion is better than life, my lips will glorify You.
s: Because Your loving devotion is better than life,
my lips will glorify You.

PSA.63.4.t: So I will bless You as long as I live; in Your name I will lift my hands.
s: So I will bless You as long as I live;
in Your name I will lift my hands.

PSA.63.5.t: My soul is satisfied as with the richest of foods; with joyful lips my mouth will praise You.
s: My soul is satisfied as with the richest of foods;
with joyful lips my mouth will praise You.

PSA.63.6.t: When I remember You on my bed, I think of You through the watches of the night.
s: When I remember You on my bed,
I think of You through the watches of the night.

PSA.63.7.t: For You are my help; I will sing for joy in the shadow of Your wings.
s: For You are my help;
I will sing for joy in the shadow of Your wings.

PSA.63.8.t: My soul clings to You; Your right hand upholds me.
s: My soul clings to You;
Your right hand upholds me.

PSA.65.9.t: You attend to the earth and water it; with abundance You enrich it. The streams of God are full of water, for You prepare our grain by providing for the earth.
s: You attend to the earth and water it;
with abundance You enrich it.
The streams of God are full of water,
for You prepare our grain
by providing for the earth.

PSA.65.10.t: You soak its furrows and level its ridges; You soften it with showers and bless its growth.
s: You soak its furrows and level its ridges;
You soften it with showers and bless its growth.

PSA.65.11.t: You crown the year with Your bounty, and Your paths overflow with plenty.
s: You crown the year with Your bounty,
and Your paths overflow with plenty.

PSA.65.12.t: The pastures of the wilderness overflow; the hills are robed with joy.
s: The pastures of the wilderness overflow;
the hills are robed with joy.

PSA.65.13.t: The pastures are clothed with flocks, and the valleys are decked with grain. They shout in triumph; indeed, they sing.
s: The pastures are clothed with flocks,
and the valleys are decked with grain.
They shout in triumph;
indeed, they sing.

PSA.68.3.t: But the righteous will be glad and rejoice before God; they will celebrate with joy.
s: But the righteous will be glad
and rejoice before God;
they will celebrate with joy.

PSA.68.4.t: Sing to God! Sing praises to His name. Exalt Him who rides on the clouds — His name is the LORD— and rejoice before Him.
s: Sing to God!
Sing praises to His name.
Exalt Him who rides on the clouds —
His name is the LORD—
and rejoice before Him.

PSA.68.5.t: A father of the fatherless, and a defender of the widows, is God in His holy habitation.
s: A father of the fatherless,
and a defender of the widows,
is God in His holy habitation.

PSA.68.6.t: God settles the lonely in families; He leads the prisoners out to prosperity, but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.
s: God settles the lonely in families;
He leads the prisoners out to prosperity,
but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.

PSA.68.7.t: O God, when You went out before Your people, when You marched through the wasteland, Selah
s: O God, when You went out before Your people,
when You marched through the wasteland,
Selah

PSA.68.8.t: the earth shook and the heavens poured down rain before God, the One on Sinai, before God, the God of Israel.
s: the earth shook and the heavens poured down rain
before God, the One on Sinai,
before God, the God of Israel.

PSA.68.9.t: You sent abundant rain, O God; You refreshed Your weary inheritance.
s: You sent abundant rain, O God;
You refreshed Your weary inheritance.

PSA.68.10.t: Your flock settled therein; O God, from Your bounty You provided for the poor.
s: Your flock settled therein;
O God, from Your bounty You provided for the poor.

PSA.68.15.t: A mountain of God is Mount Bashan; a mountain of many peaks is Mount Bashan.
s: A mountain of God is Mount Bashan;
a mountain of many peaks is Mount Bashan.

PSA.68.16.t: Why do you gaze in envy, O mountains of many peaks? This is the mountain God chose for His dwelling, where the LORD will surely dwell forever.
s: Why do you gaze in envy, O mountains of many peaks?
This is the mountain God chose for His dwelling,
where the LORD will surely dwell forever.

PSA.68.17.t: The chariots of God are tens of thousands— thousands of thousands are they; the Lord is in His sanctuary as He was at Sinai.
s: The chariots of God are tens of thousands—
thousands of thousands are they;
the Lord is in His sanctuary
as He was at Sinai.

PSA.68.18.t: You have ascended on high; You have led captives away. You have received gifts from men, even from the rebellious, that the LORD God may dwell there.
s: You have ascended on high;
You have led captives away.
You have received gifts from men,
even from the rebellious,
that the LORD God may dwell there.

PSA.68.19.t: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burden, the God of our salvation. Selah
s: Blessed be the Lord,
who daily bears our burden,
the God of our salvation.
Selah

PSA.68.20.t: Our God is a God of deliverance; the Lord GOD is our rescuer from death.
s: Our God is a God of deliverance;
the Lord GOD is our rescuer from death.

PSA.71.1.t: In You, O LORD, I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame.
s: In You, O LORD, I have taken refuge;
let me never be put to shame.

PSA.71.2.t: In Your justice, rescue and deliver me; incline Your ear and save me.
s: In Your justice, rescue and deliver me;
incline Your ear and save me.

PSA.71.3.t: Be my rock of refuge, where I can always go. Give the command to save me, for You are my rock and my fortress.
s: Be my rock of refuge,
where I can always go.
Give the command to save me,
for You are my rock and my fortress.

PSA.71.4.t: Deliver me, O my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the grasp of the unjust and ruthless.
s: Deliver me, O my God, from the hand of the wicked,
from the grasp of the unjust and ruthless.

PSA.71.5.t: For You are my hope, O Lord GOD, my confidence from my youth.
s: For You are my hope, O Lord GOD,
my confidence from my youth.

PSA.71.6.t: I have leaned on You since birth; You pulled me from my mother’s womb. My praise is always for You.
s: I have leaned on You since birth;
You pulled me from my mother’s womb.
My praise is always for You.

PSA.71.7.t: I have become a portent to many, but You are my strong refuge.
s: I have become a portent to many,
but You are my strong refuge.

PSA.71.8.t: My mouth is filled with Your praise and with Your splendor all day long.
s: My mouth is filled with Your praise
and with Your splendor all day long.

PSA.71.9.t: Do not discard me in my old age; do not forsake me when my strength fails.
s: Do not discard me in my old age;
do not forsake me when my strength fails.

PSA.73.21.t: When my heart was grieved and I was pierced within,
s: When my heart was grieved
and I was pierced within,

PSA.73.22.t: I was senseless and ignorant; I was a brute beast before You.
s: I was senseless and ignorant;
I was a brute beast before You.

PSA.73.23.t: Yet I am always with You; You hold my right hand.
s: Yet I am always with You;
You hold my right hand.

PSA.73.24.t: You guide me with Your counsel, and later receive me in glory.
s: You guide me with Your counsel,
and later receive me in glory.

PSA.73.25.t: Whom have I in heaven but You? And on earth I desire no one besides You.
s: Whom have I in heaven but You?
And on earth I desire no one besides You.

PSA.73.26.t: My flesh and my heart may fail, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
s: My flesh and my heart may fail,
but God is the strength of my heart
and my portion forever.

PSA.73.27.t: Those far from You will surely perish; You destroy all who are unfaithful to You.
s: Those far from You will surely perish;
You destroy all who are unfaithful to You.

PSA.73.28.t: But as for me, it is good to draw near to God. I have made the Lord GOD my refuge, that I may proclaim all Your works.
s: But as for me, it is good to draw near to God.
I have made the Lord GOD my refuge,
that I may proclaim all Your works.

PSA.74.12.t: Yet God is my King from ancient times, working salvation on the earth.
s: Yet God is my King from ancient times,
working salvation on the earth.

PSA.74.13.t: You divided the sea by Your strength; You smashed the heads of the dragons of the sea;
s: You divided the sea by Your strength;
You smashed the heads of the dragons of the sea;

PSA.74.14.t: You crushed the heads of Leviathan; You fed him to the creatures of the desert.
s: You crushed the heads of Leviathan;
You fed him to the creatures of the desert.

PSA.74.15.t: You broke open the fountain and the flood; You dried up the ever-flowing rivers.
s: You broke open the fountain and the flood;
You dried up the ever-flowing rivers.

PSA.74.16.t: The day is Yours, and also the night; You established the moon and the sun.
s: The day is Yours, and also the night;
You established the moon and the sun.

PSA.74.17.t: You set all the boundaries of the earth; You made the summer and winter.
s: You set all the boundaries of the earth;
You made the summer and winter.

PSA.78.1.t: Give ear, O my people, to my instruction; listen to the words of my mouth.
s: Give ear, O my people, to my instruction;
listen to the words of my mouth.

PSA.78.2.t: I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things hidden from the beginning,
s: I will open my mouth in parables;
I will utter things hidden from the beginning,

PSA.78.3.t: that we have heard and known and our fathers have relayed to us.
s: that we have heard and known
and our fathers have relayed to us.

PSA.78.4.t: We will not hide them from their children, but will declare to the next generation the praises of the LORD and His might, and the wonders He has performed.
s: We will not hide them from their children,
but will declare to the next generation
the praises of the LORD and His might,
and the wonders He has performed.

PSA.78.5.t: For He established a testimony in Jacob and appointed a law in Israel, which He commanded our fathers to teach to their children,
s: For He established a testimony in Jacob
and appointed a law in Israel,
which He commanded our fathers
to teach to their children,

PSA.78.6.t: that the coming generation would know them— even children yet to be born— to arise and tell their own children
s: that the coming generation would know them—
even children yet to be born—
to arise and tell their own children

PSA.78.7.t: that they should put their confidence in God, not forgetting His works, but keeping His commandments.
s: that they should put their confidence in God,
not forgetting His works,
but keeping His commandments.

PSA.85.1.t: You showed favor to Your land, O LORD; You restored Jacob from captivity.
s: You showed favor to Your land, O LORD;
You restored Jacob from captivity.
PSA.85.1.h: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of the sons of Korah.

PSA.85.2.t: You forgave the iniquity of Your people; You covered all their sin. Selah
s: You forgave the iniquity of Your people;
You covered all their sin.
Selah

PSA.85.3.t: You withheld all Your fury; You turned from Your burning anger.
s: You withheld all Your fury;
You turned from Your burning anger.

PSA.85.4.t: Restore us, O God of our salvation, and put away Your displeasure toward us.
s: Restore us, O God of our salvation,
and put away Your displeasure toward us.

PSA.85.5.t: Will You be angry with us forever? Will You draw out Your anger to all generations?
s: Will You be angry with us forever?
Will You draw out Your anger to all generations?

PSA.85.6.t: Will You not revive us again, that Your people may rejoice in You?
s: Will You not revive us again,
that Your people may rejoice in You?

PSA.85.7.t: Show us Your loving devotion, O LORD, and grant us Your salvation.
s: Show us Your loving devotion, O LORD,
and grant us Your salvation.

PSA.85.8.t: I will listen to what God the LORD will say; for He will surely speak peace to His people and His saints; He will not let them return to folly.
s: I will listen to what God the LORD will say;
for He will surely speak peace to His people and His saints;
He will not let them return to folly.

PSA.85.9.t: Surely His salvation is near to those who fear Him, that His glory may dwell in our land.
s: Surely His salvation is near to those who fear Him,
that His glory may dwell in our land.

PSA.85.10.t: Loving devotion and faithfulness have joined together; righteousness and peace have kissed.
s: Loving devotion and faithfulness have joined together;
righteousness and peace have kissed.

PSA.85.11.t: Faithfulness sprouts from the earth, and righteousness looks down from heaven.
s: Faithfulness sprouts from the earth,
and righteousness looks down from heaven.

PSA.85.12.t: The LORD will indeed provide what is good, and our land will yield its increase.
s: The LORD will indeed provide what is good,
and our land will yield its increase.

PSA.85.13.t: Righteousness will go before Him to prepare the way for His steps.
s: Righteousness will go before Him
to prepare the way for His steps.

PSA.86.1.t: Incline Your ear, O LORD, and answer me, for I am poor and needy.
s: Incline Your ear, O LORD, and answer me,
for I am poor and needy.

PSA.86.2.t: Preserve my soul, for I am godly. You are my God; save Your servant who trusts in You.
s: Preserve my soul, for I am godly.
You are my God; save Your servant who trusts in You.

PSA.86.3.t: Be merciful to me, O Lord, for I call to You all day long.
s: Be merciful to me, O Lord,
for I call to You all day long.

PSA.86.4.t: Bring joy to Your servant, for to You, O Lord, I lift up my soul.
s: Bring joy to Your servant,
for to You, O Lord, I lift up my soul.

PSA.86.5.t: For You, O Lord, are kind and forgiving, rich in loving devotion to all who call on You.
s: For You, O Lord, are kind and forgiving,
rich in loving devotion to all who call on You.

PSA.86.6.t: Hear my prayer, O LORD, and attend to my plea for mercy.
s: Hear my prayer, O LORD,
and attend to my plea for mercy.

PSA.86.7.t: In the day of my distress I call on You, because You answer me.
s: In the day of my distress I call on You,
because You answer me.

PSA.86.8.t: O Lord, there is none like You among the gods, nor any works like Yours.
s: O Lord, there is none like You among the gods,
nor any works like Yours.

PSA.86.9.t: All the nations You have made will come and bow before You, O Lord, and they will glorify Your name.
s: All the nations You have made
will come and bow before You, O Lord,
and they will glorify Your name.

PSA.86.10.t: For You are great and perform wonders; You alone are God.
s: For You are great and perform wonders;
You alone are God.

PSA.86.11.t: Teach me Your way, O LORD, that I may walk in Your truth. Give me an undivided heart, that I may fear Your name.
s: Teach me Your way, O LORD,
that I may walk in Your truth.
Give me an undivided heart,
that I may fear Your name.

PSA.86.12.t: I will praise You, O Lord my God, with all my heart; I will glorify Your name forever.
s: I will praise You, O Lord my God, with all my heart;
I will glorify Your name forever.

PSA.86.13.t: For great is Your loving devotion to me; You have delivered me from the depths of Sheol.
s: For great is Your loving devotion to me;
You have delivered me from the depths of Sheol.

PSA.88.1.t: O LORD, the God of my salvation, day and night I cry out before You.
s: O LORD, the God of my salvation,
day and night I cry out before You.
PSA.88.1.h: A song. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. For the choirmaster. According to Mahalath Leannoth. A Maskil of Heman the Ezrahite.
