PSA.88.2.t: May my prayer come before You; incline Your ear to my cry.
s: May my prayer come before You;
incline Your ear to my cry.

PSA.88.3.t: For my soul is full of troubles, and my life draws near to Sheol.
s: For my soul is full of troubles,
and my life draws near to Sheol.

PSA.88.4.t: I am counted among those descending to the Pit. I am like a man without strength.
s: I am counted among those descending to the Pit.
I am like a man without strength.

PSA.88.5.t: I am forsaken among the dead, like the slain who lie in the grave, whom You remember no more, who are cut off from Your care.
s: I am forsaken among the dead,
like the slain who lie in the grave,
whom You remember no more,
who are cut off from Your care.

PSA.88.6.t: You have laid me in the lowest Pit, in the darkest of the depths.
s: You have laid me in the lowest Pit,
in the darkest of the depths.

PSA.88.7.t: Your wrath weighs heavily upon me; all Your waves have submerged me. Selah
s: Your wrath weighs heavily upon me;
all Your waves have submerged me.
Selah

PSA.88.8.t: You have removed my friends from me; You have made me repulsive to them; I am confined and cannot escape.
s: You have removed my friends from me;
You have made me repulsive to them;
I am confined and cannot escape.

PSA.88.9.t: My eyes grow dim with grief. I call to You daily, O LORD; I spread out my hands to You.
s: My eyes grow dim with grief.
I call to You daily, O LORD;
I spread out my hands to You.

PSA.88.10.t: Do You work wonders for the dead? Do departed spirits rise up to praise You? Selah
s: Do You work wonders for the dead?
Do departed spirits rise up to praise You?
Selah

PSA.88.11.t: Can Your loving devotion be proclaimed in the grave, Your faithfulness in Abaddon ?
s: Can Your loving devotion be proclaimed in the grave,
Your faithfulness in Abaddon ?

PSA.88.12.t: Will Your wonders be known in the darkness, or Your righteousness in the land of oblivion?
s: Will Your wonders be known in the darkness,
or Your righteousness in the land of oblivion?

PSA.88.13.t: But to You, O LORD, I cry for help; in the morning my prayer comes before You.
s: But to You, O LORD, I cry for help;
in the morning my prayer comes before You.

PSA.88.14.t: Why, O LORD, do You reject me? Why do You hide Your face from me?
s: Why, O LORD, do You reject me?
Why do You hide Your face from me?

PSA.88.15.t: From my youth I was afflicted and near death. I have borne Your terrors; I am in despair.
s: From my youth I was afflicted and near death.
I have borne Your terrors; I am in despair.

PSA.88.16.t: Your wrath has swept over me; Your terrors have destroyed me.
s: Your wrath has swept over me;
Your terrors have destroyed me.

PSA.88.17.t: All day long they engulf me like water; they enclose me on every side.
s: All day long they engulf me like water;
they enclose me on every side.

PSA.88.18.t: You have removed my beloved and my friend; darkness is my closest companion.
s: You have removed my beloved and my friend;
darkness is my closest companion.

PSA.90.1.t: Lord, You have been our dwelling place through all generations.
s: Lord, You have been our dwelling place
through all generations.
PSA.90.1.h: A prayer of Moses the man of God.

PSA.90.2.t: Before the mountains were born or You brought forth the earth and the world, from everlasting to everlasting You are God.
s: Before the mountains were born
or You brought forth the earth and the world,
from everlasting to everlasting
You are God.

PSA.90.3.t: You return man to dust, saying, “Return, O sons of mortals.”
s: You return man to dust,
saying, “Return, O sons of mortals.”

PSA.90.4.t: For in Your sight a thousand years are but a day that passes, or a watch of the night.
s: For in Your sight a thousand years
are but a day that passes,
or a watch of the night.

PSA.90.5.t: You whisk them away in their sleep; they are like the new grass of the morning—
s: You whisk them away in their sleep;
they are like the new grass of the morning—

PSA.90.6.t: in the morning it springs up new, but by evening it fades and withers.
s: in the morning it springs up new,
but by evening it fades and withers.

PSA.90.7.t: For we are consumed by Your anger and terrified by Your wrath.
s: For we are consumed by Your anger
and terrified by Your wrath.

PSA.90.8.t: You have set our iniquities before You, our secret sins in the light of Your presence.
s: You have set our iniquities before You,
our secret sins in the light of Your presence.

PSA.90.9.t: For all our days decline in Your fury; we finish our years with a sigh.
s: For all our days decline in Your fury;
we finish our years with a sigh.

PSA.90.10.t: The length of our days is seventy years— or eighty if we are strong— yet their pride is but labor and sorrow, for they quickly pass, and we fly away.
s: The length of our days is seventy years—
or eighty if we are strong—
yet their pride is but labor and sorrow,
for they quickly pass, and we fly away.

PSA.90.11.t: Who knows the power of Your anger? Your wrath matches the fear You are due.
s: Who knows the power of Your anger?
Your wrath matches the fear You are due.

PSA.90.12.t: So teach us to number our days, that we may present a heart of wisdom.
s: So teach us to number our days,
that we may present a heart of wisdom.

PSA.90.13.t: Return, O LORD! How long will it be? Have compassion on Your servants.
s: Return, O LORD! How long will it be?
Have compassion on Your servants.

PSA.90.14.t: Satisfy us in the morning with Your loving devotion, that we may sing for joy and be glad all our days.
s: Satisfy us in the morning with Your loving devotion,
that we may sing for joy and be glad all our days.

PSA.90.15.t: Make us glad for as many days as You have afflicted us, for as many years as we have seen evil.
s: Make us glad for as many days as You have afflicted us,
for as many years as we have seen evil.

PSA.90.16.t: May Your work be shown to Your servants, and Your splendor to their children.
s: May Your work be shown to Your servants,
and Your splendor to their children.

PSA.90.17.t: May the favor of the Lord our God rest upon us; establish for us the work of our hands— yes, establish the work of our hands!
s: May the favor of the Lord our God rest upon us;
establish for us the work of our hands—
yes, establish the work of our hands!

PSA.91.1.t: He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High will abide in the shadow of the Almighty.
s: He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High
will abide in the shadow of the Almighty.

PSA.91.2.t: I will say to the LORD, “You are my refuge and my fortress, my God, in whom I trust.”
s: I will say to the LORD, “You are my refuge and my fortress,
my God, in whom I trust.”

PSA.91.3.t: Surely He will deliver you from the snare of the fowler, and from the deadly plague.
s: Surely He will deliver you
from the snare of the fowler,
and from the deadly plague.

PSA.91.4.t: He will cover you with His feathers; under His wings you will find refuge; His faithfulness is a shield and rampart.
s: He will cover you with His feathers;
under His wings you will find refuge;
His faithfulness is a shield and rampart.

PSA.92.1.t: It is good to praise the LORD, and to sing praises to Your name, O Most High,
s: It is good to praise the LORD,
and to sing praises to Your name, O Most High,
PSA.92.1.h: A Psalm. A song for the Sabbath day.

PSA.92.2.t: to proclaim Your loving devotion in the morning and Your faithfulness at night
s: to proclaim Your loving devotion in the morning
and Your faithfulness at night

PSA.92.3.t: with the ten-stringed harp and the melody of the lyre.
s: with the ten-stringed harp
and the melody of the lyre.

PSA.92.4.t: For You, O LORD, have made me glad by Your deeds; I sing for joy at the works of Your hands.
s: For You, O LORD, have made me glad by Your deeds;
I sing for joy at the works of Your hands.

PSA.92.5.t: How great are Your works, O LORD, how deep are Your thoughts!
s: How great are Your works, O LORD,
how deep are Your thoughts!

PSA.92.12.t: The righteous will flourish like a palm tree, and grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
s: The righteous will flourish like a palm tree,
and grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

PSA.92.13.t: Planted in the house of the LORD, they will flourish in the courts of our God.
s: Planted in the house of the LORD,
they will flourish in the courts of our God.

PSA.92.14.t: In old age they will still bear fruit; healthy and green they will remain,
s: In old age they will still bear fruit;
healthy and green they will remain,

PSA.92.15.t: to proclaim, “The LORD is upright; He is my Rock, and in Him there is no unrighteousness.”
s: to proclaim, “The LORD is upright; He is my Rock,
and in Him there is no unrighteousness.”

PSA.94.16.t: Who will rise up for me against the wicked? Who will stand for me against the workers of iniquity?
s: Who will rise up for me against the wicked?
Who will stand for me against the workers of iniquity?

PSA.94.17.t: Unless the LORD had been my helper, I would soon have dwelt in the abode of silence.
s: Unless the LORD had been my helper,
I would soon have dwelt in the abode of silence.

PSA.94.18.t: If I say, “My foot is slipping,” Your loving devotion, O LORD, supports me.
s: If I say, “My foot is slipping,”
Your loving devotion, O LORD, supports me.

PSA.94.19.t: When anxiety overwhelms me, Your consolation delights my soul.
s: When anxiety overwhelms me,
Your consolation delights my soul.

PSA.94.20.t: Can a corrupt throne be Your ally— one devising mischief by decree?
s: Can a corrupt throne be Your ally—
one devising mischief by decree?

PSA.94.21.t: They band together against the righteous and condemn the innocent to death.
s: They band together against the righteous
and condemn the innocent to death.

PSA.94.22.t: But the LORD has been my stronghold, and my God is my rock of refuge.
s: But the LORD has been my stronghold,
and my God is my rock of refuge.

PSA.100.1.t: Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth.
s: Make a joyful noise to the LORD,
all the earth.

PSA.100.2.t: Serve the LORD with gladness; come into His presence with joyful songs.
s: Serve the LORD with gladness;
come into His presence with joyful songs.

PSA.100.3.t: Know that the LORD is God. It is He who made us, and we are His; we are His people, and the sheep of His pasture.
s: Know that the LORD is God.
It is He who made us, and we are His;
we are His people, and the sheep of His pasture.

PSA.100.4.t: Enter His gates with thanksgiving and His courts with praise; give thanks to Him and bless His name.
s: Enter His gates with thanksgiving
and His courts with praise;
give thanks to Him and bless His name.

PSA.100.5.t: For the LORD is good, and His loving devotion endures forever; His faithfulness continues to all generations.
s: For the LORD is good,
and His loving devotion endures forever;
His faithfulness continues to all generations.

PSA.101.1.t: I will sing of Your loving devotion and justice; to You, O LORD, I will sing praises.
s: I will sing of Your loving devotion and justice;
to You, O LORD, I will sing praises.

PSA.101.2.t: I will ponder the way that is blameless— when will You come to me? I will walk in my house with integrity of heart.
s: I will ponder the way that is blameless—
when will You come to me?
I will walk in my house
with integrity of heart.

PSA.101.3.t: I will set no worthless thing before my eyes. I hate the work of those who fall away; it shall not cling to me.
s: I will set no worthless thing
before my eyes.
I hate the work of those who fall away;
it shall not cling to me.

PSA.101.4.t: A perverse heart shall depart from me; I will know nothing of evil.
s: A perverse heart shall depart from me;
I will know nothing of evil.

PSA.101.5.t: Whoever slanders his neighbor in secret, I will put to silence; the one with haughty eyes and a proud heart, I will not endure.
s: Whoever slanders his neighbor in secret,
I will put to silence;
the one with haughty eyes and a proud heart,
I will not endure.

PSA.101.6.t: My eyes favor the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me; he who walks in the way of integrity shall minister to me.
s: My eyes favor the faithful of the land,
that they may dwell with me;
he who walks in the way of integrity
shall minister to me.

PSA.101.7.t: No one who practices deceit shall dwell in my house; no one who tells lies shall stand in my presence.
s: No one who practices deceit
shall dwell in my house;
no one who tells lies
shall stand in my presence.

PSA.101.8.t: Every morning I will remove all the wicked of the land, that I may cut off every evildoer from the city of the LORD.
s: Every morning I will remove all the wicked of the land,
that I may cut off every evildoer from the city of the LORD.

PSA.102.1.t: Hear my prayer, O LORD; let my cry for help come before You.
s: Hear my prayer, O LORD;
let my cry for help come before You.
PSA.102.1.h: A prayer of one who is afflicted, when he grows faint and pours out his lament before the LORD.

PSA.102.2.t: Do not hide Your face from me in my day of distress. Incline Your ear to me; answer me quickly when I call.
s: Do not hide Your face from me
in my day of distress.
Incline Your ear to me;
answer me quickly when I call.

PSA.102.3.t: For my days vanish like smoke, and my bones burn like glowing embers.
s: For my days vanish like smoke,
and my bones burn like glowing embers.

PSA.102.4.t: My heart is afflicted, and withered like grass; I even forget to eat my bread.
s: My heart is afflicted, and withered like grass;
I even forget to eat my bread.

PSA.102.5.t: Through my loud groaning my flesh clings to my bones.
s: Through my loud groaning
my flesh clings to my bones.

PSA.102.6.t: I am like a desert owl, like an owl among the ruins.
s: I am like a desert owl,
like an owl among the ruins.

PSA.102.7.t: I lie awake; I am like a lone bird on a housetop.
s: I lie awake;
I am like a lone bird on a housetop.

PSA.102.8.t: All day long my enemies taunt me; they ridicule me and curse me.
s: All day long my enemies taunt me;
they ridicule me and curse me.

PSA.102.9.t: For I have eaten ashes like bread and mixed my drink with tears
s: For I have eaten ashes like bread
and mixed my drink with tears

PSA.102.10.t: because of Your indignation and wrath, for You have picked me up and cast me aside.
s: because of Your indignation and wrath,
for You have picked me up and cast me aside.

PSA.102.11.t: My days are like lengthening shadows, and I wither away like grass.
s: My days are like lengthening shadows,
and I wither away like grass.

PSA.102.12.t: But You, O LORD, sit enthroned forever; Your renown endures to all generations.
s: But You, O LORD, sit enthroned forever;
Your renown endures to all generations.

PSA.102.24.t: I say: “O my God, do not take me in the midst of my days! Your years go on through all generations.
s: I say: “O my God, do not take me in the midst of my days!
Your years go on through all generations.

PSA.102.25.t: In the beginning You laid the foundations of the earth, and the heavens are the work of Your hands.
s: In the beginning You laid the foundations of the earth,
and the heavens are the work of Your hands.

PSA.102.26.t: They will perish, but You remain; they will all wear out like a garment. Like clothing You will change them, and they will be passed on.
s: They will perish, but You remain;
they will all wear out like a garment.
Like clothing You will change them,
and they will be passed on.

PSA.102.27.t: But You remain the same, and Your years will never end.
s: But You remain the same,
and Your years will never end.

PSA.102.28.t: The children of Your servants will dwell securely, and their descendants will be established before You.”
s: The children of Your servants will dwell securely,
and their descendants will be established before You.”

PSA.103.1.t: Bless the LORD, O my soul; all that is within me, bless His holy name.
s: Bless the LORD, O my soul;
all that is within me, bless His holy name.

PSA.103.2.t: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and do not forget all His kind deeds—
s: Bless the LORD, O my soul,
and do not forget all His kind deeds—

PSA.103.3.t: He who forgives all your iniquities and heals all your diseases,
s: He who forgives all your iniquities
and heals all your diseases,

PSA.103.4.t: who redeems your life from the Pit and crowns you with loving devotion and compassion,
s: who redeems your life from the Pit
and crowns you with loving devotion and compassion,

PSA.103.5.t: who satisfies you with good things, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.
s: who satisfies you with good things,
so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.

PSA.103.8.t: The LORD is compassionate and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion.
s: The LORD is compassionate and gracious,
slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion.

PSA.103.9.t: He will not always accuse us, nor harbor His anger forever.
s: He will not always accuse us,
nor harbor His anger forever.

PSA.103.10.t: He has not dealt with us according to our sins or repaid us according to our iniquities.
s: He has not dealt with us according to our sins
or repaid us according to our iniquities.

PSA.103.11.t: For as high as the heavens are above the earth, so great is His loving devotion for those who fear Him.
s: For as high as the heavens are above the earth,
so great is His loving devotion for those who fear Him.

PSA.103.12.t: As far as the east is from the west, so far has He removed our transgressions from us.
s: As far as the east is from the west,
so far has He removed our transgressions from us.

PSA.103.13.t: As a father has compassion on his children, so the LORD has compassion on those who fear Him.
s: As a father has compassion on his children,
so the LORD has compassion on those who fear Him.

PSA.103.14.t: For He knows our frame; He is mindful that we are dust.
s: For He knows our frame;
He is mindful that we are dust.

PSA.103.15.t: As for man, his days are like grass— he blooms like a flower of the field;
s: As for man, his days are like grass—
he blooms like a flower of the field;

PSA.103.16.t: when the wind passes over, it vanishes, and its place remembers it no more.
s: when the wind passes over, it vanishes,
and its place remembers it no more.

PSA.103.17.t: But from everlasting to everlasting the loving devotion of the LORD extends to those who fear Him, and His righteousness to their children’s children—
s: But from everlasting to everlasting
the loving devotion of the LORD
extends to those who fear Him,
and His righteousness to their children’s children—

PSA.103.18.t: to those who keep His covenant and remember to obey His precepts.
s: to those who keep His covenant
and remember to obey His precepts.

PSA.107.23.t: Others went out to sea in ships, conducting trade on the mighty waters.
s: Others went out to sea in ships,
conducting trade on the mighty waters.

PSA.107.24.t: They saw the works of the LORD, and His wonders in the deep.
s: They saw the works of the LORD,
and His wonders in the deep.

PSA.107.25.t: For He spoke and raised a tempest that lifted the waves of the sea.
s: For He spoke and raised a tempest
that lifted the waves of the sea.

PSA.107.26.t: They mounted up to the heavens, then sunk to the depths; their courage melted in their anguish.
s: They mounted up to the heavens, then sunk to the depths;
their courage melted in their anguish.

PSA.107.27.t: They reeled and staggered like drunkards, and all their skill was useless.
s: They reeled and staggered like drunkards,
and all their skill was useless.

PSA.107.28.t: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He brought them out of their distress.
s: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble,
and He brought them out of their distress.

PSA.107.29.t: He calmed the storm to a whisper, and the waves of the sea were hushed.
s: He calmed the storm to a whisper,
and the waves of the sea were hushed.

PSA.107.30.t: They rejoiced in the silence, and He guided them to the harbor they desired.
s: They rejoiced in the silence,
and He guided them to the harbor they desired.

PSA.107.31.t: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.
s: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion
and His wonders to the sons of men.

PSA.107.32.t: Let them exalt Him in the assembly of the people and praise Him in the council of the elders.
s: Let them exalt Him in the assembly of the people
and praise Him in the council of the elders.

PSA.111.1.t: Hallelujah! I will give thanks to the LORD with all my heart in the council of the upright and in the assembly.
s: Hallelujah!
I will give thanks to the LORD with all my heart
in the council of the upright and in the assembly.

PSA.111.2.t: Great are the works of the LORD; they are pondered by all who delight in them.
s: Great are the works of the LORD;
they are pondered by all who delight in them.

PSA.111.3.t: Splendid and majestic is His work; His righteousness endures forever.
s: Splendid and majestic is His work;
His righteousness endures forever.

PSA.111.4.t: He has caused His wonders to be remembered; the LORD is gracious and compassionate.
s: He has caused His wonders to be remembered;
the LORD is gracious and compassionate.

PSA.111.5.t: He provides food for those who fear Him; He remembers His covenant forever.
s: He provides food for those who fear Him;
He remembers His covenant forever.

PSA.111.6.t: He has shown His people the power of His works by giving them the inheritance of the nations.
s: He has shown His people the power of His works
by giving them the inheritance of the nations.

PSA.111.7.t: The works of His hands are truth and justice; all His precepts are trustworthy.
s: The works of His hands are truth and justice;
all His precepts are trustworthy.

PSA.111.8.t: They are upheld forever and ever, enacted in truth and uprightness.
s: They are upheld forever and ever,
enacted in truth and uprightness.

PSA.111.9.t: He has sent redemption to His people; He has ordained His covenant forever; holy and awesome is His name.
s: He has sent redemption to His people;
He has ordained His covenant forever;
holy and awesome is His name.

PSA.111.10.t: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom; all who follow His precepts gain rich understanding. His praise endures forever!
s: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom;
all who follow His precepts gain rich understanding.
His praise endures forever!

PSA.112.4.t: Light dawns in the darkness for the upright— for the gracious, compassionate, and righteous.
s: Light dawns in the darkness for the upright—
for the gracious, compassionate, and righteous.

PSA.112.5.t: It is well with the man who is generous and lends freely, whose affairs are guided by justice.
s: It is well with the man who is generous and lends freely,
whose affairs are guided by justice.

PSA.112.6.t: Surely he will never be shaken; the righteous man will be remembered forever.
s: Surely he will never be shaken;
the righteous man will be remembered forever.

PSA.112.7.t: He does not fear bad news; his heart is steadfast, trusting in the LORD.
s: He does not fear bad news;
his heart is steadfast, trusting in the LORD.

PSA.112.8.t: His heart is assured; he does not fear, until he looks in triumph on his foes.
s: His heart is assured; he does not fear,
until he looks in triumph on his foes.

PSA.116.1.t: I love the LORD, for He has heard my voice— my appeal for mercy.
s: I love the LORD, for He has heard my voice—
my appeal for mercy.

PSA.116.2.t: Because He has inclined His ear to me, I will call on Him as long as I live.
s: Because He has inclined His ear to me,
I will call on Him as long as I live.

PSA.116.3.t: The ropes of death entangled me; the anguish of Sheol overcame me; I was confronted by trouble and sorrow.
s: The ropes of death entangled me;
the anguish of Sheol overcame me;
I was confronted by trouble and sorrow.

PSA.116.4.t: Then I called on the name of the LORD: “O LORD, deliver my soul!”
s: Then I called on the name of the LORD:
“O LORD, deliver my soul!”

PSA.116.5.t: The LORD is gracious and righteous; our God is full of compassion.
s: The LORD is gracious and righteous;
our God is full of compassion.

PSA.116.6.t: The LORD preserves the simplehearted; I was helpless, and He saved me.
s: The LORD preserves the simplehearted;
I was helpless, and He saved me.

PSA.116.7.t: Return to your rest, O my soul, for the LORD has been good to you.
s: Return to your rest, O my soul,
for the LORD has been good to you.

PSA.116.8.t: For You have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from stumbling.
s: For You have delivered my soul from death,
my eyes from tears, my feet from stumbling.

PSA.116.9.t: I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.
s: I will walk before the LORD
in the land of the living.

PSA.118.19.t: Open to me the gates of righteousness, that I may enter and give thanks to the LORD.
s: Open to me the gates of righteousness,
that I may enter and give thanks to the LORD.

PSA.118.20.t: This is the gate of the LORD; the righteous shall enter through it.
s: This is the gate of the LORD;
the righteous shall enter through it.

PSA.118.21.t: I will give You thanks, for You have answered me, and You have become my salvation.
s: I will give You thanks, for You have answered me,
and You have become my salvation.

PSA.118.22.t: The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.
s: The stone the builders rejected
has become the cornerstone.

PSA.118.23.t: This is from the LORD, and it is marvelous in our eyes.
s: This is from the LORD,
and it is marvelous in our eyes.

PSA.118.24.t: This is the day that the LORD has made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
s: This is the day that the LORD has made;
we will rejoice and be glad in it.

PSA.118.25.t: O LORD, save us, we pray. We beseech You, O LORD, cause us to prosper!
s: O LORD, save us, we pray.
We beseech You, O LORD, cause us to prosper!

PSA.118.26.t: Blessed is he who comes in the name of the LORD. From the house of the LORD we bless you.
s: Blessed is he who comes in the name of the LORD.
From the house of the LORD we bless you.

PSA.118.27.t: The LORD is God; He has made His light to shine upon us. Bind the festal sacrifice with cords to the horns of the altar.
s: The LORD is God;
He has made His light to shine upon us.
Bind the festal sacrifice with cords
to the horns of the altar.

PSA.118.28.t: You are my God, and I will give You thanks. You are my God, and I will exalt You.
s: You are my God, and I will give You thanks.
You are my God, and I will exalt You.

PSA.118.29.t: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
s: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good;
His loving devotion endures forever.

PSA.119.9.t: How can a young man keep his way pure? By guarding it according to Your word.
s: How can a young man keep his way pure?
By guarding it according to Your word.

PSA.119.10.t: With all my heart I have sought You; do not let me stray from Your commandments.
s: With all my heart I have sought You;
do not let me stray from Your commandments.

PSA.119.11.t: I have hidden Your word in my heart that I might not sin against You.
s: I have hidden Your word in my heart
that I might not sin against You.

PSA.119.12.t: Blessed are You, O LORD; teach me Your statutes.
s: Blessed are You, O LORD;
teach me Your statutes.

PSA.119.13.t: With my lips I proclaim all the judgments of Your mouth.
s: With my lips I proclaim
all the judgments of Your mouth.

PSA.119.14.t: I rejoice in the way of Your testimonies as much as in all riches.
s: I rejoice in the way of Your testimonies
as much as in all riches.

PSA.119.15.t: I will meditate on Your precepts and regard Your ways.
s: I will meditate on Your precepts
and regard Your ways.

PSA.119.16.t: I will delight in Your statutes; I will not forget Your word.
s: I will delight in Your statutes;
I will not forget Your word.

PSA.119.33.t: Teach me, O LORD, the way of Your statutes, and I will keep them to the end.
s: Teach me, O LORD, the way of Your statutes,
and I will keep them to the end.

PSA.119.34.t: Give me understanding that I may obey Your law, and follow it with all my heart.
s: Give me understanding that I may obey Your law,
and follow it with all my heart.

PSA.119.35.t: Direct me in the path of Your commandments, for there I find delight.
s: Direct me in the path of Your commandments,
for there I find delight.

PSA.119.36.t: Turn my heart to Your testimonies and not to covetous gain.
s: Turn my heart to Your testimonies
and not to covetous gain.

PSA.119.37.t: Turn my eyes away from worthless things; revive me with Your word.
s: Turn my eyes away from worthless things;
revive me with Your word.

PSA.119.38.t: Establish Your word to Your servant, to produce reverence for You.
s: Establish Your word to Your servant,
to produce reverence for You.

PSA.119.39.t: Turn away the disgrace I dread, for Your judgments are good.
s: Turn away the disgrace I dread,
for Your judgments are good.

PSA.119.40.t: How I long for Your precepts! Revive me in Your righteousness.
s: How I long for Your precepts!
Revive me in Your righteousness.

PSA.119.73.t: Your hands have made me and fashioned me; give me understanding to learn Your commandments.
s: Your hands have made me and fashioned me;
give me understanding to learn Your commandments.

PSA.119.74.t: May those who fear You see me and rejoice, for I have hoped in Your word.
s: May those who fear You see me and rejoice,
for I have hoped in Your word.

PSA.119.75.t: I know, O LORD, that Your judgments are righteous, and that in faithfulness You have afflicted me.
s: I know, O LORD, that Your judgments are righteous,
and that in faithfulness You have afflicted me.

PSA.119.76.t: May Your loving devotion comfort me, I pray, according to Your promise to Your servant.
s: May Your loving devotion comfort me, I pray,
according to Your promise to Your servant.

PSA.119.77.t: May Your compassion come to me, that I may live, for Your law is my delight.
s: May Your compassion come to me, that I may live,
for Your law is my delight.

PSA.119.97.t: Oh, how I love Your law! All day long it is my meditation.
s: Oh, how I love Your law!
All day long it is my meditation.

PSA.119.98.t: Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies, for they are always with me.
s: Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies,
for they are always with me.

PSA.119.99.t: I have more insight than all my teachers, for Your testimonies are my meditation.
s: I have more insight than all my teachers,
for Your testimonies are my meditation.

PSA.119.100.t: I discern more than the elders, for I obey Your precepts.
s: I discern more than the elders,
for I obey Your precepts.

PSA.119.101.t: I have kept my feet from every evil path, that I may keep Your word.
s: I have kept my feet from every evil path,
that I may keep Your word.

PSA.119.102.t: I have not departed from Your ordinances, for You Yourself have taught me.
s: I have not departed from Your ordinances,
for You Yourself have taught me.

PSA.119.103.t: How sweet are Your words to my taste— sweeter than honey in my mouth!
s: How sweet are Your words to my taste—
sweeter than honey in my mouth!

PSA.119.104.t: I gain understanding from Your precepts; therefore I hate every false way.
s: I gain understanding from Your precepts;
therefore I hate every false way.

PSA.119.105.t: Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path.
s: Your word is a lamp to my feet
and a light to my path.

PSA.119.106.t: I have sworn and confirmed that I will keep Your righteous judgments.
s: I have sworn and confirmed
that I will keep Your righteous judgments.

PSA.119.107.t: I am severely afflicted, O LORD; revive me through Your word.
s: I am severely afflicted, O LORD;
revive me through Your word.

PSA.119.108.t: Accept the freewill offerings of my mouth, O LORD, and teach me Your judgments.
s: Accept the freewill offerings of my mouth, O LORD,
and teach me Your judgments.

PSA.119.109.t: I constantly take my life in my hands, yet I do not forget Your law.
s: I constantly take my life in my hands,
yet I do not forget Your law.

PSA.119.110.t: The wicked have set a snare for me, but I have not strayed from Your precepts.
s: The wicked have set a snare for me,
but I have not strayed from Your precepts.

PSA.119.111.t: Your testimonies are my heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.
s: Your testimonies are my heritage forever,
for they are the joy of my heart.

PSA.119.112.t: I have inclined my heart to perform Your statutes, even to the very end.
s: I have inclined my heart to perform Your statutes,
even to the very end.

PSA.121.1.t: I lift up my eyes to the hills. From where does my help come?
s: I lift up my eyes to the hills.
From where does my help come?

PSA.121.2.t: My help comes from the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.
s: My help comes from the LORD,
the Maker of heaven and earth.

PSA.121.3.t: He will not allow your foot to slip; your Protector will not slumber.
s: He will not allow your foot to slip;
your Protector will not slumber.

PSA.121.4.t: Behold, the Protector of Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.
s: Behold, the Protector of Israel
will neither slumber nor sleep.

PSA.121.5.t: The LORD is your keeper; the LORD is the shade on your right hand.
s: The LORD is your keeper;
the LORD is the shade on your right hand.

PSA.121.6.t: The sun will not strike you by day, nor the moon by night.
s: The sun will not strike you by day,
nor the moon by night.

PSA.121.7.t: The LORD will guard you from all evil; He will preserve your soul.
s: The LORD will guard you from all evil;
He will preserve your soul.

PSA.121.8.t: The LORD will watch over your coming and going, both now and forevermore.
s: The LORD will watch over your coming and going,
both now and forevermore.

PSA.125.1.t: Those who trust in the LORD are like Mount Zion. It cannot be moved; it abides forever.
s: Those who trust in the LORD are like Mount Zion.
It cannot be moved; it abides forever.

PSA.125.2.t: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the LORD surrounds His people, both now and forevermore.
s: As the mountains surround Jerusalem,
so the LORD surrounds His people,
both now and forevermore.

PSA.125.3.t: For the scepter of the wicked will not rest upon the land allotted to the righteous, so that the righteous will not put forth their hands to injustice.
s: For the scepter of the wicked will not rest
upon the land allotted to the righteous,
so that the righteous will not put forth
their hands to injustice.

PSA.125.4.t: Do good, O LORD, to those who are good, and to the upright in heart.
s: Do good, O LORD, to those who are good,
and to the upright in heart.

PSA.125.5.t: But those who turn to crooked ways the LORD will banish with the evildoers. Peace be upon Israel.
s: But those who turn to crooked ways
the LORD will banish with the evildoers.
Peace be upon Israel.

PSA.127.1.t: Unless the LORD builds the house, its builders labor in vain; unless the LORD protects the city, its watchmen stand guard in vain.
s: Unless the LORD builds the house,
its builders labor in vain;
unless the LORD protects the city,
its watchmen stand guard in vain.
PSA.127.1.h: A song of ascents. Of Solomon.

PSA.127.2.t: In vain you rise early and stay up late, toiling for bread to eat— for He gives sleep to His beloved.
s: In vain you rise early
and stay up late,
toiling for bread to eat—
for He gives sleep to His beloved.

PSA.127.3.t: Children are indeed a heritage from the LORD, and the fruit of the womb is His reward.
s: Children are indeed a heritage from the LORD,
and the fruit of the womb is His reward.

PSA.127.4.t: Like arrows in the hand of a warrior, so are children born in one’s youth.
s: Like arrows in the hand of a warrior,
so are children born in one’s youth.

PSA.127.5.t: Blessed is the man whose quiver is full of them. He will not be put to shame when he confronts the enemies at the gate.
s: Blessed is the man
whose quiver is full of them.
He will not be put to shame
when he confronts the enemies at the gate.

PSA.130.1.t: Out of the depths I cry to You, O LORD!
s: Out of the depths
I cry to You, O LORD!

PSA.130.2.t: O Lord, hear my voice; let Your ears be attentive to my plea for mercy.
s: O Lord, hear my voice;
let Your ears be attentive to my plea for mercy.

PSA.130.3.t: If You, O LORD, kept track of iniquities, then who, O Lord, could stand?
s: If You, O LORD, kept track of iniquities,
then who, O Lord, could stand?

PSA.130.4.t: But with You there is forgiveness, so that You may be feared.
s: But with You there is forgiveness,
so that You may be feared.

PSA.130.5.t: I wait for the LORD; my soul does wait, and in His word I put my hope.
s: I wait for the LORD; my soul does wait,
and in His word I put my hope.

PSA.130.6.t: My soul waits for the Lord more than watchmen wait for the morning— more than watchmen wait for the morning.
s: My soul waits for the Lord
more than watchmen wait for the morning—
more than watchmen wait for the morning.

PSA.130.7.t: O Israel, put your hope in the LORD, for with the LORD is loving devotion, and with Him is redemption in abundance.
s: O Israel, put your hope in the LORD,
for with the LORD is loving devotion,
and with Him is redemption in abundance.

PSA.130.8.t: And He will redeem Israel from all iniquity.
s: And He will redeem Israel
from all iniquity.

PSA.131.1.t: My heart is not proud, O LORD, my eyes are not haughty. I do not aspire to great things or matters too lofty for me.
s: My heart is not proud, O LORD,
my eyes are not haughty.
I do not aspire to great things
or matters too lofty for me.
PSA.131.1.h: A song of ascents. Of David.

PSA.131.2.t: Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul; like a weaned child with his mother, like a weaned child is my soul within me.
s: Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul;
like a weaned child with his mother,
like a weaned child is my soul within me.

PSA.131.3.t: O Israel, put your hope in the LORD, both now and forevermore.
s: O Israel, put your hope in the LORD,
both now and forevermore.

PSA.133.1.t: Behold, how good and pleasant it is when brothers live together in harmony!
s: Behold, how good and pleasant it is
when brothers live together in harmony!
PSA.133.1.h: A song of ascents. Of David.

PSA.133.2.t: It is like fine oil on the head, running down on the beard, running down Aaron’s beard over the collar of his robes.
s: It is like fine oil on the head,
running down on the beard,
running down Aaron’s beard
over the collar of his robes.

PSA.133.3.t: It is like the dew of Hermon falling on the mountains of Zion. For there the LORD has bestowed the blessing of life forevermore.
s: It is like the dew of Hermon
falling on the mountains of Zion.
For there the LORD has bestowed the blessing
of life forevermore.

PSA.136.23.t: He remembered us in our low estate His loving devotion endures forever.
s: He remembered us in our low estate
His loving devotion endures forever.

PSA.136.24.t: and freed us from our enemies. His loving devotion endures forever.
s: and freed us from our enemies.
His loving devotion endures forever.

PSA.136.25.t: He gives food to every creature. His loving devotion endures forever.
s: He gives food to every creature.
His loving devotion endures forever.

PSA.136.26.t: Give thanks to the God of heaven! His loving devotion endures forever.
s: Give thanks to the God of heaven!
His loving devotion endures forever.

PSA.138.1.t: I give You thanks with all my heart; before the gods I sing Your praises.
s: I give You thanks with all my heart;
before the gods I sing Your praises.

PSA.138.2.t: I bow down toward Your holy temple and give thanks to Your name for Your loving devotion and Your faithfulness; You have exalted Your name and Your word above all else.
s: I bow down toward Your holy temple
and give thanks to Your name
for Your loving devotion and Your faithfulness;
You have exalted Your name
and Your word above all else.

PSA.138.3.t: On the day I called, You answered me; You emboldened me and strengthened my soul.
s: On the day I called, You answered me;
You emboldened me and strengthened my soul.

PSA.138.4.t: All the kings of the earth will give You thanks, O LORD, when they hear the words of Your mouth.
s: All the kings of the earth will give You thanks, O LORD,
when they hear the words of Your mouth.

PSA.138.5.t: They will sing of the ways of the LORD, for the glory of the LORD is great.
s: They will sing of the ways of the LORD,
for the glory of the LORD is great.

PSA.138.6.t: Though the LORD is on high, He attends to the lowly; but the proud He knows from afar.
s: Though the LORD is on high,
He attends to the lowly;
but the proud He knows from afar.

PSA.138.7.t: If I walk in the midst of trouble, You preserve me from the anger of my foes; You extend Your hand, and Your right hand saves me.
s: If I walk in the midst of trouble,
You preserve me from the anger of my foes;
You extend Your hand,
and Your right hand saves me.

PSA.138.8.t: The LORD will fulfill His purpose for me. O LORD, Your loving devotion endures forever— do not abandon the works of Your hands.
s: The LORD will fulfill
His purpose for me.
O LORD, Your loving devotion endures forever—
do not abandon the works of Your hands.

PSA.139.1.t: O LORD, You have searched me and known me.
s: O LORD, You have searched me
and known me.
PSA.139.1.h: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David.

PSA.139.2.t: You know when I sit and when I rise; You understand my thoughts from afar.
s: You know when I sit and when I rise;
You understand my thoughts from afar.

PSA.139.3.t: You search out my path and my lying down; You are aware of all my ways.
s: You search out my path and my lying down;
You are aware of all my ways.

PSA.139.4.t: Even before a word is on my tongue, You know all about it, O LORD.
s: Even before a word is on my tongue,
You know all about it, O LORD.

PSA.139.5.t: You hem me in behind and before; You have laid Your hand upon me.
s: You hem me in behind and before;
You have laid Your hand upon me.

PSA.139.6.t: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me, too lofty for me to attain.
s: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me,
too lofty for me to attain.

PSA.139.7.t: Where can I go to escape Your Spirit? Where can I flee from Your presence?
s: Where can I go to escape Your Spirit?
Where can I flee from Your presence?

PSA.139.8.t: If I ascend to the heavens, You are there; if I make my bed in Sheol, You are there.
s: If I ascend to the heavens, You are there;
if I make my bed in Sheol, You are there.

PSA.139.9.t: If I rise on the wings of the dawn, if I settle by the farthest sea,
s: If I rise on the wings of the dawn,
if I settle by the farthest sea,

PSA.139.10.t: even there Your hand will guide me; Your right hand will hold me fast.
s: even there Your hand will guide me;
Your right hand will hold me fast.

PSA.139.11.t: If I say, “Surely the darkness will hide me, and the light become night around me”—
s: If I say, “Surely the darkness will hide me,
and the light become night around me”—

PSA.139.12.t: even the darkness is not dark to You, but the night shines like the day, for darkness is as light to You.
s: even the darkness is not dark to You,
but the night shines like the day,
for darkness is as light to You.

PSA.139.13.t: For You formed my inmost being; You knit me together in my mother’s womb.
s: For You formed my inmost being;
You knit me together in my mother’s womb.

PSA.139.14.t: I praise You, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Marvelous are Your works, and I know this very well.
s: I praise You,
for I am fearfully and wonderfully made.
Marvelous are Your works,
and I know this very well.

PSA.139.15.t: My frame was not hidden from You when I was made in secret, when I was woven together in the depths of the earth.
s: My frame was not hidden from You
when I was made in secret,
when I was woven together
in the depths of the earth.

PSA.139.16.t: Your eyes saw my unformed body; all my days were written in Your book and ordained for me before one of them came to be.
s: Your eyes saw my unformed body;
all my days were written in Your book
and ordained for me
before one of them came to be.

PSA.139.17.t: How precious to me are Your thoughts, O God, how vast is their sum!
s: How precious to me are Your thoughts, O God,
how vast is their sum!

PSA.139.18.t: If I were to count them, they would outnumber the grains of sand; and when I awake, I am still with You.
s: If I were to count them,
they would outnumber the grains of sand;
and when I awake,
I am still with You.

PSA.140.1.t: Rescue me, O LORD, from evil men. Protect me from men of violence,
s: Rescue me, O LORD, from evil men.
Protect me from men of violence,
PSA.140.1.h: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David.

PSA.140.2.t: who devise evil in their hearts and stir up war all day long.
s: who devise evil in their hearts
and stir up war all day long.

PSA.140.3.t: They sharpen their tongues like snakes; the venom of vipers is on their lips. Selah
s: They sharpen their tongues like snakes;
the venom of vipers is on their lips.
Selah

PSA.140.4.t: Guard me, O LORD, from the hands of the wicked. Keep me safe from men of violence who scheme to make me stumble.
s: Guard me, O LORD,
from the hands of the wicked.
Keep me safe from men of violence
who scheme to make me stumble.

PSA.140.5.t: The proud hide a snare for me; the cords of their net are spread along the path, and lures are set out for me. Selah
s: The proud hide a snare for me;
the cords of their net are spread along the path,
and lures are set out for me.
Selah

PSA.140.6.t: I say to the LORD, “You are my God.” Hear, O LORD, my cry for help.
s: I say to the LORD, “You are my God.”
Hear, O LORD, my cry for help.

PSA.140.7.t: O GOD the Lord, the strength of my salvation, You shield my head in the day of battle.
s: O GOD the Lord, the strength of my salvation,
You shield my head in the day of battle.

PSA.140.8.t: Grant not, O LORD, the desires of the wicked; do not promote their evil plans, lest they be exalted. Selah
s: Grant not, O LORD, the desires of the wicked;
do not promote their evil plans,
lest they be exalted.
Selah

PSA.141.1.t: I call upon You, O LORD; come quickly to me. Hear my voice when I call to You.
s: I call upon You, O LORD; come quickly to me.
Hear my voice when I call to You.

PSA.141.2.t: May my prayer be set before You like incense, my uplifted hands like the evening offering.
s: May my prayer be set before You like incense,
my uplifted hands like the evening offering.

PSA.141.3.t: Set a guard, O LORD, over my mouth; keep watch at the door of my lips.
s: Set a guard, O LORD, over my mouth;
keep watch at the door of my lips.

PSA.141.4.t: Do not let my heart be drawn to any evil thing or take part in works of wickedness with men who do iniquity; let me not feast on their delicacies.
s: Do not let my heart be drawn to any evil thing
or take part in works of wickedness
with men who do iniquity;
let me not feast on their delicacies.

PSA.142.1.t: I cry aloud to the LORD; I lift my voice to the LORD for mercy.
s: I cry aloud to the LORD;
I lift my voice to the LORD for mercy.
PSA.142.1.h: A Maskil of David, when he was in the cave. A prayer.

PSA.142.2.t: I pour out my complaint before Him; I reveal my trouble to Him.
s: I pour out my complaint before Him;
I reveal my trouble to Him.

PSA.142.3.t: Although my spirit grows faint within me, You know my way. Along the path I travel they have hidden a snare for me.
s: Although my spirit grows faint within me,
You know my way.
Along the path I travel
they have hidden a snare for me.

PSA.142.4.t: Look to my right and see; no one attends to me. There is no refuge for me; no one cares for my soul.
s: Look to my right and see;
no one attends to me.
There is no refuge for me;
no one cares for my soul.

PSA.142.5.t: I cry to You, O LORD: “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”
s: I cry to You, O LORD: “You are my refuge,
my portion in the land of the living.”

PSA.142.6.t: Listen to my cry, for I am brought quite low. Rescue me from my pursuers, for they are too strong for me.
s: Listen to my cry,
for I am brought quite low.
Rescue me from my pursuers,
for they are too strong for me.

PSA.142.7.t: Free my soul from prison, that I may praise Your name. The righteous will gather around me because of Your goodness to me.
s: Free my soul from prison,
that I may praise Your name.
The righteous will gather around me
because of Your goodness to me.

PSA.145.13.t: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and Your dominion endures through all generations. The LORD is faithful in all His words and kind in all His actions.
s: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom,
and Your dominion endures through all generations.
The LORD is faithful in all His words
and kind in all His actions.

PSA.145.14.t: The LORD upholds all who fall and lifts up all who are bowed down.
s: The LORD upholds all who fall
and lifts up all who are bowed down.

PSA.145.15.t: The eyes of all look to You, and You give them their food in season.
s: The eyes of all look to You,
and You give them their food in season.

PSA.145.16.t: You open Your hand and satisfy the desire of every living thing.
s: You open Your hand
and satisfy the desire of every living thing.

PSA.145.17.t: The LORD is righteous in all His ways and kind in all His deeds.
s: The LORD is righteous in all His ways
and kind in all His deeds.

PSA.145.18.t: The LORD is near to all who call on Him, to all who call out to Him in truth.
s: The LORD is near to all who call on Him,
to all who call out to Him in truth.

PSA.145.19.t: He fulfills the desires of those who fear Him; He hears their cry and saves them.
s: He fulfills the desires of those who fear Him;
He hears their cry and saves them.

PSA.147.1.t: Hallelujah! How good it is to sing praises to our God, how pleasant and lovely to praise Him!
s: Hallelujah!
How good it is to sing praises to our God,
how pleasant and lovely to praise Him!

PSA.147.2.t: The LORD builds up Jerusalem; He gathers the exiles of Israel.
s: The LORD builds up Jerusalem;
He gathers the exiles of Israel.

PSA.147.3.t: He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.
s: He heals the brokenhearted
and binds up their wounds.

PSA.147.4.t: He determines the number of the stars; He calls them each by name.
s: He determines the number of the stars;
He calls them each by name.

PSA.147.5.t: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power; His understanding has no limit.
s: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power;
His understanding has no limit.

PSA.147.6.t: The LORD sustains the humble, but casts the wicked to the ground.
s: The LORD sustains the humble,
but casts the wicked to the ground.

PSA.147.7.t: Sing to the LORD with thanksgiving; make music on the harp to our God,
s: Sing to the LORD with thanksgiving;
make music on the harp to our God,

PSA.147.8.t: who covers the sky with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth, who makes grass to grow on the hills.
s: who covers the sky with clouds,
who prepares rain for the earth,
who makes grass to grow on the hills.

PSA.147.9.t: He provides food for the animals, and for the young ravens when they call.
s: He provides food for the animals,
and for the young ravens when they call.

PSA.147.10.t: He does not delight in the strength of the horse; He takes no pleasure in the legpower of the man.
s: He does not delight in the strength of the horse;
He takes no pleasure in the legpower of the man.

PSA.147.11.t: The LORD is pleased with those who fear Him, who hope in His loving devotion.
s: The LORD is pleased with those who fear Him,
who hope in His loving devotion.

REV.21.1.t: Then I saw a new heaven and a new earth, for the first heaven and earth had passed away, and the sea was no more.
s: Then I saw a new heaven and a new earth, for the first heaven and earth had passed away, and the sea was no more.

REV.21.2.t: I saw the holy city, the new Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.
s: I saw the holy city, the new Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.

REV.21.3.t: And I heard a loud voice from the throne saying: “Behold, the dwelling place of God is with man, and He will dwell with them. They will be His people, and God Himself will be with them as their God.
s: And I heard a loud voice from the throne saying:
“Behold, the dwelling place of God is with man,
and He will dwell with them.
They will be His people,
and God Himself will be with them as their God.

REV.21.4.t: ‘He will wipe away every tear from their eyes,’ and there will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain, for the former things have passed away.”
s: ‘He will wipe away every tear from their eyes,’
and there will be no more death
or mourning or crying or pain,
for the former things have passed away.”

REV.21.5.t: And the One seated on the throne said, “Behold, I make all things new.” Then He said, “Write this down, for these words are faithful and true.”
s: And the One seated on the throne said, “Behold, I make all things new.” Then He said, “Write this down, for these words are faithful and true.”

ROM.5.1.t: Therefore, since we have been justified through faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ,
s: Therefore, since we have been justified through faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ,

ROM.5.2.t: through whom we have gained access by faith into this grace in which we stand. And we rejoice in the hope of the glory of God.
s: through whom we have gained access by faith into this grace in which we stand. And we rejoice in the hope of the glory of God.

ROM.5.3.t: Not only that, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, because we know that suffering produces perseverance;
s: Not only that, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, because we know that suffering produces perseverance;
perseverance, character; and character, hope.

ROM.5.5.t: And hope does not disappoint us, because God has poured out His love into our hearts through the Holy Spirit, whom He has given us.
s: And hope does not disappoint us, because God has poured out His love into our hearts through the Holy Spirit, whom He has given us.

ROM.8.1.t: Therefore, there is now no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus.
s: Therefore, there is now no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus.

ROM.8.2.t: For in Christ Jesus the law of the Spirit of life set you free from the law of sin and death.
s: For in Christ Jesus the law of the Spirit of life set you free from the law of sin and death.

ROM.8.3.t: For what the law was powerless to do in that it was weakened by the flesh, God did by sending His own Son in the likeness of sinful man, as an offering for sin. He thus condemned sin in the flesh,
s: For what the law was powerless to do in that it was weakened by the flesh, God did by sending His own Son in the likeness of sinful man, as an offering for sin. He thus condemned sin in the flesh,

ROM.8.4.t: so that the righteous standard of the law might be fulfilled in us, who do not walk according to the flesh but according to the Spirit.
s: so that the righteous standard of the law might be fulfilled in us, who do not walk according to the flesh but according to the Spirit.

ROM.8.12.t: Therefore, brothers, we have an obligation, but it is not to the flesh, to live according to it.
s: Therefore, brothers, we have an obligation, but it is not to the flesh, to live according to it.

ROM.8.13.t: For if you live according to the flesh, you will die; but if by the Spirit you put to death the deeds of the body, you will live.
s: For if you live according to the flesh, you will die; but if by the Spirit you put to death the deeds of the body, you will live.

ROM.8.14.t: For all who are led by the Spirit of God are sons of God.
s: For all who are led by the Spirit of God are sons of God.

ROM.8.15.t: For you did not receive a spirit of slavery that returns you to fear, but you received the Spirit of sonship, by whom we cry, “Abba! Father!”
s: For you did not receive a spirit of slavery that returns you to fear, but you received the Spirit of sonship, by whom we cry, “Abba! Father!”

ROM.8.16.t: The Spirit Himself testifies with our spirit that we are God’s children.
s: The Spirit Himself testifies with our spirit that we are God’s children.

ROM.8.17.t: And if we are children, then we are heirs: heirs of God and co-heirs with Christ—if indeed we suffer with Him, so that we may also be glorified with Him.
s: And if we are children, then we are heirs: heirs of God and co-heirs with Christ—if indeed we suffer with Him, so that we may also be glorified with Him.

ROM.8.18.t: I consider that our present sufferings are not comparable to the glory that will be revealed in us.
s: I consider that our present sufferings are not comparable to the glory that will be revealed in us.

ROM.8.19.t: The creation waits in eager expectation for the revelation of the sons of God.
s: The creation waits in eager expectation for the revelation of the sons of God.

ROM.8.20.t: For the creation was subjected to futility, not by its own will, but because of the One who subjected it, in hope
s: For the creation was subjected to futility, not by its own will, but because of the One who subjected it, in hope

ROM.8.21.t: that the creation itself will be set free from its bondage to decay and brought into the glorious freedom of the children of God.
s: that the creation itself will be set free from its bondage to decay and brought into the glorious freedom of the children of God.

ROM.8.22.t: We know that the whole creation has been groaning together in the pains of childbirth until the present time.
s: We know that the whole creation has been groaning together in the pains of childbirth until the present time.

ROM.8.23.t: Not only that, but we ourselves, who have the firstfruits of the Spirit, groan inwardly as we wait eagerly for our adoption as sons, the redemption of our bodies.
s: Not only that, but we ourselves, who have the firstfruits of the Spirit, groan inwardly as we wait eagerly for our adoption as sons, the redemption of our bodies.

ROM.8.24.t: For in this hope we were saved; but hope that is seen is no hope at all. Who hopes for what he can already see?
s: For in this hope we were saved; but hope that is seen is no hope at all. Who hopes for what he can already see?

ROM.8.25.t: But if we hope for what we do not yet see, we wait for it patiently.
s: But if we hope for what we do not yet see, we wait for it patiently.

ROM.8.26.t: In the same way, the Spirit helps us in our weakness. For we do not know how we ought to pray, but the Spirit Himself intercedes for us with groans too deep for words.
s: In the same way, the Spirit helps us in our weakness. For we do not know how we ought to pray, but the Spirit Himself intercedes for us with groans too deep for words.

ROM.8.27.t: And He who searches our hearts knows the mind of the Spirit, because the Spirit intercedes for the saints according to the will of God.
s: And He who searches our hearts knows the mind of the Spirit, because the Spirit intercedes for the saints according to the will of God.

ROM.8.28.t: And we know that God works all things together for the good of those who love Him, who are called according to His purpose.
s: And we know that God works all things together for the good of those who love Him, who are called according to His purpose.

ROM.8.31.t: What then shall we say in response to these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?
s: What then shall we say in response to these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?

ROM.8.32.t: He who did not spare His own Son but gave Him up for us all, how will He not also, along with Him, freely give us all things?
s: He who did not spare His own Son but gave Him up for us all, how will He not also, along with Him, freely give us all things?

ROM.8.33.t: Who will bring any charge against God’s elect? It is God who justifies.
s: Who will bring any charge against God’s elect? It is God who justifies.

ROM.8.34.t: Who is there to condemn us? For Christ Jesus, who died, and more than that was raised to life, is at the right hand of God—and He is interceding for us.
s: Who is there to condemn us? For Christ Jesus, who died, and more than that was raised to life, is at the right hand of God—and He is interceding for us.

ROM.8.35.t: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Shall trouble or distress or persecution or famine or nakedness or danger or sword?
s: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Shall trouble or distress or persecution or famine or nakedness or danger or sword?

ROM.8.36.t: As it is written: “For Your sake we face death all day long; we are considered as sheep to be slaughtered.”
s: As it is written:
“For Your sake we face death all day long;
we are considered as sheep to be slaughtered.”

ROM.8.37.t: No, in all these things we are more than conquerors through Him who loved us.
s: No, in all these things we are more than conquerors through Him who loved us.

ROM.8.38.t: For I am convinced that neither death nor life, neither angels nor principalities, neither the present nor the future, nor any powers,
s: For I am convinced that neither death nor life, neither angels nor principalities, neither the present nor the future, nor any powers,

ROM.8.39.t: neither height nor depth, nor anything else in all creation, will be able to separate us from the love of God that is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
s: neither height nor depth, nor anything else in all creation, will be able to separate us from the love of God that is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

ROM.12.1.t: Therefore I urge you, brothers, on account of God’s mercy, to offer your bodies as living sacrifices, holy and pleasing to God, which is your spiritual service of worship.
s: Therefore I urge you, brothers, on account of God’s mercy, to offer your bodies as living sacrifices, holy and pleasing to God, which is your spiritual service of worship.

ROM.12.2.t: Do not be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind. Then you will be able to test and approve what is the good, pleasing, and perfect will of God.
s: Do not be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind. Then you will be able to test and approve what is the good, pleasing, and perfect will of God.

ROM.12.3.t: For by the grace given me I say to every one of you: Do not think of yourself more highly than you ought, but think of yourself with sober judgment, according to the measure of faith God has given you.
s: For by the grace given me I say to every one of you: Do not think of yourself more highly than you ought, but think of yourself with sober judgment, according to the measure of faith God has given you.

ROM.12.4.t: Just as each of us has one body with many members, and not all members have the same function,
s: Just as each of us has one body with many members, and not all members have the same function,

ROM.12.5.t: so in Christ we who are many are one body, and each member belongs to one another.
s: so in Christ we who are many are one body, and each member belongs to one another.

ROM.12.6.t: We have different gifts according to the grace given us. If one’s gift is prophecy, let him use it in proportion to his faith;
s: We have different gifts according to the grace given us. If one’s gift is prophecy, let him use it in proportion to his faith;

ROM.12.7.t: if it is serving, let him serve; if it is teaching, let him teach;
s: if it is serving, let him serve; if it is teaching, let him teach;

ROM.12.8.t: if it is encouraging, let him encourage; if it is giving, let him give generously; if it is leading, let him lead with diligence; if it is showing mercy, let him do it cheerfully.
s: if it is encouraging, let him encourage; if it is giving, let him give generously; if it is leading, let him lead with diligence; if it is showing mercy, let him do it cheerfully.

ROM.12.9.t: Love must be sincere. Detest what is evil; cling to what is good.
s: Love must be sincere. Detest what is evil; cling to what is good.

ROM.12.10.t: Be devoted to one another in brotherly love. Outdo yourselves in honoring one another.
s: Be devoted to one another in brotherly love. Outdo yourselves in honoring one another.

ROM.12.11.t: Do not let your zeal subside; keep your spiritual fervor, serving the Lord.
s: Do not let your zeal subside; keep your spiritual fervor, serving the Lord.

ROM.12.12.t: Be joyful in hope, patient in affliction, persistent in prayer.
s: Be joyful in hope, patient in affliction, persistent in prayer.

ROM.12.13.t: Share with the saints who are in need. Practice hospitality.
s: Share with the saints who are in need. Practice hospitality.

ROM.12.14.t: Bless those who persecute you. Bless and do not curse.
s: Bless those who persecute you. Bless and do not curse.

ROM.12.15.t: Rejoice with those who rejoice; weep with those who weep.
s: Rejoice with those who rejoice; weep with those who weep.

ROM.12.16.t: Live in harmony with one another. Do not be proud, but enjoy the company of the lowly. Do not be conceited.
s: Live in harmony with one another. Do not be proud, but enjoy the company of the lowly. Do not be conceited.

ROM.12.17.t: Do not repay anyone evil for evil. Carefully consider what is right in the eyes of everybody.
s: Do not repay anyone evil for evil. Carefully consider what is right in the eyes of everybody.

ROM.12.18.t: If it is possible on your part, live at peace with everyone.
s: If it is possible on your part, live at peace with everyone.

ROM.12.19.t: Do not avenge yourselves, beloved, but leave room for God’s wrath. For it is written: “Vengeance is Mine; I will repay, says the Lord.”
s: Do not avenge yourselves, beloved, but leave room for God’s wrath. For it is written: “Vengeance is Mine; I will repay, says the Lord.”

ROM.12.20.t: On the contrary, “If your enemy is hungry, feed him; if he is thirsty, give him a drink. For in so doing, you will heap burning coals on his head.”
s: On the contrary,
“If your enemy is hungry, feed him;
if he is thirsty, give him a drink.
For in so doing,
you will heap burning coals on his head.”

ROM.12.21.t: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
s: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.

ROM.13.6.t: This is also why you pay taxes. For the authorities are God’s servants, who devote themselves to their work.
s: This is also why you pay taxes. For the authorities are God’s servants, who devote themselves to their work.

ROM.13.7.t: Pay everyone what you owe him: taxes to whom taxes are due, revenue to whom revenue is due, respect to whom respect is due, honor to whom honor is due.
s: Pay everyone what you owe him: taxes to whom taxes are due, revenue to whom revenue is due, respect to whom respect is due, honor to whom honor is due.

ROM.13.8.t: Be indebted to no one, except to one another in love. For he who loves his neighbor has fulfilled the law.
s: Be indebted to no one, except to one another in love. For he who loves his neighbor has fulfilled the law.

ROM.13.9.t: The commandments “Do not commit adultery,” “Do not murder,” “Do not steal,” “Do not covet,” and any other commandments, are summed up in this one decree: “Love your neighbor as yourself.”
s: The commandments “Do not commit adultery,” “Do not murder,” “Do not steal,” “Do not covet,” and any other commandments, are summed up in this one decree: “Love your neighbor as yourself.”

ROM.13.10.t: Love does no wrong to its neighbor. Therefore love is the fulfillment of the law.
s: Love does no wrong to its neighbor. Therefore love is the fulfillment of the law.

ROM.15.1.t: We who are strong ought to bear with the shortcomings of the weak and not to please ourselves.
s: We who are strong ought to bear with the shortcomings of the weak and not to please ourselves.

ROM.15.2.t: Each of us should please his neighbor for his good, to build him up.
s: Each of us should please his neighbor for his good, to build him up.

ROM.15.3.t: For even Christ did not please Himself, but as it is written: “The insults of those who insult You have fallen on Me.”
s: For even Christ did not please Himself, but as it is written: “The insults of those who insult You have fallen on Me.”

ROM.15.4.t: For everything that was written in the past was written for our instruction, so that through endurance and the encouragement of the Scriptures, we might have hope.
s: For everything that was written in the past was written for our instruction, so that through endurance and the encouragement of the Scriptures, we might have hope.

ROM.15.5.t: Now may the God who gives endurance and encouragement grant you harmony with one another in Christ Jesus,
s: Now may the God who gives endurance and encouragement grant you harmony with one another in Christ Jesus,

ROM.15.6.t: so that with one mind and one voice you may glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
s: so that with one mind and one voice you may glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

ROM.15.7.t: Accept one another, then, just as Christ accepted you, in order to bring glory to God.
s: Accept one another, then, just as Christ accepted you, in order to bring glory to God.

ROM.15.8.t: For I tell you that Christ has become a servant of the circumcised on behalf of God’s truth, to confirm the promises made to the patriarchs,
s: For I tell you that Christ has become a servant of the circumcised on behalf of God’s truth, to confirm the promises made to the patriarchs,

ROM.15.9.t: so that the Gentiles may glorify God for His mercy. As it is written: “Therefore I will praise You among the Gentiles; I will sing hymns to Your name.”
s: so that the Gentiles may glorify God for His mercy. As it is written:
“Therefore I will praise You among the Gentiles;
I will sing hymns to Your name.”

ROM.15.10.t: Again, it says: “Rejoice, O Gentiles, with His people.”
s: Again, it says:
“Rejoice, O Gentiles, with His people.”

ROM.15.11.t: And again: “Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles, and extol Him, all you peoples.”
s: And again:
“Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles,
and extol Him, all you peoples.”

ROM.15.12.t: And once more, Isaiah says: “The Root of Jesse will appear, One who will arise to rule over the Gentiles; in Him the Gentiles will put their hope.”
s: And once more, Isaiah says:
“The Root of Jesse will appear,
One who will arise to rule over the Gentiles;
in Him the Gentiles will put their hope.”

ROM.15.13.t: Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace as you believe in Him, so that you may overflow with hope by the power of the Holy Spirit.
s: Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace as you believe in Him, so that you may overflow with hope by the power of the Holy Spirit.

RUT.1.6.t: When Naomi heard in Moab that the LORD had attended to His people by providing them with food, she and her daughters-in-law prepared to leave the land of Moab.
s: When Naomi heard in Moab that the LORD had attended to His people by providing them with food, she and her daughters-in-law prepared to leave the land of Moab.

RUT.1.7.t: Accompanied by her two daughters-in-law, she left the place where she had been living and set out on the road leading back to the land of Judah.
s: Accompanied by her two daughters-in-law, she left the place where she had been living and set out on the road leading back to the land of Judah.

RUT.1.8.t: Then Naomi said to her two daughters-in-law, “Go back, each of you to your mother’s home. May the LORD show you loving devotion, as you have shown to your dead and to me.
s: Then Naomi said to her two daughters-in-law, “Go back, each of you to your mother’s home. May the LORD show you loving devotion, as you have shown to your dead and to me.

RUT.1.9.t: May the LORD enable each of you to find rest in the home of your new husband.” And she kissed them as they wept aloud
s: May the LORD enable each of you to find rest in the home of your new husband.”
And she kissed them as they wept aloud

RUT.1.10.t: and said, “Surely we will return with you to your people.”
s: and said, “Surely we will return with you to your people.”

RUT.1.11.t: But Naomi replied, “Return home, my daughters. Why would you go with me? Are there still sons in my womb to become your husbands?
s: But Naomi replied, “Return home, my daughters. Why would you go with me? Are there still sons in my womb to become your husbands?

RUT.1.12.t: Return home, my daughters. Go on, for I am too old to have another husband. Even if I thought there was hope for me to have a husband tonight and to bear sons,
s: Return home, my daughters. Go on, for I am too old to have another husband. Even if I thought there was hope for me to have a husband tonight and to bear sons,

RUT.1.13.t: would you wait for them to grow up? Would you refrain from having husbands? No, my daughters, it grieves me very much for your sakes that the hand of the LORD has gone out against me.”
s: would you wait for them to grow up? Would you refrain from having husbands? No, my daughters, it grieves me very much for your sakes that the hand of the LORD has gone out against me.”

RUT.1.14.t: Again they wept aloud, and Orpah kissed her mother-in-law goodbye, but Ruth clung to her.
s: Again they wept aloud, and Orpah kissed her mother-in-law goodbye, but Ruth clung to her.

RUT.1.15.t: “Look,” said Naomi, “your sister-in-law has gone back to her people and her gods; follow her back home.”
s: “Look,” said Naomi, “your sister-in-law has gone back to her people and her gods; follow her back home.”

RUT.1.16.t: But Ruth replied: “Do not urge me to leave you or to turn from following you. For wherever you go, I will go, and wherever you live, I will live; your people will be my people, and your God will be my God.
s: But Ruth replied:
“Do not urge me to leave you
or to turn from following you.
For wherever you go, I will go,
and wherever you live, I will live;
your people will be my people,
and your God will be my God.

RUT.1.17.t: Where you die, I will die, and there I will be buried. May the LORD punish me, and ever so severely, if anything but death separates you and me.”
s: Where you die, I will die,
and there I will be buried.
May the LORD punish me,
and ever so severely,
if anything but death
separates you and me.”

RUT.1.18.t: When Naomi saw that Ruth was determined to go with her, she stopped trying to persuade her.
s: When Naomi saw that Ruth was determined to go with her, she stopped trying to persuade her.

RUT.2.1.t: Now Naomi had a relative on her husband’s side, a prominent man of noble character from the clan of Elimelech, whose name was Boaz.
s: Now Naomi had a relative on her husband’s side, a prominent man of noble character from the clan of Elimelech, whose name was Boaz.

RUT.2.2.t: And Ruth the Moabitess said to Naomi, “Please let me go into the fields and glean heads of grain after someone in whose sight I may find favor.” “Go ahead, my daughter,” Naomi replied.
s: And Ruth the Moabitess said to Naomi, “Please let me go into the fields and glean heads of grain after someone in whose sight I may find favor.”
“Go ahead, my daughter,” Naomi replied.

RUT.2.3.t: So Ruth departed and went out into the field and gleaned after the harvesters. And she happened to come to the part of the field belonging to Boaz, who was from the clan of Elimelech.
s: So Ruth departed and went out into the field and gleaned after the harvesters. And she happened to come to the part of the field belonging to Boaz, who was from the clan of Elimelech.

RUT.2.4.t: Just then Boaz arrived from Bethlehem and said to the harvesters, “The LORD be with you.” “The LORD bless you,” they replied.
s: Just then Boaz arrived from Bethlehem and said to the harvesters, “The LORD be with you.”
“The LORD bless you,” they replied.

RUT.2.5.t: And Boaz asked the foreman of his harvesters, “Whose young woman is this?”
s: And Boaz asked the foreman of his harvesters, “Whose young woman is this?”

RUT.2.6.t: The foreman answered, “She is the Moabitess who returned with Naomi from the land of Moab.
s: The foreman answered, “She is the Moabitess who returned with Naomi from the land of Moab.

RUT.2.7.t: She has said, ‘Please let me glean and gather among the sheaves after the harvesters.’ So she came out and has continued from morning until now, except that she rested a short time in the shelter.”
s: She has said, ‘Please let me glean and gather among the sheaves after the harvesters.’ So she came out and has continued from morning until now, except that she rested a short time in the shelter.”

RUT.2.8.t: Then Boaz said to Ruth, “Listen, my daughter. Do not go and glean in another field, and do not go away from this place, but stay here close to my servant girls.
s: Then Boaz said to Ruth, “Listen, my daughter. Do not go and glean in another field, and do not go away from this place, but stay here close to my servant girls.

RUT.2.9.t: Let your eyes be on the field they are harvesting, and follow along after these girls. Indeed, I have ordered the young men not to touch you. And when you are thirsty, go and drink from the jars the young men have filled.”
s: Let your eyes be on the field they are harvesting, and follow along after these girls. Indeed, I have ordered the young men not to touch you. And when you are thirsty, go and drink from the jars the young men have filled.”

RUT.2.10.t: At this, she fell on her face, bowing low to the ground, and said to him, “Why have I found such favor in your eyes that you should take notice of me, even though I am a foreigner?”
s: At this, she fell on her face, bowing low to the ground, and said to him, “Why have I found such favor in your eyes that you should take notice of me, even though I am a foreigner?”

RUT.2.11.t: Boaz replied, “I have been made fully aware of all you have done for your mother-in-law since the death of your husband, how you left your father and mother and the land of your birth, and how you came to a people you did not know before.
s: Boaz replied, “I have been made fully aware of all you have done for your mother-in-law since the death of your husband, how you left your father and mother and the land of your birth, and how you came to a people you did not know before.

RUT.2.12.t: May the LORD repay your work, and may you receive a rich reward from the LORD, the God of Israel, under whose wings you have taken refuge.”
s: May the LORD repay your work, and may you receive a rich reward from the LORD, the God of Israel, under whose wings you have taken refuge.”

RUT.2.13.t: “My lord,” she said, “may I continue to find favor in your eyes, for you have comforted and spoken kindly to your maidservant, though I am not like one of your servant girls.”
s: “My lord,” she said, “may I continue to find favor in your eyes, for you have comforted and spoken kindly to your maidservant, though I am not like one of your servant girls.”

RUT.4.13.t: So Boaz took Ruth, and she became his wife. And when he had relations with her, the LORD enabled her to conceive, and she gave birth to a son.
s: So Boaz took Ruth, and she became his wife. And when he had relations with her, the LORD enabled her to conceive, and she gave birth to a son.

RUT.4.14.t: Then the women said to Naomi, “Blessed be the LORD, who has not left you this day without a kinsman-redeemer. May his name become famous in Israel.
s: Then the women said to Naomi, “Blessed be the LORD, who has not left you this day without a kinsman-redeemer. May his name become famous in Israel.

RUT.4.15.t: He will renew your life and sustain you in your old age. For your daughter-in-law, who loves you and is better to you than seven sons, has given him birth.”
