s: He will renew your life and sustain you in your old age. For your daughter-in-law, who loves you and is better to you than seven sons, has given him birth.”

RUT.4.16.t: And Naomi took the child, placed him on her lap, and became a nurse to him.
s: And Naomi took the child, placed him on her lap, and became a nurse to him.

RUT.4.17.t: The neighbor women said, “A son has been born to Naomi,” and they named him Obed. He became the father of Jesse, the father of David.
s: The neighbor women said, “A son has been born to Naomi,” and they named him Obed. He became the father of Jesse, the father of David.

SNG.2.1.t: I am a rose of Sharon, a lily of the valley.
s: I am a rose of Sharon,
a lily of the valley.

SNG.2.2.t: Like a lily among the thorns is my darling among the maidens.
s: Like a lily among the thorns
is my darling among the maidens.

SNG.2.3.t: Like an apricot tree among the trees of the forest is my beloved among the young men. I delight to sit in his shade, and his fruit is sweet to my taste.
s: Like an apricot tree among the trees of the forest
is my beloved among the young men.
I delight to sit in his shade,
and his fruit is sweet to my taste.

SNG.2.4.t: He has brought me to the house of wine, and his banner over me is love.
s: He has brought me to the house of wine,
and his banner over me is love.

SNG.2.5.t: Sustain me with raisins; refresh me with apples, for I am faint with love.
s: Sustain me with raisins;
refresh me with apples,
for I am faint with love.

SNG.2.6.t: His left hand is under my head, and his right arm embraces me.
s: His left hand is under my head,
and his right arm embraces me.

SNG.2.7.t: O daughters of Jerusalem, I adjure you by the gazelles and does of the field: Do not arouse or awaken love until the time is right.
s: O daughters of Jerusalem, I adjure you
by the gazelles and does of the field:
Do not arouse or awaken love
until the time is right.

SNG.2.8.t: Listen! My beloved approaches. Look! Here he comes, leaping across the mountains, bounding over the hills.
s: Listen! My beloved approaches.
Look! Here he comes,
leaping across the mountains,
bounding over the hills.

SNG.2.9.t: My beloved is like a gazelle or a young stag. Look, he stands behind our wall, gazing through the windows, peering through the lattice.
s: My beloved is like a gazelle or a young stag.
Look, he stands behind our wall,
gazing through the windows,
peering through the lattice.

SNG.2.10.t: My beloved calls to me, “Arise, my darling. Come away with me, my beautiful one.
s: My beloved calls to me,
“Arise, my darling.
Come away with me, my beautiful one.

SNG.2.11.t: For now the winter is past; the rain is over and gone.
s: For now the winter is past;
the rain is over and gone.

SNG.2.12.t: The flowers have appeared in the countryside; the season of singing has come, and the cooing of turtledoves is heard in our land.
s: The flowers have appeared in the countryside;
the season of singing has come,
and the cooing of turtledoves
is heard in our land.

SNG.2.13.t: The fig tree ripens its figs; the blossoming vines spread their fragrance. Arise, come away, my darling; come away with me, my beautiful one.”
s: The fig tree ripens its figs;
the blossoming vines spread their fragrance.
Arise, come away, my darling;
come away with me, my beautiful one.”

SNG.8.5.t: Who is this coming up from the wilderness, leaning on her beloved? I roused you under the apple tree; there your mother conceived you; there she travailed and brought you forth.
s: Who is this coming up from the wilderness,
leaning on her beloved?
I roused you under the apple tree;
there your mother conceived you;
there she travailed and brought you forth.

SNG.8.6.t: Set me as a seal over your heart, as a seal upon your arm. For love is as strong as death, its jealousy as unrelenting as Sheol. Its sparks are fiery flames, the fiercest blaze of all.
s: Set me as a seal over your heart,
as a seal upon your arm.
For love is as strong as death,
its jealousy as unrelenting as Sheol.
Its sparks are fiery flames,
the fiercest blaze of all.

SNG.8.7.t: Mighty waters cannot quench love; rivers cannot sweep it away. If a man were to give all the wealth of his house for love, his offer would be utterly scorned.
s: Mighty waters cannot quench love;
rivers cannot sweep it away.
If a man were to give all the wealth of his house for love,
his offer would be utterly scorned.

TIT.2.11.t: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to everyone.
s: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to everyone.

TIT.2.12.t: It instructs us to renounce ungodliness and worldly passions, and to live sensible, upright, and godly lives in the present age,
s: It instructs us to renounce ungodliness and worldly passions, and to live sensible, upright, and godly lives in the present age,

TIT.2.13.t: as we await the blessed hope and glorious appearance of our great God and Savior Jesus Christ.
s: as we await the blessed hope and glorious appearance of our great God and Savior Jesus Christ.

TIT.2.14.t: He gave Himself for us to redeem us from all lawlessness and to purify for Himself a people for His own possession, zealous for good deeds.
s: He gave Himself for us to redeem us from all lawlessness and to purify for Himself a people for His own possession, zealous for good deeds.

TIT.3.1.t: Remind the believers to submit to rulers and authorities, to be obedient and ready for every good work,
s: Remind the believers to submit to rulers and authorities, to be obedient and ready for every good work,

TIT.3.2.t: to malign no one, and to be peaceable and gentle, showing full consideration to everyone.
s: to malign no one, and to be peaceable and gentle, showing full consideration to everyone.

TIT.3.3.t: For at one time we too were foolish, disobedient, misled, and enslaved to all sorts of desires and pleasures—living in malice and envy, being hated and hating one another.
s: For at one time we too were foolish, disobedient, misled, and enslaved to all sorts of desires and pleasures—living in malice and envy, being hated and hating one another.

TIT.3.4.t: But when the kindness of God our Savior and His love for mankind appeared,
s: But when the kindness of God our Savior and His love for mankind appeared,

TIT.3.5.t: He saved us, not by the righteous deeds we had done, but according to His mercy, through the washing of new birth and renewal by the Holy Spirit.
s: He saved us, not by the righteous deeds we had done, but according to His mercy, through the washing of new birth and renewal by the Holy Spirit.

TIT.3.6.t: This is the Spirit He poured out on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Savior,
s: This is the Spirit He poured out on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Savior,

TIT.3.7.t: so that, having been justified by His grace, we would become heirs with the hope of eternal life.
s: so that, having been justified by His grace, we would become heirs with the hope of eternal life.

ZEC.4.6.t: So he said to me, “This is the word of the LORD to Zerubbabel: Not by might nor by power, but by My Spirit, says the LORD of Hosts.
s: So he said to me, “This is the word of the LORD to Zerubbabel: Not by might nor by power, but by My Spirit, says the LORD of Hosts.

ZEC.4.7.t: What are you, O great mountain? Before Zerubbabel you will become a plain. Then he will bring forth the capstone accompanied by shouts of ‘Grace, grace to it!’”
s: What are you, O great mountain? Before Zerubbabel you will become a plain. Then he will bring forth the capstone accompanied by shouts of ‘Grace, grace to it!’”

ZEC.4.8.t: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
s: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

ZEC.4.9.t: “The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this house, and his hands will complete it. Then you will know that the LORD of Hosts has sent me to you.
s: “The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this house, and his hands will complete it. Then you will know that the LORD of Hosts has sent me to you.

ZEC.4.10.t: For who has despised the day of small things? But these seven eyes of the LORD, which scan the whole earth, will rejoice when they see the plumb line in the hand of Zerubbabel.”
s: For who has despised the day of small things? But these seven eyes of the LORD, which scan the whole earth, will rejoice when they see the plumb line in the hand of Zerubbabel.”

ZEC.7.4.t: Then the word of the LORD of Hosts came to me, saying,
s: Then the word of the LORD of Hosts came to me, saying,

ZEC.7.5.t: “Ask all the people of the land and the priests, ‘When you fasted and mourned in the fifth and seventh months for these seventy years, was it really for Me that you fasted?
s: “Ask all the people of the land and the priests, ‘When you fasted and mourned in the fifth and seventh months for these seventy years, was it really for Me that you fasted?

ZEC.7.6.t: And when you were eating and drinking, were you not doing so simply for yourselves?
s: And when you were eating and drinking, were you not doing so simply for yourselves?

ZEC.7.7.t: Are these not the words that the LORD proclaimed through the earlier prophets, when Jerusalem and its surrounding towns were populous and prosperous, and the Negev and the foothills were inhabited?’”
s: Are these not the words that the LORD proclaimed through the earlier prophets, when Jerusalem and its surrounding towns were populous and prosperous, and the Negev and the foothills were inhabited?’”

ZEC.7.8.t: Then the word of the LORD came to Zechariah, saying,
s: Then the word of the LORD came to Zechariah, saying,

ZEC.7.9.t: “This is what the LORD of Hosts says: ‘Administer true justice. Show loving devotion and compassion to one another.
s: “This is what the LORD of Hosts says: ‘Administer true justice. Show loving devotion and compassion to one another.

ZEC.7.10.t: Do not oppress the widow or the fatherless, the foreigner or the poor. And do not plot evil in your hearts against one another.’
s: Do not oppress the widow or the fatherless, the foreigner or the poor. And do not plot evil in your hearts against one another.’

ZEC.8.1.t: Again the word of the LORD of Hosts came to me, saying:
s: Again the word of the LORD of Hosts came to me, saying:

ZEC.8.2.t: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: “I am jealous for Zion with great zeal; I am jealous for her with great fervor.”
s: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: “I am jealous for Zion with great zeal; I am jealous for her with great fervor.”

ZEC.8.3.t: This is what the LORD says: “I will return to Zion and dwell in Jerusalem. Then Jerusalem will be called the City of Truth, and the mountain of the LORD of Hosts will be called the Holy Mountain.”
s: This is what the LORD says: “I will return to Zion and dwell in Jerusalem. Then Jerusalem will be called the City of Truth, and the mountain of the LORD of Hosts will be called the Holy Mountain.”

ZEC.8.4.t: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: “Old men and old women will again sit along the streets of Jerusalem, each with a staff in hand because of great age.
s: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: “Old men and old women will again sit along the streets of Jerusalem, each with a staff in hand because of great age.

ZEC.8.5.t: And the streets of the city will be filled with boys and girls playing there.”
s: And the streets of the city will be filled with boys and girls playing there.”

ZEC.8.6.t: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: “If this is impossible in the eyes of the remnant of this people in these days, should it also be impossible in My eyes?” declares the LORD of Hosts.
s: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: “If this is impossible in the eyes of the remnant of this people in these days, should it also be impossible in My eyes?” declares the LORD of Hosts.

ZEC.8.7.t: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: “I will save My people from the land of the east and from the land of the west.
s: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: “I will save My people from the land of the east and from the land of the west.

ZEC.8.8.t: I will bring them back to dwell in Jerusalem, where they will be My people, and I will be their faithful and righteous God.”
s: I will bring them back to dwell in Jerusalem, where they will be My people, and I will be their faithful and righteous God.”

ZEC.8.14.t: For this is what the LORD of Hosts says: “Just as I resolved to bring disaster upon you when your fathers provoked Me to anger, and I did not relent,” says the LORD of Hosts,
s: For this is what the LORD of Hosts says: “Just as I resolved to bring disaster upon you when your fathers provoked Me to anger, and I did not relent,” says the LORD of Hosts,

ZEC.8.15.t: “so now I have resolved to do good again to Jerusalem and Judah. Do not be afraid.
s: “so now I have resolved to do good again to Jerusalem and Judah. Do not be afraid.

ZEC.8.16.t: These are the things you must do: Speak truth to one another, render true and sound judgments in your gates,
s: These are the things you must do: Speak truth to one another, render true and sound judgments in your gates,

ZEC.8.17.t: do not plot evil in your hearts against your neighbor, and do not love to swear falsely, for I hate all these things,” declares the LORD.
s: do not plot evil in your hearts against your neighbor, and do not love to swear falsely, for I hate all these things,” declares the LORD.

ZEP.3.14.t: Sing for joy, O Daughter of Zion; shout aloud, O Israel! Be glad and rejoice with all your heart, O Daughter of Jerusalem!
s: Sing for joy, O Daughter of Zion;
shout aloud, O Israel!
Be glad and rejoice with all your heart,
O Daughter of Jerusalem!

ZEP.3.15.t: The LORD has taken away your punishment; He has turned back your enemy. Israel’s King, the LORD, is among you; no longer will you fear any harm.
s: The LORD has taken away your punishment;
He has turned back your enemy.
Israel’s King, the LORD, is among you;
no longer will you fear any harm.

ZEP.3.16.t: On that day they will say to Jerusalem: “Do not fear, O Zion; do not let your hands fall limp.
s: On that day they will say to Jerusalem:
“Do not fear, O Zion;
do not let your hands fall limp.

ZEP.3.17.t: The LORD your God is among you; He is mighty to save. He will rejoice over you with gladness; He will quiet you with His love; He will rejoice over you with singing.”
s: The LORD your God is among you;
He is mighty to save.
He will rejoice over you with gladness;
He will quiet you with His love;
He will rejoice over you with singing.”

ZEP.3.18.t: “I will gather those among you who grieve over the appointed feasts, so that you will no longer suffer reproach.
s: “I will gather those among you who grieve
over the appointed feasts,
so that you will no longer suffer reproach.

ZEP.3.19.t: Behold, at that time, I will deal with all who afflict you. I will save the lame and gather the scattered; and I will appoint praise and fame for the disgraced throughout the earth.
s: Behold, at that time,
I will deal with all who afflict you.
I will save the lame
and gather the scattered;
and I will appoint praise and fame
for the disgraced throughout the earth.

ZEP.3.20.t: At that time I will bring you in; yes, at that time I will gather you. For I will give you fame and praise among all the peoples of the earth when I restore your captives before your very eyes,” says the LORD.
s: At that time I will bring you in;
yes, at that time I will gather you.
For I will give you fame and praise
among all the peoples of the earth
when I restore your captives
before your very eyes,”
says the LORD.
